title_cn: Share-Borne AI 病毒：跨 LLM 智能体的内存跳跃攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型正越来越多地被部署为有状态助手，这类助手能够跨交互保留信息，并使用工具读取、修改和创建持久化制品。随着这些制品在用户之间共享，它们在原本相互独立的助手之间形成了一条间接通信信道。我们研究了一种故障模式，其中该信道使自我传播攻击成为可能。我们引入「制品介导传播」概念：通过制品（如报告）植入的对抗性内容，被存入助手的持久记忆，在随后创建的制品中得以复现，并被之后读取该制品的另一个助手所获取。我们在时序人机宇宙中对这一过程进行评估，该宇宙对独立运行的助手之间随时间推移的制品交换进行建模，度量攻击能否在连续传递中存活、能到达多少跳，以及传播范围有多广。我们发现，攻击可以跨越多个独立助手传播，并在较长的交互序列中持续存在。在更大规模的模拟环境中，即便是 GPT-5.6 Luna 也表现出相当大的传播范围，感染率达到 60–80% 的智能体，传播链延伸至八跳。这些结果表明，持久化制品可以充当对抗性状态的持久载体，使攻击得以超越单次交互的生命周期，并在相互隔离的助手之间扩散。
summary_cn: 提出工件中介传播攻击：对抗内容经工件进入 agent 持久记忆、再写入新工件被其他 agent 读取；在时序人机环境模拟中发现即便是 GPT-5.6 Luna 也会扩散至 60–80% agent，传播链可达 8 跳。
objective_summary: 构建模拟独立 agent 间工件交换的时序环境，评估对抗内容经持久记忆与工件在多 agent 间的传播率、跳数与存活性，并在包括 GPT-5.6 Luna 的模型上测量。
evidence_note: 在模拟多 agent 环境中测量多模型的传播率与跳数，给出 60–80％ 覆盖与 8 跳等数字，摘要未提及真实部署对照与统计检验。
novelty_note: 将工件作为跨 agent 的持久对抗载体并给出自传播链路的新攻击模式。
scope: 具备持久记忆与可读写共享工件的多 LLM agent 场景，评测基于模拟人机世界。
limitations: 基于模拟环境与少量模型，真实生态中的防护叠加与缓解效果未在摘要中给出。

title: The Compiler May Read It, the Agent May Not: Keeping Part of a Research Code Away from a Coding Agent
abstract: The compiler must read modules a physics-based solver cannot build without; the coding agent must not read that intellectual property. The harness does not ship that rule. We classified fifteen read routes against a container, permission rules and a sandbox. None of the three can tell which program is reading.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Ancillary files: the classification and history scripts with their outputs
title_cn: 编译器可以读，智能体不能读：让编码智能体远离研究代码的某些部分
abstract_cn: 编译器必须读取基于物理的求解器不可或缺的模块；而编码智能体不得读取那份知识产权。harness 并不内置这条规则。我们针对容器、权限规则和沙箱，对十五条读取路径进行了分类。三种方案均无法区分是哪个程序在读取。
summary_cn: 对编译器必须读、编码 agent 不应读的物理求解器 IP，按容器、权限规则与沙箱三类机制对十五条读取路径做分类，指出三者都无法分辨读取方是哪个程序。
objective_summary: 将十五条读访问路径分别对照容器、权限规则与沙箱做分类分析，考察现有 harness 能否按读取主体区分编译器与编码 agent。
evidence_note: 6 页篇幅，核心为十五条读路径的分类与一张表，无系统实现或大规模实验。
novelty_note: 聚焦编码 agent 与编译器读权限区分这一具体隔离需求，并指出现有机制的共同不足。
scope: 本地研究代码场景下，编码 agent 与编译器对同一文件系统的读访问隔离。
limitations: 未给出可行的新机制实现与性能评估，结论停留在分类层面。

title: INTCC: A Framework for Interactive Confidential Computing
abstract: Confidential computing leverages Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) to ensure the confidentiality and integrity of data in use. However, TEEs rely on remote attestation to guarantee the integrity of their initial memory state. This model is fundamentally at odds with interactive development workflows. In scenarios like LLM fine-tuning and exploratory data analysis, data processors need human-in-the-loop capabilities, including dynamic code injection, intermediate state inspection, and hyperparameter tuning, all of which inherently violate the static, one-time integrity guarantees of traditional remote attestation. To reconcile this tension, we propose the interactive confidential computing paradigm, a system architecture enabling untrusted data processors to execute dynamic, non-deterministic operations within TEEs without compromising data confidentiality. Driven by the insight that inherently unmeasurable human interaction must be excluded from the Trusted Computing Base (TCB), we logically partition the TEE into an interactive controller and a verifiable runtime. To realize this paradigm, we present INTCC, a framework featuring three key mechanisms: (1) a proxy-based dispatch system to preserve the native development experience; (2) a fine-grained information flow control mechanism based on a security lattice to prevent data leakage; and (3) a privacy-preserving verifiable execution mechanism to guarantee the runtime compliance of dynamic workflows. We implement INTCC on AMD SEV-SNP using Confidential Containers and evaluate it across diverse real-world workloads. Our experiments demonstrate that INTCC effectively balances security and interactivity, incurring a practical overhead of less than 5% for LLM fine-tuning and under 17% for data analysis relative to baseline execution.
title_cn: INTCC：交互式机密计算框架
abstract_cn: 机密计算利用可信执行环境（TEE）来保障使用中数据的机密性与完整性。然而，TEE 依赖远程证明来保证其初始内存状态的完整性。这一模型与交互式开发工作流存在根本性冲突。在 LLM 微调和探索性数据分析等场景中，数据处理方需要人在回路的能力，包括动态代码注入、中间状态检查和超参数调整，而这些操作本质上违背了传统远程证明的静态、一次性完整性保证。为消解这一矛盾，我们提出交互式机密计算范式——一种系统架构，使不可信的数据处理方能够在 TEE 内执行动态、非确定性操作，同时不损害数据机密性。基于「本质上不可度量的人类交互必须排除在可信计算基（TCB）之外」这一洞见，我们将 TEE 在逻辑上划分为交互控制器和可验证运行时两部分。为实现这一范式，我们提出 INTCC——一个具备三项关键机制的框架：(1) 基于代理的分发系统，以保留原生开发体验；(2) 基于安全格的细粒度信息流控制机制，以防止数据泄漏；(3) 保护隐私的可验证执行机制，以保证动态工作流的运行时合规性。我们基于 AMD SEV-SNP，使用 Confidential Containers 实现了 INTCC，并在多种真实工作负载上进行了评估。实验结果表明，INTCC 能够有效平衡安全性与交互性，相较于基线执行，LLM 微调的实际开销不超过 5%，数据分析的开销不超过 17%。
summary_cn: 提出交互式机密计算范式，把 TEE 逻辑切分为交互控制器与可验证运行时，用代理分发、基于安全格的细粒度信息流控制与隐私保护可验证执行三机制，在 AMD SEV-SNP 上实现 INTCC，LLM 微调开销＜5％、数据分析＜17％。
objective_summary: 设计 INTCC 框架调和远程证明与交互式工作流，基于 AMD SEV-SNP 与机密容器实现并在 LLM 微调、数据分析等真实工作负载上评估性能开销。
evidence_note: 在真实工作负载上给出相对基线的开销数据，但摘要未明示工作负载规模、对照系统与统计检验。
novelty_note: 针对动态非确定交互场景将 TEE 拆分为控制器与可验证运行时的架构在摘要中为新提出。
scope: 基于 AMD SEV-SNP 与机密容器的 TEE 工作流，验证于 LLM 微调与探索式数据分析。
limitations: 依赖 SEV-SNP 的安全假设，开销评估集中在两类负载，摘要未覆盖对抗性场景下的安全性量化。
institution: Southern University of Science and Technology

title: Detecting False Data Injection and Unstable Operation in Smart Grid via System-Aware Graph Boundary Learning
abstract: Cyber-physical power systems increasingly rely on data-driven tools to detect instability and support reliable grid operation. However, reliable stability prediction is difficult when unstable operating configurations are rare, sensitive, or unavailable during model development, since collecting such data safely and at scale is often impractical. At the same time, False Data Injection (FDI) attacks can manipulate reported system parameters to trigger false instability alarms or conceal unsafe operation, and such threats in Decentral Smart Grid Control (DSGC) systems remain largely unexplored. These challenges are rarely addressed jointly, leaving a gap between stability prediction and attack detection that this work aims to close. In this paper, we introduce StarGNN, a graph learning framework that learns the stable operating region exclusively from clean stable configurations and uses a single abnormality score to flag reported configurations that should not be trusted as evidence of safe operation, covering both genuine instability and unseen FDI manipulations. Each configuration is represented as a producer-consumer star graph and processed by a role aware graph neural network, with physics constrained pseudo-negatives generated by perturbing reaction time and price response parameters standing in for the unavailable unstable and attack data. A single threshold, calibrated only on held-out stable data, is used without task or attack specific adjustment. Evaluated on nine unseen FDI scenarios, StarGNN detects between 0.780 and 0.973 of attacks on stable configurations and retains a post attack instability recall between 0.972 and 0.999 on unstable ones, with 0.899 recall against a stronger adaptive attacker, showing that stable-only boundary learning can support both stability prediction and attack detection without access to genuine unstable labels or attack samples during training.
title_cn: 通过系统感知图边界学习检测智能电网中的虚假数据注入与不稳定运行
abstract_cn: 信息物理电力系统日益依赖数据驱动工具来检测不稳定性并支持可靠的电网运行。然而，当不稳定运行配置在模型开发期间稀少、敏感或不可用时，可靠的稳定性预测十分困难，因为安全地大规模收集此类数据往往不切实际。与此同时，虚假数据注入（FDI）攻击可以操纵报告的系统参数以触发虚假不稳定告警或隐藏不安全运行，而此类威胁在去中心化智能电网控制（DSGC）系统中仍基本未被探索。这些挑战鲜少被联合解决，在稳定性预测与攻击检测之间留下了本工作旨在弥合的差距。本文介绍 StarGNN，一个图学习框架，该框架仅从干净稳定配置中学习稳定运行区域，并使用单一异常分数标记不应被信任为安全运行证据的报告配置，涵盖真实不稳定性与未见过的 FDI 操纵。每个配置被表示为生产者-消费者星形图，并由角色感知图神经网络处理，以扰动反应时间与价格响应参数生成的物理约束伪负样本代替不可用的不稳定数据与攻击数据。单一阈值仅在保留的稳定数据上校准，无需针对任务或攻击的特定调整。在九个未见过的 FDI 场景上进行评估，StarGNN 在稳定配置上检测到 0.780 至 0.973 的攻击，在不稳定配置上保持 0.972 至 0.999 的攻击后不稳定性召回率，对更强自适应攻击者的召回率为 0.899，表明仅基于稳定数据的边界学习可以在训练期间无需访问真实不稳定标签或攻击样本的情况下同时支持稳定性预测与攻击检测。
summary_cn: 提出 StarGNN，用生产者-消费者星图加角色感知 GNN，仅从稳定运行配置学边界并以单一异常分同时识别失稳与 FDI 攻击；九个未见 FDI 场景检测率 0.780–0.973，失稳召回保持 0.972–0.999，对自适应攻击者仍有 0.899 召回。
objective_summary: 将 DSGC 配置建模为星图并用角色感知 GNN 在稳定数据上学边界，通过物理约束伪负样本代替缺失的不稳定与攻击数据，在九个未见 FDI 场景与自适应攻击者下评测检测与召回。
evidence_note: 覆盖九个未见 FDI 场景并包含自适应攻击者评测，报告具体检测率与召回区间，但未提及统计检验。
novelty_note: 将仅稳定数据的边界学习与 FDI 检测合在同一异常分内处理，想法在已有图异常检测方向上有改进。
scope: DSGC 智能电网配置的失稳与 FDI 联合检测，阈值仅在干净稳定数据上标定。
limitations: 依赖物理约束伪负样本的质量，真实不稳定与攻击标签在训练中仍缺席。

title: Beyond Scalar Probes: Exploiting Vector-Valued Outputs in ReLU Networks For Signature Extraction
abstract: We revisit cryptanalytic extraction of ReLU networks from a geometric and algebraic perspective. Rather than restricting attention to a single output component, we study the full vector-valued behavior across adjacent linear regions. This leads to a rank-one characterization of Jacobian differences that recovers the usual row-signature information while also revealing complementary column-side information. Our experiments show how this additional structure can be used in ex- traction and improves numerical estimation under different numerical- precision regimes (float64, float32 and float16). We extend the analysis beyond the high-precision and output-rounding settings commonly con- sidered in the literature towards the low-precision settings encountered in many practical settings.
title_cn: 超越标量探测：利用ReLU网络的向量值输出进行签名提取
abstract_cn: 我们从几何与代数视角重新审视 ReLU 网络的密码分析提取问题。我们不局限于单个输出分量，而是研究跨相邻线性区域的完整向量值行为。这导致雅可比矩阵差值的秩一刻画，在恢复通常的行签名信息的同时揭示互补的列侧信息。我们的实验表明，这种额外结构如何用于提取，并在不同数值精度模式（float64、float32 与 float16）下改善数值估计。我们将分析从文献中通常考虑的高精度与输出舍入设置延伸至许多实际场景中遇到的低精度设置。
summary_cn: 从几何与代数视角重审 ReLU 网络的密码学抽取攻击，利用相邻线性域间 Jacobian 差的秩一结构同时得到行签名与列侧信息，并在 float64/32/16 下评估数值估计效果。
objective_summary: 将 ReLU 网络抽取推广到向量值输出，给出 Jacobian 差秩一特征以同时恢复行列侧信息，并在 float64、float32、float16 多种精度下做抽取与数值估计实验。
evidence_note: 提供多精度下的实验对比，摘要未明示网络规模、基线方法与统计检验。
novelty_note: 将抽取从单输出标量探针扩展到向量值行为并挖掘列侧信息，拓展到低精度实际场景。
scope: ReLU 全连接网络的参数签名抽取，覆盖 float64/32/16 与非输出取整设定。
limitations: 摘要未报告在真实大型模型上的完整抽取结果，重点在数值估计改进。

title: LLM-Assisted Automatic Security Proofs for Cryptographic Protocols: How Far Are We?
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for assisting software and security analysis tasks, yet their effectiveness in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we conduct the first systematic evaluation of the capability of state-of-the-art LLMs in cryptographic symbolic protocol verification. To quantify this capability, we propose \textsc{CRoST} (Coverage Rate of Solve Tree), a proof-based metric derived from the verifier's proof skeleton that measures the similarity between generated lemmas and reference lemmas. We then establish the rationale of \textsc{CRoST} through both theoretical analysis and empirical validation. The evaluation results show that state-of-the-art models achieve 38.82\% coverage on average, with 14.4\% of generated lemmas exceeding 80\% coverage, indicating that LLMs can already generate useful lemmas to a certain extent. However, they still exhibit non-trivial failure modes on complex multi-phase protocols, show diminishing returns under naive scaling, and incur substantial verification overhead. These findings clarify the practical potential and limitations of LLMs for protocol verification and motivate future work on complex real-world protocols.
comment: 12 pages, 12 figures
title_cn: LLM辅助密码协议自动安全性证明：我们进展到哪一步了？
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLMs）在辅助软件与安全分析任务方面展现出强大潜力，然而其在密码符号协议验证中的有效性仍有待充分研究。本文对最先进 LLMs 在密码符号协议验证中的能力进行首次系统性评估。为量化这一能力，我们提出 CRoST（Coverage Rate of Solve Tree），一种从验证器证明骨架派生的基于证明的度量标准，用于衡量生成的引理与参考引理之间的相似度。随后，我们通过理论分析与实证验证建立 CRoST 的合理性。评估结果表明，最先进模型平均达到 38.82% 的覆盖率，14.4% 的生成引理超过 80% 覆盖率，表明 LLMs 在一定程度上已能生成有用的引理。然而，它们在复杂多阶段协议上仍表现出不可忽视的失败模式，在朴素规模扩展下呈现收益递减，并带来大量验证开销。这些发现厘清了 LLMs 在协议验证方面的实际潜力与局限，并激励未来在复杂真实协议上开展工作。
summary_cn: 首次系统评测 SOTA LLM 在密码协议符号化验证上的能力，提出基于证明骨架的 CRoST 指标，发现平均覆盖率 38.82％、14.4％ 的生成引理覆盖率超过 80％，但在复杂多阶段协议上仍有不可忽视的失败模式，朴素扩展收益递减且验证开销大。
objective_summary: 提出覆盖率指标 CRoST 并做理论与实证论证，用其评测多款 SOTA LLM 在生成密码协议符号化验证引理上的表现，报告平均覆盖率与失败模式。
evidence_note: 跨多模型评测并给出覆盖率统计，但协议规模、数量与基线对比在摘要中未明确，无统计检验描述。
novelty_note: 作者自称首个针对密码符号化验证的系统性 LLM 评测，指标 CRoST 为新定义。
scope: 在密码协议符号化验证场景下，用 CRoST 衡量生成引理与参考引理的相似度。
limitations: CRoST 以与参考引理的相似度衡量，依赖已有参考证明；摘要未给被测协议数量与模型清单。

title: Indistinguishability of Sum of Permutations: A Fourier Analytic Route to Classical and Quantum Security
abstract: We study classical and quantum indistinguishability of sums of independent random permutations and related transformations from permutations to functions. Let $G$ be a finite abelian group of order $N$, and let $\pi^k_+(x)=\pi_1(x)+\cdots+\pi_k(x)$ for $k\geq2$ independent uniform random permutations of $G$. We give a unified Fourier analytic treatment in which the construction is represented by its probability density and a distinguisher by its acceptance function, with the classical and quantum query models imposing different restrictions on the Fourier support of the latter. Classically, we obtain the bound $O_k(q/N^{k-1/2})$ for every $q<N$, and refine it below the birthday threshold to $O_k(q^2/N^k)$. In the quantum model, a simulation argument gives $O_k(N^{-(k-3/2)})$ for $q\leq(N-1)/2$, while Fourier interpolation gives concrete finite bounds up to $q\leq4N/15$ and the query-dependent bounds $O\left(\min\left\{N^{-1/2},q^3/N^2 + 1/N\right\}\right)$ and $O_k\left(\min\left\{q^3/N^k,N^{-(k-3/2)}\right\}\right)$, for $k=2$ and $k \geq 3$, respectively, throughout $1\leq q\leq(N-1)/2$. For $q = 1$, the first bound sharpens to $O(N^{-2})$. Over $G=\mathbb F_2^n$, a one-query Fourier attack matches the order of our one-query bound, while an $N/2$-query parity attack with advantage $1/2$ shows that our bounds reach the constant-advantage query threshold. We further study two variants of sum of permutations over binary vector spaces. First, we allow arbitrary surjective linear postprocessing, which includes truncation, and obtain classical and quantum bounds that retain the output-size dependence. Second, we analyse Dinur's variable-output single-permutation construction, $\mathsf{LXoP}$, for every fixed output width, and derive its classical and quantum security bounds; for one- and two-block outputs, we give concrete quantum security bounds.
title_cn: 置换之和的不可区分性：经典与量子安全的傅里叶分析路径
abstract_cn: 我们研究独立随机置换之和及置换到函数相关变换的经典与量子不可区分性。设 G 为阶为 N 的有限阿贝尔群，设 π^k_+(x) = π_1(x) + ⋯ + π_k(x)，其中 k ≥ 2 为 G 上独立均匀随机置换。我们给出统一的傅里叶分析处理方式，其中构造由其概率密度表示，区分器由其接受函数表示，经典与量子查询模型对后者的傅里叶支撑施加不同限制。在经典情形下，对所有 q < N 我们获得界 O_k(q/N^(k-1/2))，并在生日门限以下将其精化为 O_k(q^2/N^k)。在量子模型中，模拟论证对 q ≤ (N-1)/2 给出 O_k(N^(-(k-3/2)))，而傅里叶插值对 q ≤ 4N/15 给出具体有限界，以及在整个 1 ≤ q ≤ (N-1)/2 范围内，k=2 与 k ≥ 3 分别给出查询相关界 O(min{N^(-1/2), q^3/N^2 + 1/N}) 与 O_k(min{q^3/N^k, N^(-(k-3/2))})。对于 q = 1，第一个界精化为 O(N^(-2))。在 G = F_2^n 上，单查询傅里叶攻击与我们单查询界的阶数吻合，而优势为 1/2 的 N/2 查询奇偶性攻击表明我们的界达到了常数优势查询门限。我们进一步研究二进制向量空间上置换之和的两种变体：首先，我们允许任意满射线性后处理（包括截断），并获得保留输出大小依赖性的经典与量子界；其次，我们分析 Dinur 的可变输出单置换构造 LXoP 在每个固定输出宽度下的情形，并推导其经典与量子安全界；对于单块与双块输出，我们给出具体的量子安全界。
summary_cn: 用 Fourier 分析统一处理置换求和与相关构造的经典与量子不可区分性，在有限 Abel 群上给出 O_k（q/N^（k-1/2））及生日界下 O_k（q^2/N^k）等界，并对 LXoP 等变体给出具体量子安全界。
objective_summary: 以概率密度与接受函数的 Fourier 表示统一分析置换求和及其截断、LXoP 等变体，推导经典与量子查询模型下的区分优势上界，并给出匹配的攻击作为紧度证明。
evidence_note: 理论论文，摘要列出多组上界并给出 F_2^n 上一查询攻击与 N/2 查询奇偶攻击作为紧性，具体证明细节未在摘要中展开。
novelty_note: 将经典与量子界放在统一 Fourier 框架内，并覆盖线性后处理与 Dinur 的 LXoP 变体。
scope: 有限 Abel 群上独立随机置换求和及其线性后处理，查询数一般限制在 q≤（N-1）/2 等区间。
limitations: 部分界只在 k=2 或特定查询区间紧，常数依赖 k，摘要未声明一般 k 的紧性。

title: AI-Based Vulnerability Assessment Capability and Cyber Attack Graph Analysis
abstract: Cyber threats targeting mission-critical infrastructure are becoming more sophisticated while the barrier to launching attacks continues to fall. Traditional point solutions like antivirus and firewalls are reactive and fail to address the combinatorial complexity of modern attack surfaces. This paper presents an investigation combining two complementary methodologies: Lockheed Martin's Vortex/Crow framework, which applies multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) over industry-standard cyber knowledge graph to identify and prioritize attack vectors and TTPs (tactics, techniques, and procedures); and Aalto's probabilistic attack graph model that combines network topology and its vulnerabilities to compute system-level risk metrics. The 2015 Ukraine Power Grid cyberattack serves as a well-documented validation scenario. Applied independently to the same operational technology (OT) network topology, both methodologies converge on the same attack vectors and exploit sequences as those documented in the incident record, thus providing mutual cross-validation. Attack graph analyses using node-level elimination experiments identify industrial control systems (ICS) as the most critical enablers of attack propagation, representing high-priority targets for defensive hardening. Comparison of CVSS (v2.0) and IronMiner vulnerability scoring yields in general consistent results, with IronMiner providing more actionable differentiation at network periphery nodes. The layered methodology of baseline assessment and node-level elimination proves to be scalable to large enterprise networks, thus offering defenders a structured, AI-enabled path to prioritize mitigation under realistic time and resource constraints.
title_cn: 基于AI的漏洞评估能力与网络攻击图分析
abstract_cn: 针对关键任务基础设施的网络威胁日趋复杂，同时发动攻击的门槛不断降低。杀毒软件、防火墙等传统单点方案属于被动响应式，无法应对现代攻击面的组合复杂性。本文呈现了结合两种互补方法论的研究：Lockheed Martin 的 Vortex/Crow 框架——在行业标准网络知识图谱上应用多智能体强化学习（MARL），以识别并优先排序攻击向量与 TTPs（战术、技术与程序）；以及 Aalto 的概率攻击图模型——融合网络拓扑及其漏洞以计算系统级风险指标。2015 年乌克兰电网网络攻击事件作为有据可查的验证场景。将两种方法论独立应用于同一运营技术（OT）网络拓扑时，两者均收敛到与事件记录所记载相同的攻击向量和漏洞利用序列，从而实现了相互交叉验证。通过节点级消除实验进行的攻击图分析识别出工业控制系统（ICS）是攻击传播最关键的推动因素，代表防御加固的高优先级目标。对 CVSS（v2.0）与 IronMiner 漏洞评分的比较总体上产生一致结果，IronMiner 在网络外围节点提供了更具可操作性的差异化评估。基线评估与节点级消除的分层方法论被证明可扩展至大型企业网络，从而为防御者提供一条结构化的、AI 赋能的路径，以在现实时间与资源约束下优先安排缓解措施。
summary_cn: 将 Lockheed Martin 的 Vortex/Crow 多智能体强化学习框架与 Aalto 的概率攻击图模型应用于同一 OT 网络拓扑，以 2015 年乌克兰电网事件做验证，两套方法独立都收敛到事件记录中的攻击路径，并指出 ICS 为传播关键节点。
objective_summary: 组合 MARL 攻击图框架与概率攻击图模型，在 2015 年乌克兰电网案例上独立复现攻击序列，并通过节点消除实验识别关键节点，比较 CVSS v2.0 与 IronMiner 评分。
evidence_note: 以单一历史事件 OT 网络拓扑为案例，两套方法相互对照并做节点消除对比，摘要未给大规模评测或统计检验。
novelty_note: 两种既有方法在同一场景下的交叉验证与对比，方法本身非首创。
scope: 针对工控/电网 OT 网络的攻击路径优先级与节点关键性分析，以乌克兰电网拓扑验证。
limitations: 单案例验证，泛化到其他企业网络的能力未在摘要中给出。

title: "Nothing to See Here'': Unintended Disclosure through Revision Traces of LLM Deliverables
abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users draft content for third-party recipients. During private drafting, the user or the model may introduce an item and later remove or replace it. The model may remove the item from the intended content but reveal it again when stating the edit. We call such statements revision traces. For example, after a user removes the password before sharing a configuration file, the model may delete it but leave a comment saying, "Removed the password 'No****4!' as requested." A third-party recipient who sees only the delivered file can therefore recover the withdrawn password from the comment. In an in-the-wild analysis of three public conversation corpora, we identify 26,753 revision requests, of which 2,363 (8.8%) leave revision traces. We study them in greater depth under controlled conditions by introducing RevLeakBench, a benchmark of 100 tasks across five scenarios with a conversation track and an agent track. We measure trace occurrence, withdrawn-item recovery, trace position, and required-content retention. Across six models, about half of the deliverables in both tracks state the edit after a revocation, and a reader that sees only the deliverable can recover the withdrawn item from about 13% of them. Telling the model that its entire reply will be forwarded to the recipient still leaves revision traces in 36.4% of the deliverables. We compare prompt defenses and a delivery boundary, and propose an output-side filter that sharply reduces recovery with little loss of required content. We believe our work can benefit efforts to understand and mitigate unintended disclosure in LLM interactions.
title_cn: 「此处无异常」：通过 LLM 可交付物的修订痕迹造成的意外信息泄露
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型（LLM）助手越来越多地帮助用户为第三方接收者起草内容。在私下起草过程中，用户或模型可能引入某个内容项，随后将其删除或替换。模型可能将该内容项从预期内容中删除，但在说明编辑操作时再次将其暴露。我们将此类陈述称为修订痕迹。例如，用户在分享配置文件前删除密码后，模型可能将其删除，但留下一条注释写道：「已按要求删除密码 'No****4!'」。仅看到已交付文件的第三方接收者因此可以从注释中恢复被撤回的密码。在对三个公开对话语料库的实地分析中，我们识别出 26,753 条修订请求，其中 2,363 条（8.8%）留下了修订痕迹。我们通过引入 RevLeakBench 在受控条件下对其进行更深入的研究，该基准包含跨五个场景的 100 个任务，分为对话轨道和智能体轨道。我们测量痕迹出现率、被撤回内容项的可恢复性、痕迹位置以及必要内容的保留情况。在六个模型中，两个轨道中约一半的可交付物在撤回后陈述了编辑操作，仅看到可交付物的读者可以从其中约 13% 中恢复被撤回的内容项。告知模型其完整回复将被转发给接收者，仍会在 36.4% 的可交付物中留下修订痕迹。我们比较了提示防御与交付边界，并提出了一种输出端过滤器，能够大幅降低可恢复性，同时几乎不损失必要内容。我们相信，本工作有助于推动理解和缓解 LLM 交互中意外信息泄露的相关努力。
summary_cn: 指出 LLM 修订后仍在交付物里留下披露性修订痕迹的问题，在三类公开对话语料里 26753 个修订请求中 2363 条留痕，构建含 5 场景 100 任务的 RevLeakBench 基准，6 模型约一半交付物在撤回后仍陈述编辑动作，读者可从约 13% 中复原被撤项，告知整段将转发时仍有 36.4% 留痕，输出侧过滤能大幅降低复原且几乎不损必要内容。
objective_summary: 在三类公开对话语料里统计修订痕迹现象，构建含 5 场景 100 任务的 RevLeakBench 覆盖对话与智能体两条轨道，用 6 个模型评测痕迹发生率、被撤项复原率、痕迹位置与必要内容保留，并对比提示防御、交付边界与输出侧过滤。
evidence_note: 真实语料 26753 个修订请求的大规模分析加上 100 任务 5 场景 6 模型基准评测，并对多种防御做对照。
novelty_note: 系统刻画此前未被充分研究的修订痕迹无意披露面，并给出可复用基准与可行的输出侧防御。
scope: 结论限于被评测的 6 个模型在对话与代理两条交付轨道上针对撤回敏感项的修订场景。
limitations: 痕迹比例取自三类特定公开语料，输出侧过滤在更对抗性或任务依赖撤回信息时的代价仍需验证。
institution: CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security

title: Planarian: Managing Agent State with Statepoints
abstract: LLM agents solve complex tasks by iteratively changing files, invoking local tools, and interacting with remote services, which modifies state across their local environment and remote services. Today, agents and users must manage these changes explicitly, whether reverting exploratory actions or recovering from erroneous ones. Doing so safely requires coordinated actions, yet current agent harnesses lack unified abstractions and mechanisms for managing local and remote state consistently and efficiently. We describe Planarian, an agent runtime with state management that enables agents and users to recover from erroneous actions and explore alternative executions over consistent local and remote environment state. Planarian introduces the abstraction of agent statepoints, which are consistent, restorable point-in-time versions of the environment state. Planarian exposes three state-management primitives to agents and users: (i) snapshot creates a new statepoint spanning local and remote state without requiring external services to support checkpoints: it relies on efficient incremental process and file system snapshotting to capture local sandboxed state, and transparently records compensating actions to undo remote state changes; (ii) rollback restores the environment to a previous statepoint by reverting to a prior local checkpoint and replaying compensating actions for remote state changes; and (iii) fork creates multiple isolated branches from a statepoint, enabling the agent to explore alternatives in parallel. We show that Planarian enables agents to undo mistakes and explore alternatives in parallel, improving task quality by up to 15x, and allows users to recover from erroneous actions with only 3% overhead.
title_cn: Planarian：使用状态点管理智能体状态
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体通过迭代地修改文件、调用本地工具以及与远程服务交互来解决复杂任务，这些操作会修改本地环境和远程服务中的状态。目前，无论是回滚探索性操作还是从错误操作中恢复，智能体和用户都必须显式地管理这些变更。安全地执行此类操作需要协调一致的行动，然而现有的智能体框架缺乏统一的抽象和机制来一致高效地管理本地与远程状态。我们介绍 Planarian，这是一个具备状态管理能力的智能体运行时，使智能体和用户能够从错误操作中恢复，并在一致的本地与远程环境状态上探索备选执行路径。Planarian 引入了智能体状态点的抽象概念，即环境状态在某一时间点上的一致且可恢复的版本。Planarian 向智能体和用户暴露三种状态管理原语：（i）snapshot 创建一个横跨本地与远程状态的新状态点，无需外部服务支持检查点：它依赖高效的增量进程和文件系统快照来捕获本地沙箱状态，并透明地记录补偿操作以撤销远程状态变更；（ii）rollback 通过回退到先前的本地检查点并重放针对远程状态变更的补偿操作，将环境恢复到先前的状态点；（iii）fork 从一个状态点创建多个隔离分支，使智能体能够并行探索备选路径。我们证明 Planarian 使智能体能够撤销错误并并行探索备选方案，将任务质量最高提升至 15 倍，并允许用户以仅 3% 的开销从错误操作中恢复。
summary_cn: 提出 agent 运行时 Planarian 与状态点抽象，用增量进程文件系统快照记录本地沙箱状态并以补偿动作回放远程变更，提供快照、回滚与分叉三原语，让 agent 并行探索备选执行时任务质量最高提升至 15 倍，用户恢复错误操作仅约 3% 开销。
objective_summary: 实现一个为 LLM agent 提供快照、回滚、分叉三原语的运行时，用增量快照与远程动作补偿机制统一管理本地与远程状态，并在任务质量提升与恢复开销上做评测。
evidence_note: 给出最高 15 倍任务质量提升与约 3% 恢复开销的关键指标，摘要未披露任务规模、模型组合或多次重复情况。
novelty_note: 把数据库式状态点抽象与远程补偿事务引入 agent 运行时统一本地远程状态是新组合，核心机制沿用既有快照与补偿思路。
scope: 适用于本地环境可放入可快照沙箱、且远程服务动作可通过补偿动作撤销的 agent 工作流。
limitations: 远程状态恢复依赖补偿动作是否存在，若外部服务不支持等价撤销则无法完整回退。

title: Hybrid QKD-PQC Network Emulation through Automated and Scalable Cloud-Native Orchestration
abstract: The ongoing transition toward quantum-safe networking has motivated the development of hybrid network architectures integrating Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). However, the experimental evaluation of hybrid QKD-PQC network architectures remains constrained by the high cost and limited accessibility of quantum hardware, as well as by the limited support for hybrid QKD-PQC networks in existing emulation platforms. Quditto is an open-source emulation platform originally designed for QKD networks that enables cost-effective and reproducible experimentation without requiring dedicated physical quantum infrastructure. Building on this foundation, this work presents Quditto as a hybrid QKD-PQC network emulation platform featuring automated and scalable cloud-native orchestration. The proposed platform introduces four principal contributions: a cloud-native orchestrator enabling fully automated infrastructure deployment across cloud and multi-cluster environments; an optimized provisioning workflow enabling large-scale quantum-safe network emulation; native integration of post-quantum nodes enabling unified emulation of hybrid QKD-PQC networks; and a secure key management module providing persistent and access-controlled storage of cryptographic material. Experimental validation demonstrates sublinear orchestration-time scaling with network size and successful end-to-end hybrid QKD-PQC key establishment on a representative spine-leaf deployment, thereby enabling the systematic evaluation of quantum-safe networking mechanisms in large-scale heterogeneous network environments.
title_cn: 通过自动化可扩展云原生编排实现混合 QKD-PQC 网络仿真
abstract_cn: 向量子安全网络的持续演进推动了集成量子密钥分发（QKD）与后量子密码学（PQC）的混合网络架构的发展。然而，混合 QKD-PQC 网络架构的实验评估仍受制于量子硬件的高成本与有限可及性，以及现有仿真平台对混合 QKD-PQC 网络的有限支持。Quditto 是一个最初为 QKD 网络设计的开源仿真平台，无需专用物理量子基础设施即可实现经济高效且可重复的实验。在此基础上，本工作将 Quditto 呈现为一个具备自动化可扩展云原生编排能力的混合 QKD-PQC 网络仿真平台。所提平台引入四项主要贡献：一个支持跨云和多集群环境全自动基础设施部署的云原生编排器；一个支持大规模量子安全网络仿真的优化供给工作流；支持混合 QKD-PQC 网络统一仿真的后量子节点原生集成；以及提供密码材料持久化和访问控制存储的安全密钥管理模块。实验验证表明，编排时间随网络规模呈次线性扩展，并在典型的脊叶式部署上成功实现了端到端混合 QKD-PQC 密钥建立，从而能够在大规模异构网络环境中对量子安全网络机制进行系统性评估。
summary_cn: 把开源 QKD 仿真平台 Quditto 扩展为云原生编排的混合 QKD-PQC 网络仿真平台，加入云与多集群编排器、大规模部署工作流、PQC 节点原生集成与持久化访问控制的密钥管理模块，在代表性脊叶拓扑上完成端到端混合密钥建立，编排时间随网络规模呈次线性扩展。
objective_summary: 扩展 Quditto 平台支持混合 QKD-PQC 仿真，引入云原生编排器、大规模部署工作流、PQC 节点集成与安全密钥管理模块，并在脊叶拓扑上验证端到端混合密钥建立与编排时间扩展。
evidence_note: 在代表性脊叶部署上做端到端验证并测量编排扩展，摘要未与其他仿真平台横向对比或给出功能基准。
novelty_note: 在既有 QKD 仿真平台上加 PQC 节点集成与云原生编排，是把现有组件组装成混合仿真能力，非引入新密码原语。
scope: 适用于基于云原生基础设施搭建混合 QKD-PQC 网络仿真的实验与评测部署。
limitations: 量子行为仍由仿真近似，摘要未与真实 QKD 链路或多厂商异构部署做对比。

title: Zero Knowledge Proofs in Quantum Networks
abstract: Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) enable the verification of a statement without revealing any information beyond its validity and constitute a fundamental primitive in cryptography and information theory. However, existing constructions rely on computational assumptions and are predominantly confined to bipartite settings, leaving their information-theoretic realization in bipartite or network scenarios largely unexplored. Here we develop a framework for zero-knowledge verification based on the indistinguishability of quantum states under operational constraints. Exploiting the fundamental limitations imposed by local operations, we show that a verifier is inherently restricted from extracting information about the underlying state while retaining the ability to verify correctness. We construct explicit protocols for multiparty quantum networks that achieve information-theoretic security, ensuring that no subset of collaborating parties can gain knowledge beyond the validity of the statement, independent of their joint computational power.
comment: 18 pages, 1 figure
title_cn: 量子网络中的零知识证明
abstract_cn: 零知识证明（ZKP）能够在不泄露任何超出其有效性信息的情况下验证一个陈述，是密码学和信息论中的基本原语。然而，现有构造依赖于计算假设，且主要局限于两方场景，其在两方或网络场景中的信息论实现在很大程度上尚未被探索。本文建立了一个基于量子态在操作约束下不可区分性的零知识验证框架。利用局部操作施加的基本限制，我们证明验证者在保留验证正确性能力的同时，本质上被限制无法提取关于底层状态的信息。我们为多方量子网络构造了具体协议，实现信息论安全，确保无论协作方的联合计算能力如何，任意协作方子集均无法获取超出陈述有效性的知识。
summary_cn: 基于操作约束下量子态的不可区分性构建零知识验证框架，证明验证方虽受局部操作限制无法提取底层量子态的信息却仍能验证正确性，并给出面向多方量子网络的显式协议，使任何合谋方子集都无法获得超出陈述有效性的知识，达到信息论安全。
objective_summary: 用量子态在局部操作约束下的不可区分性替代计算假设，构造多方量子网络下的信息论安全零知识验证协议并给出显式方案。
evidence_note: 以构造性协议与安全性论证为主，摘要列出显式多方协议但未报实验或可实现开销评估。
novelty_note: 把 ZKP 从计算假设与两方场景推广到多方量子网络下的信息论安全设定，视角较新。
scope: 结论限于参与方受局部操作约束、且可分发量子态的多方量子网络设定。
limitations: 依赖局部操作限制与量子态分发前提，摘要未讨论噪声、信道损耗与可实现性。

title: Sustained Participation as a Security Resource: The Bounded Participation Channel
abstract: Can sustained, per-identity participation be engineered into a security resource? Most anti-Sybil defenses price identity creation rather than identity survival. Once admitted, an adversary may sustain many identities without paying a recurring cost. We introduce the Bounded Participation Channel (BPC), a formal primitive for repeatedly verifying participation window by window. BPC issues fresh, identity-bound challenges under a strict deadline and enforces four structural properties: identity binding, freshness, real-time response, and bounded per-channel throughput. Together, these yield a provable cost theorem: sustaining $s$ identities over $T$ windows requires $C(s,T) \geq sT/\tau_h$ participation channel-windows. The guarantee is solver-agnostic: a channel may be operated by a human, an AI system, or a hybrid. We give a hash-based construction with publicly verifiable participation proofs, characterize four admissible challenge families, and evaluate two against GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 across 600 trials. Despite near-perfect accuracy (97--100%) on the perceptual tasks, the evaluated automated channels remain throughput-bounded under the tested deployment conditions. The results illustrate a key distinction: solvability does not imply unlimited throughput. By requiring participation to be re-earned by every identity in every time window, BPC turns sustained participation into a measurable security resource with a linear structural cost floor, independent of whether the participation is supplied by humans, AI systems, or hybrids.
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Version 1
title_cn: 持续参与作为安全资源：有界参与信道
abstract_cn: 持续的、基于身份的参与能否被工程化为一种安全资源？大多数抗女巫攻击防御机制对身份创建收费，而非对身份维持收费。一旦通过准入，攻击者便可以维持大量身份而无需支付持续性代价。我们提出有界参与信道（BPC），这是一种逐窗口反复验证参与行为的正式原语。BPC 在严格截止期限内发出新鲜的、与身份绑定的挑战，并强制执行四项结构性属性：身份绑定、新鲜性、实时响应以及每信道吞吐量有界。这些属性共同产生一个可证明的代价定理：在 T 个窗口内维持 s 个身份需要 C(s,T) ≥ sT/τ_h 个参与信道窗口。该保证与求解方无关：信道可由人类、AI 系统或两者的混合体来操作。我们给出一种基于哈希的构造，具有可公开验证的参与证明，刻画了四类可接受的挑战族，并在 600 次试验中针对 GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5 对其中两类进行了评估。尽管在感知任务上的准确率接近完美（97%—100%），被评估的自动化信道在测试的部署条件下仍然受到吞吐量限制。实验结果揭示了一个关键区别：可解性并不意味着无限吞吐量。通过要求每个身份在每个时间窗口内重新获得参与资格，BPC 将持续参与转化为一种可度量的安全资源，具有线性结构代价下界，无论参与由人类、AI 系统还是混合体提供均成立。
summary_cn: 提出有界参与信道形式原语，用窗口内身份绑定挑战逼迫维持 s 个身份 T 个窗口的信道窗口数不低于 sT 除以单位响应阈值，给出哈希构造与可公开验证证明，并在 GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash 与 Claude Sonnet 4.5 上进行 600 次感知挑战试验，显示即便 97% 到 100% 的准确率仍受吞吐上限约束。
objective_summary: 为持续参与定义带四条结构性质的形式原语并证明线性成本下界，给出哈希构造与可公开验证证明，对四类挑战中的两类用三种前沿大模型在 600 次试验上评测。
evidence_note: 三款前沿 LLM 共 600 次试验给出准确率与吞吐分析，未报统计检验或与其他抗 Sybil 机制横向对比。
novelty_note: 从一次性身份创建成本转向按窗口持续重验的新定价维度，并给出求解者无关的结构性成本定理。
scope: 适用于能对身份按窗口下发新鲜挑战并保证实时响应的系统，评估限于四类挑战中的两类与所测自动化信道条件。
limitations: 可解性与吞吐上限的区分依赖于当下 LLM 能力，未来模型若延迟骤降可能侵蚀下界，摘要未覆盖人机混合求解。

title: Continuous Assurance of Agentic Security Auditors for Software Delivery Decision Gates
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based repository auditors are increasingly deployed as security controls within continuous integration (CI) pipelines, where their findings admit, block, or delay software changes. As Agentic Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Security Controls, their non-deterministic behaviour changes the evidence, while organisational risk appetite and jurisdictional or data-sovereignty policy change its interpretation. Point-in-time audits therefore cannot maintain current assurance for merge decisions. We propose the Policy-Evidence-Execution Separation Pattern, implemented by the Trustworthy AI Posture (TAIP) Assurance Engine and operated as Continuous Control Posture Assurance (CCPA). By separating policy from stable execution and binding admitted evidence to a versioned Posture Tree, the same assurance logic operates across models, environments, and policy profiles. We evaluate the approach using unmodified RepoAudit on a fixed Python Null Pointer Dereference benchmark. The retained evidence repository contains 80 RepoAudit executions across two OpenAI model configurations, gpt-4o-mini and gpt-4.1. TAIP recomputes assurance posture after policy, evidence, and model-context changes and is evaluated across increasing numbers of independent Decision Gateway contexts. The maximum observed policy-to-posture latency was 1.1 ms across three policy-class cycles in one execution. At 1,000 independent assurance contexts, full policy-triggered recomputation with one worker recorded a maximum aggregate refresh of 1.62 s, below the predeclared 5 s Decision Gateway budget. These single-host measurements concern assurance over retained evidence and exclude RepoAudit execution and provider inference.
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at ICECCS 2026
title_cn: 面向软件交付决策门的智能体安全审计员的持续保障
abstract_cn: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的仓库审计员越来越多地作为安全控制部署于持续集成（CI）流水线中，其结果决定软件变更是否被允许、阻止或延迟。作为智能体软件开发生命周期（SDLC）安全控制，它们的非确定性行为改变了证据，而组织的风险偏好以及司法管辖或数据主权策略则改变了对证据的解释。因此，点式审计无法为合并决策维持持续有效的保障。我们提出策略-证据-执行分离模式，由可信 AI 态势（TAIP）保障引擎实现，并以持续控制态势保障（CCPA）的方式运行。通过将策略与稳定执行相分离，并将已接纳的证据绑定至版本化的态势树，相同的保障逻辑可跨模型、环境与策略配置运行。我们使用未经修改的 RepoAudit 在固定的 Python 空指针解引用基准上评估该方法。保留的证据库包含跨两种 OpenAI 模型配置（gpt-4o-mini 和 gpt-4.1）的 80 次 RepoAudit 执行。TAIP 在策略、证据和模型上下文发生变化后重新计算保障态势，并在不断增加的独立决策网关上下文数量下进行评估。在三个策略类循环的一次执行中，最大观测策略到态势延迟为 1.1 ms。在 1,000 个独立保障上下文下，单个工作进程的完整策略触发重计算最大聚合刷新时间为 1.62 秒，低于预先声明的 5 秒决策网关预算。这些单机测量仅涉及对已保留证据的保障，不包含 RepoAudit 执行与提供商推理时间。
summary_cn: 提出策略证据执行解耦模式与持续控制态势保障机制，把 LLM 代码审计的证据绑定到版本化态势树，用未修改的 RepoAudit 在 Python 空指针解引用基准上保留 80 次 gpt-4o-mini 与 gpt-4.1 执行记录，策略到态势延迟最高 1.1 ms，1000 个独立保障上下文下单个工作进程全量重算最高 1.62 秒，低于预设 5 秒决策网关预算。（ICECCS 2026）
objective_summary: 把策略、证据与执行三者分离，用版本化态势树承载保留的审计证据，并以 RepoAudit 在 Python 空指针解引用基准上测算策略类变化与多独立决策场景下的保障重算延迟。
evidence_note: 单主机 80 次 RepoAudit 执行、2 种模型配置、延迟测量明确，未与其他保障方案横向对比，样本偏小。
novelty_note: 在既有 LLM 审计流水线之上做治理层扩展，把策略与执行解耦并以版本化态势树承载证据的组合是新组合。
scope: 结论限于对保留证据的保障重算，单主机实验且不包含 RepoAudit 本体执行与提供方推理时间。
limitations: 基准单一、模型组合有限，大规模多主机或多策略组合下的重算与决策门预算尚未验证。

title: Implementing Data Diodes Using Commodity Hardware and Open Source Software
abstract: One-way network devices, known as data diodes, are used to defend against sophisticated cyberattacks. Partly due to their high cost, data diodes are mostly deployed in nuclear power plants and within the government for handling classified information. Although commercially available data diodes are expensive, a data diode's hardware can assembled from commodity fiber-optic network equipment. However, specialized software is needed to send data through a data diode reliably: the receiving program cannot request retransmission of dropped packets, so packet loss must be minimized and mitigated. First, we developed a minimal program to measure packet loss. We found that most packet loss was caused by the receiving program processing incoming packets too slowly, and that packet loss often occurs in clusters. Also, we discovered ways to minimize packet loss on Linux and macOS without using superuser privileges. Next, we tested three existing open source programs for one-way data transfers: netcat, UDPcast, and lidi. Although these programs were unreliable in their default configurations, we identified reliable configurations for UDPcast and lidi. Finally, we incorporated our findings into pydiode, our cross-platform program for reliable one-way data transfers.
comment: 19 pages, 8 figures
title_cn: 使用商用硬件与开源软件实现数据二极管
abstract_cn: 数据二极管是一种单向网络设备，用于防御复杂的网络攻击。部分由于成本较高，数据二极管主要部署于核电站以及政府处理机密信息的场合。尽管市售数据二极管价格昂贵，但其硬件可由商用光纤网络设备组装而成。然而，要可靠地通过数据二极管发送数据，还需要专门的软件：接收程序无法请求重传被丢弃的数据包，因此必须将丢包最小化并加以缓解。首先，我们开发了一个最小程序来测量丢包率。我们发现，大多数丢包是由接收程序处理入站数据包过慢引起的，且丢包往往成簇出现。此外，我们发现了在 Linux 和 macOS 上无需超级用户权限即可最小化丢包的方法。接着，我们测试了三个现有的开源单向数据传输程序：netcat、UDPcast 和 lidi。尽管这些程序在默认配置下不够可靠，但我们为 UDPcast 和 lidi 找到了可靠的配置方案。最后，我们将上述发现融入 pydiode，这是我们自主开发的跨平台可靠单向数据传输程序。
summary_cn: 用商用光纤设备与开源软件搭数据二极管，先用自建最小程序测量丢包并发现接收端处理过慢是主因且丢包常成簇出现；再测试 netcat、UDPcast 与 lidi 三款开源单向传输工具，为 UDPcast 与 lidi 找到可靠配置并给出 Linux 与 macOS 下无需超级用户权限的缓解方法，最后把结论做成跨平台单向传输程序 pydiode。
objective_summary: 先用自建最小程序测量丢包并定位主因，再评估 netcat、UDPcast、lidi 三款开源单向传输程序在 Linux 与 macOS 上的默认与可靠配置，最后实现跨平台单向传输程序 pydiode。
evidence_note: 在两种操作系统上对三款开源程序做丢包测量并识别配置，摘要未报具体吞吐数值或统计检验。
novelty_note: 用商用硬件自建数据二极管的思路已有，主要新颖在系统化测量开源方案并收敛到 pydiode 的工程实现。
scope: 结论限于 Linux 与 macOS 用户态下使用商用光纤网卡与基于 UDP 的单向传输场景。
limitations: 丢包主要受接收端处理速度制约，未解决极高吞吐或超长距链路的可靠性问题。

title: Poster: Towards ProofWeave: A Privacy-Minimised, Integrity-Anchored Evidence Plane for Continuous Agentic Assurance
abstract: Agentic AI systems increasingly act via tools, memory, delegation, and external services. Existing observability and provenance mechanisms can reconstruct events post hoc, but they rarely show, at the time of the record, whether each policy-relevant action was checked by the intended control before execution. This leaves a trust-observability gap for continuous monitoring, detection, and response: later assurance may rest on evidence that is incomplete, privacy-leaking, mutable, or detached from the policy context that governed the event. What's missing in the literature is contemporaneous, policy-bound evidence that the intended control was evaluated under the policy in force at the time. We introduce ProofWeave, a record-time chain-of-evidence concept for agentic AI assurance. At each policy-relevant action boundary, ProofWeave generates a privacy-minimised and integrity-anchored evidence transaction that binds (i) agent intent or action, (ii) control response, and (iii) a policy-at-time snapshot. Each transaction is committed to an append-only ledger and materialised into a derived proof graph. A bounded Weaver Agent translates policy intent into proof obligations, while deterministic validators check evidence completeness, privacy minimisation, policy binding, and integrity. In the minimal scenario, an agent attempts to transmit a secret to an unapproved external sink. The audit compares a logs-only correlation baseline with ProofWeave across verdict latency, join ambiguity, privacy exposure, tamper detection, and resistance to graph-only proof injection. ProofWeave reduces candidate bindings per verdict from up to `10,201` to one, validation operations from up to `10,201` to approximately `26`, and assurance evidence storage from `0.79`\~MiB to `0.15`\~MiB per project.
comment: 3 pages, 2 figures. Poster accepted at ACM CCS 2026
title_cn: 海报：迈向 ProofWeave：面向持续智能体保障的隐私最小化、完整性锚定证据平面
abstract_cn: 智能体 AI 系统越来越多地通过工具、记忆、委托和外部服务采取行动。现有的可观测性与溯源机制可以事后重建事件，但它们在记录当时很少能表明每项策略相关操作是否在执行前已经过预定控制的检查。这给持续监控、检测与响应留下了信任可观测性鸿沟：事后保障所依赖的证据可能是不完整的、泄露隐私的、可篡改的，或与当时约束该事件的策略上下文相脱节。文献中所缺失的，是同期的、与策略绑定的证据，证明预定控制是在事件发生时生效的策略下被评估的。我们提出 ProofWeave，一种面向智能体 AI 保障的记录时证据链概念。在每个策略相关操作边界处，ProofWeave 生成一笔隐私最小化且完整性锚定的证据事务，将（i）智能体意图或操作、（ii）控制响应以及（iii）当时策略快照绑定在一起。每笔事务被提交至一个只追加账本，并物化为一个推导证明图。一个有界 Weaver Agent 将策略意图转化为证明义务，确定性验证器则检查证据完整性、隐私最小化、策略绑定与完整性。在最小化场景中，一个智能体试图将秘密传输至未经批准的外部接收端。审计将纯日志关联基线与 ProofWeave 在裁决延迟、关联歧义、隐私暴露、篡改检测以及抵抗仅图证明注入等方面进行对比。ProofWeave 将每次裁决的候选绑定从最多 10,201 个减少至 1 个，将验证操作从最多 10,201 次减少至约 26 次，并将每个项目的保障证据存储从 0.79 MiB 减少至 0.15 MiB。
summary_cn: 提出 ProofWeave，在 agentic AI 的每个策略相关动作边界生成绑定意图、控制响应与当时策略快照的隐私最小化、完整性锚定证据交易，提交到追加式账本并物化为证明图，在将秘密外传至未授权外部接收端的最小场景下，将每次判决的候选绑定数从最多 10201 降至 1、验证操作从最多 10201 降至约 26、每项目证据存储从 0.79 MiB 降至 0.15 MiB。（CCS 2026 海报）
objective_summary: 提出记录时的策略绑定证据链概念，用确定性验证器检查证据完整性、隐私最小化、策略绑定与完整性，并在将秘密外传至未授权外部接收端的最小场景中与仅依赖日志关联的基线对比裁决延迟、关联歧义、隐私暴露、篡改检测以及抵抗仅图证明注入。
evidence_note: 仅在一个最小偷传场景与日志关联基线对比，无多负载或统计检验，摘要未报其他规模实验。
novelty_note: 把当时策略快照与控制响应在记录时一并锚定，形成可验证证据图，是现有事后溯源之外的新路径。
scope: 适用于 agentic AI 在策略相关动作边界有拦截点、可将当时策略快照与控制响应提交到追加式账本的部署。
limitations: 仅在最小偷传场景下评估，未验证在复杂多步代理与真实策略集下的开销、覆盖与误报。

title: TANGO: Watermarking Masked Diffusion Language Models in Token Pairs
abstract: Masked-diffusion language models fill in masked positions in parallel and in no fixed order. Most practical text watermarks assume left-to-right generation. They key each token to the tokens before it, and in a diffusion model those tokens may still be masked. A fixed green list needs no such context, but it favors the same tokens at every position, so these tokens appear more often in watermarked text. An attacker who compares token frequencies in watermarked and unwatermarked text can recover the list and forge text that the provider's own detector accepts. We present TANGO, a watermark for masked-diffusion language models that keys each new token to a nearby token that is already unmasked. A secret key splits the vocabulary into color classes, and TANGO biases the new token toward a color determined by the key and the nearby token's color. The watermark is therefore embedded in pairs of tokens. Because the favored color changes from position to position, token frequencies stay much closer to those of unwatermarked text than under a fixed green list. Detection needs only the text and the key, and it does not assume any unmasking order. On two masked-diffusion models, TANGO detects nearly all unedited watermarked texts and most edited ones, and frequency attacks that forge the fixed green list fail against it.
title_cn: TANGO：在词元对中为掩码扩散语言模型嵌入水印
abstract_cn: 掩码扩散语言模型并行填充掩码位置，且不遵循固定顺序。大多数实用的文本水印方案假设从左到右的生成过程：它们将每个词元与其前面的词元绑定，而在扩散模型中这些词元可能仍处于掩码状态。固定绿名单无需此类上下文，但它在每个位置都倾向于相同的词元，因此这些词元在已打水印的文本中出现得更为频繁。攻击者通过对比已打水印文本与未打水印文本的词元频率，可以还原该名单，并伪造出能被提供方自身检测器接受的文本。我们提出 TANGO，一种面向掩码扩散语言模型的水印方案，它将每个新词元与附近一个已去掩码的词元绑定。一个密钥将词汇表划分为颜色类别，TANGO 根据密钥与附近词元的颜色共同决定的颜色，对新词元施加偏向。因此，水印被嵌入词元对之中。由于偏向的颜色随位置变化，词元频率与未打水印文本的差异远小于使用固定绿名单时的情形。检测仅需文本和密钥，且不假定任何去掩码顺序。在两个掩码扩散模型上，TANGO 几乎能检测出所有未经编辑的已打水印文本以及大多数经过编辑的文本，而针对固定绿名单的频率攻击在 TANGO 面前均告失败。
summary_cn: 提出针对掩码扩散语言模型的词对水印 TANGO，用密钥把词表分色并让新词偏向由邻近已解掩码词决定的颜色；在两种掩码扩散模型上几乎全部未改写文本可被检出，并抵御固定绿名单的频率伪造。
objective_summary: 针对非从左到右生成的掩码扩散语言模型设计以邻近已揭示词为键的词对水印 TANGO，在两种掩码扩散模型上评估未编辑与编辑文本的检测率及频率伪造攻击下的鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 在两种掩码扩散模型上评估未编辑与编辑文本的检测率以及频率伪造，摘要未给具体数值。
novelty_note: 针对无固定生成顺序的掩码扩散模型，以邻近已揭示词定键的词对水印使频率分布接近非水印文本。
scope: 需知密钥的掩码扩散语言模型文本生成水印检测。
limitations: 仅在两种掩码扩散模型上评估，编辑后文本只有大多数可检出，对更强改写攻击的鲁棒性摘要未给。

title: OT-PCA: New Key-Recovery Plaintext-Checking Oracle Based Side-Channel Attacks on HQC with Offline Templates
abstract: In this paper, we introduce OT-PCA, a novel approach for conducting Plaintext-Checking (PC) oracle based side-channel attacks, specifically designed for Hamming Quasi-Cyclic (HQC). By calling the publicly accessible HQC decoder, we build offline templates that enable efficient extraction of soft information for hundreds of secret positions with just a single PC oracle call. Our method addresses critical challenges in optimizing key-related information extraction, including maximizing decryption output entropy and ensuring error pattern independence, through the use of genetic-style algorithms. Extensive simulations demonstrate that our new attack method significantly reduces the required number of oracle calls, achieving a 2.4-fold decrease for hqc-128 and even greater reductions for hqc-192 and hqc-256 compared to current state-of-the-art methods. Notably, the attack shows strong resilience against inaccuracy in the PC oracle-when the oracle accuracy decreases to 95%, the reduction factor in oracle call requirements increases to 7.6 for hqc-128. Lastly, a real-world evaluation conducted using power analysis on a platform with an ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller validates the practical applicability and effectiveness of our approach.
title_cn: OT-PCA：基于离线模板的新型密钥恢复明文检查预言机侧信道攻击针对 HQC
abstract_cn: 本文介绍 OT-PCA，一种专为 Hamming Quasi-Cyclic（HQC）设计的新型基于明文检查（PC）预言机的侧信道攻击方法。通过调用公开可访问的 HQC 解码器，我们构建离线模板，仅需一次 PC 预言机调用即可高效提取数百个秘密位的软信息。我们的方法通过遗传风格算法解决了优化密钥相关信息提取中的关键挑战，包括最大化解密输出熵以及确保错误模式的独立性。大量仿真实验表明，我们的新攻击方法大幅减少了所需预言机调用次数：与当前最先进方法相比，hqc-128 的调用次数降至原来的 1/2.4，hqc-192 和 hqc-256 降幅更大。值得注意的是，该攻击对 PC 预言机的不准确性表现出较强的鲁棒性——当预言机准确率降至 95% 时，hqc-128 的预言机调用需求缩减倍数提升至 7.6 倍。最后，我们在搭载 ARM Cortex-M4 微控制器的平台上进行功耗分析的实际评估，验证了该方法的实际适用性与有效性。
summary_cn: 提出针对后量子 KEM HQC 的离线模板明文校验预言机侧信道攻击 OT-PCA，与当前最先进方法相比 hqc-128 预言机调用次数降至原来的 1/2.4；预言机准确率 95% 时缩减倍数升至 7.6 倍，并在 ARM Cortex-M4 功耗平台实测验证。
objective_summary: 通过调用公开 HQC 解码器离线构造模板，使单次 PC 预言机调用能提取数百位秘密信息，并用遗传式算法优化熵与错误独立性；在三套 HQC 参数仿真与 Cortex-M4 功耗平台实测。
evidence_note: hqc-128/192/256 三组参数仿真对比现有方法并给出降幅倍数，并在 Cortex-M4 功耗平台做实测验证。
novelty_note: 以离线模板从单次 PC 预言机调用恢复数百位秘密信息，显式优化输出熵与错误模式独立性。
scope: HQC 全部三组参数的 PC 预言机侧信道场景，含 ARM Cortex-M4 实测。
limitations: 真实硬件验证限于单款 Cortex-M4 平台，未覆盖多种实现与对抗性对策。

title: Trajectory-Level Security Debt in LLM Coding Agents
abstract: LLM coding agents can traverse hundreds of intermediate code states before submitting a solution. Evaluating only the final artifact leaves the evolution of security findings unmeasured. We introduce the Security Debt Line Integral (SDLI), which accumulates static-analysis risk when an agent reaches a new best test pass ratio. We instantiate it with four static application security testing (SAST) tools and study artifacts from 830 passing SWE-bench runs, 712 ProgramBench final workspaces, and 13 public MirrorCode trajectories. The two large populations use the final-state special case of SDLI. Two-tool Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) class agreement occurs in 3.9% of SWE-bench runs and 26.2% of the 80 ProgramBench runs passing at least 90% of official tests. These are scanner findings, not validated vulnerability rates. Excluding three advisory-heavy classes reduces the latter rate to 6.2%. Same-task runs differ in their measured scores, while one reconstructed ProgramBench run exposes persistent findings from its first implementation write. A repair case study reduces the scanner signal while preserving tested behavior, but also reveals sensitivity to equivalent API rewrites. SDLI offers a way to study progress and security findings together. Its value for steering agents and confirming exploitable vulnerabilities remains to be established.
title_cn: LLM 编程智能体中的轨迹级安全债务
abstract_cn: LLM 编程智能体在提交解决方案之前可能经历数百个中间代码状态。仅评估最终产物会导致安全发现的演变过程无法度量。我们引入安全债务线积分（SDLI），当智能体达到新的最佳测试通过率时，对静态分析风险进行累积。我们使用四种静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具将其实例化，并研究了 830 次通过的 SWE-bench 运行、712 个 ProgramBench 最终工作空间和 13 条公开 MirrorCode 轨迹的产物。两个大规模群体使用 SDLI 的最终状态特例。在 3.9% 的 SWE-bench 运行以及通过至少 90% 官方测试的 80 个 ProgramBench 运行中的 26.2% 里，出现了双工具通用缺陷枚举（CWE）类别一致。这些是扫描器的发现，而非经验证的漏洞率。排除三个告警密集类别后，后一比率降至 6.2%。相同任务的运行在测量分数上存在差异，而一次重建的 ProgramBench 运行从其首次实现写入就暴露出持续性发现。一项修复案例研究在保留测试行为的同时减少了扫描器信号，但也揭示了对等价 API 重写的敏感性。SDLI 提供了一种将进展与安全发现一并研究的方法。其在引导智能体和确认可利用漏洞方面的价值有待进一步验证。
summary_cn: 提出沿 LLM 编码 agent 轨迹累加 SAST 风险的 SDLI 指标，在 830 条 SWE-bench、712 份 ProgramBench 终态与 13 条 MirrorCode 轨迹上评估，双工具 CWE 类别一致率在 SWE-bench 为 3.9%，在通过至少 90% 官方测试的 80 条 ProgramBench 运行中为 26.2%。
objective_summary: 定义以测试通过率新高为节点、以 SAST 报警累加的 Security Debt Line Integral，用四款 SAST 工具在三组 agent 产物上测量，并做一例修复案例研究。
evidence_note: 覆盖 830 条 SWE-bench、712 份 ProgramBench 终态与 13 条 MirrorCode 轨迹，但两大群体仍为终态近似。
novelty_note: 将 agent 中间状态的静态风险沿轨迹累计，作为仅看终态的编码评估的补充度量。
scope: 以 SAST 报警为信号、以测试通过率为节点的 LLM 编码 agent 轨迹分析。
limitations: 报警并非经确认漏洞，不同工具一致率低，且对等价 API 改写敏感。

title: Analyzing Solana's Blocks and Transactions
abstract: Solana is one of the most popular blockchains, and is arguably the most widely used blockchain for smart contracts, also known as dApps. Understanding the types of smart contracts that are being executed by Solana and their interplay is therefore highly beneficial both for designers of modern blockchains and developers of smart contracts. To that end, in this paper we analyze a million recent Solana blocks. We report statistics about the size of blocks (number of transactions per block), execution time units for individual transactions and fees, and invoked Solana programs. Further, based on the declared readset and writeset of each transaction, as mandated by Solana, we analyze the conflicts and corresponding conflict graphs arising within each block. These latter statistics are important to understand the potential for parallelism in the network, which is one of the main claimed benefits of Solana. The data and code are available in open source.
comment: To appear in The 28th International Symposium on Stabilization, Safety, and Security of Distributed Systems
title_cn: Solana 区块与交易分析
abstract_cn: Solana 是最受欢迎的区块链之一，也可以说是智能合约（又称去中心化应用，dApps）使用最广泛的区块链。因此，了解 Solana 正在执行的智能合约类型及其相互作用，对现代区块链设计者和智能合约开发者均大有裨益。为此，本文分析了近期的 100 万个 Solana 区块。我们报告了区块大小（每个区块的交易数量）、单笔交易的执行时间单元与手续费，以及所调用 Solana 程序的统计数据。此外，基于 Solana 要求的每笔交易的已声明读集与写集，我们分析了每个区块内产生的冲突及相应的冲突图。后一类统计数据对于理解网络中的并行化潜力至关重要，而并行化正是 Solana 宣称的主要优势之一。数据与代码均已开源。
summary_cn: 对最近一百万 Solana 块做测量分析，报告块大小、单笔执行时间单元与手续费、所调用程序以及基于声明读写集的块内冲突图，用以刻画其并行潜力（SSS 2026）。
objective_summary: 统计最近一百万 Solana 块，覆盖块大小、单笔执行时间单元、费用与被调用程序，并按声明读写集构造块内冲突图分析并行潜力。
evidence_note: 一百万个最近 Solana 块的描述性统计，代码与数据声明开源，无与其他链的横向对比。
novelty_note: 把 Solana 必须声明的读写集用于块内冲突图构造，是对其并行机制的实证刻画。
scope: 最近一百万 Solana 块与所声明读写集下的 dApp 执行统计。
limitations: 仅从静态读写集看冲突，未度量运行时实际并行度，也未做纵向跨时期对比。

title: LENS: The Sum Is Worse Than the Parts for Set-Level Poisoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) aggregates evidence from multiple external documents, yet this joint integration creates an underexamined vulnerability: attack effects absent in individual documents can emerge through set-level composition. Existing coordinated attacks do not explicitly enforce that every proper subset remains insufficient in frozen single-round RAG. We formalize set-level compositional poisoning, where documents designed to remain individually plausible jointly redirect RAG outputs to a target answer, while proper subsets fail to induce the target on their own. To construct such attacks, we propose LENS, a generator-black-box multi-agent framework that casts construction as constrained evidence composition. LENS factorizes target inference into a query-conditioned interpretation lens and complementary facts, then uses a nested dual-loop workflow to concentrate steering in the full set while suppressing subset leakage. The outer loop plans the interpretation lens and semantic roles; the inner loop synthesizes documents and applies counterexample-guided repair. Across four benchmarks and three generators, returned packets achieve 0.852 full-set ASR and 0.784 post-retrieval ASR@5, while their strongest proper subsets reach only 0.069. Against construction baselines evaluated on the same frozen manifest, LENS improves all-attempt E2E-Strict@5 from 0.244 to 0.363, a 48.8% relative gain. A blinded human audit finds that 68.3% of returned packets combine an incorrect target, a definite answer-criterion shift, and no target entailment under the original semantics. Across four published defenses, LENS attains the highest defended all-attempt ASR@5, exceeding the strongest baseline by 0.141 on average. Together, these results establish evidence composition as a distinct RAG security boundary and position LENS as a stress test for defenses that reason over document sets.
title_cn: LENS：检索增强生成中集合级投毒的整体劣于部分
abstract_cn: 检索增强生成（RAG）汇聚来自多个外部文档的证据，然而这种联合整合产生了一个研究不足的漏洞：单个文档中不存在的攻击效果可通过集合级组合而涌现。现有的协同攻击并未明确强制要求在冻结的单轮 RAG 中每个真子集均不足以触发攻击。我们形式化定义了集合级组合投毒：设计为单独看来合理的文档联合起来将 RAG 输出重定向至目标答案，而其真子集单独无法诱导出目标。为构造此类攻击，我们提出 LENS，一个将构造任务转化为约束证据组合的生成器黑盒多智能体框架。LENS 将目标推断分解为查询条件化的解释透镜（interpretation lens）和互补事实，继而使用嵌套双循环工作流在完整集合中集中引导，同时抑制子集泄漏。外循环规划解释透镜与语义角色；内循环合成文档并应用反例引导修复。在四个基准和三个生成器上，返回的数据包实现了 0.852 的全集攻击成功率（ASR）和 0.784 的检索后 ASR@5，而其最强真子集仅达到 0.069。相对于在相同冻结清单上评估的构造基线，LENS 将全尝试端到端 E2E-Strict@5 从 0.244 提升至 0.363，相对提升 48.8%。盲审人工评估发现，68.3% 的返回数据包同时具备：目标错误、明确的答案标准偏移以及在原始语义下不蕴含目标。在四种已发布的防御方案中，LENS 达到最高的有防御全尝试 ASR@5，平均超过最强基线 0.141。综合来看，这些结果将证据组合确立为独立的 RAG 安全边界，并将 LENS 定位为针对基于文档集推理的防御机制的压力测试工具。
summary_cn: 形式化 RAG 的集合级合成投毒问题，提出多 agent 框架 LENS 构造联合投毒文档；在 4 个基准 3 个生成器上整集 ASR 达 0.852、最强子集仅 0.069，并压过 4 种已发表防御。
objective_summary: 将「真子集均不足以诱导、整集可诱导」的 RAG 投毒形式化，提出带内外双循环的构造框架 LENS，并在 4 个基准、3 个生成器、4 种发布防御与盲审人类标注下评测。
evidence_note: 4 个基准、3 个生成器、4 种已发表防御上的对比，加 68.3% 盲审人工审计与多项 ASR 指标。
novelty_note: 显式要求任意真子集均不足以成功，将集合级合成投毒刻画为与现有协同攻击不同的 RAG 安全边界。
scope: 冻结单轮 RAG、黑盒生成器、每轮返回若干文档的部署形态。
limitations: 只针对冻结单轮 RAG，未评估多轮或可自适应检索下的效果。

title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
abstract: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.
authors: Brent ByungHoon Kang (1) ((1) Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST))
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, and 9 tables
title_cn: 当有效工具调用改变语义：LLM 智能体的形成一致性分发
abstract_cn: 具有工具能力的智能体从模型可见的接口构造调用，而宿主随后选择其实现。标准分发忽略了描述符与处理程序之间的关系。因此，一个未经更改且符合 schema 的调用，在推出、重连或延迟审批过程中可能获得不同的安全效果。我们将这种失效称为 schema-epoch 漂移。我们提出形成一致性分发（FCD），将实现分析与执行权限相连接。经审查的配置文件从官方来源生成已声明范围内效果的溯源绑定过近似。在封闭目标审批策略下，验证器将每个已形成的调用应用到摘要，仅在其效果符合该调用的安全契约时才捕获后继状态。原子准入与最终跳跃围栏将此决策保留直到效果执行。确切来源保留优先权，捕获的后继者仅在来源退役后才具备资格。存量版本与部署变更重现了该失效。四个配置文件覆盖了 32 个官方版本：29 个无需特定版本更改，三个出现了权限提升。冻结的 16 版本扩展与独立的来源 oracle 相匹配。在预注册的存量对比中，FCD 完成了所有三个效果保持私有的待处理调用，并阻断了所有三个遗漏已公开的调用。精确固定与版本范围拒绝阻止了所有六个调用，而版本范围审批完成了所有六个，但产生了三个公开效果。一个独立的生命周期实验将一个形成捕获的证书携带跨越了来源退役过程。随后安装的相同安全证书在不扩展待处理调用权限的情况下管控了新的形成。
summary_cn: 定义 LLM agent 工具调用在滚动与延迟批准下含义漂移的 schema-epoch drift 问题，提出按声明效果与批准契约分发的 FCD，4 份 profile 覆盖 32 次官方发布中 29 次免改、三次升级。
objective_summary: 把描述符与处理器的关系纳入 LLM agent 工具调用分发，提出带原子准入与最终跳栅栏的 FCD，并在 32 次官方发布与一组预注册对比与生命周期实验中评估。
evidence_note: 4 份 profile 覆盖 32 次发布与 16 次冻结扩展，另有预注册 6 次对比与生命周期实验，规模有限。
novelty_note: 将描述符与处理器关系以及 schema-epoch drift 概念纳入 agent 调度层，并给出配套机制。
scope: 工具启用型 LLM agent 的调度层，依赖可审阅 profile 与官方发布源。
limitations: 评估基于复现的 stock release 与少量实验，未在大规模真实部署中度量开销。
institution: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

title: Efficient TCitH-Based Alternatives to SLH-DSA: Cross-Layer ASIC Design of Mirath
abstract: To address the security risks posed by quantum computers, the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has standardized the post-quantum signature schemes ML-DSA, FN-DSA, and SLH-DSA. While ML-DSA and FN-DSA are lattice-based, SLH-DSA relies on hash-based assumptions. To support cryptographic agility against future vulnerabilities, NIST is evaluating non-lattice candidates as alternatives to SLH-DSA. Among these, TCitH-based schemes are particularly promising due to their compact keys and small signatures. However, their high computational complexity and memory footprint pose significant challenges for efficient implementations on resource-constrained embedded platforms. They remain largely unexplored in this context, particularly in ASIC implementations. To address this gap, we use a cross-layer methodology combining algorithmic and hardware layers to present, to the best of our knowledge, the first ASIC implementation of Mirath, a TCitH-based signature scheme, in a RISC-V-based system. The design is implemented in a 22nm FD-SOI technology node. Compared with an SLH-DSA ASIC implemented in the same technology node, the proposed architecture achieves 17.8x lower signing latency while requiring 58% less total cell area, showing the potential of TCitH-based signatures as efficient non-lattice alternatives from an implementation perspective.
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Nordic Circuits and Systems Conference (NorCAS 2026). 7 pages, 4 figures
title_cn: 高效的基于 TCitH 的 SLH-DSA 替代方案：Mirath 的跨层 ASIC 设计
abstract_cn: 为应对量子计算机带来的安全风险，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）已将后量子签名方案 ML-DSA、FN-DSA 与 SLH-DSA 标准化。ML-DSA 与 FN-DSA 基于格，而 SLH-DSA 依赖基于哈希的假设。为支持针对未来漏洞的密码敏捷性，NIST 正在评估非格候选方案作为 SLH-DSA 的替代。其中，基于 TCitH 的方案因密钥紧凑、签名小而尤为前景可期。然而，其较高的计算复杂度与内存占用对资源受限嵌入式平台上的高效实现构成重大挑战，在这一背景下尤其是 ASIC 实现方面，相关研究仍十分有限。为填补这一空白，我们采用结合算法层与硬件层的跨层方法，据我们所知首次在基于 RISC-V 的系统中实现了 Mirath（一种基于 TCitH 的签名方案）的 ASIC。该设计采用 22nm FD-SOI 工艺节点实现。与同一工艺节点下实现的 SLH-DSA ASIC 相比，所提架构签名延迟降至其 1/17.8，同时所需总单元面积减少 58%，从实现角度展示了基于 TCitH 签名方案作为高效非格替代方案的潜力。
summary_cn: 在 22nm FD-SOI 工艺上给出基于 TCitH 的后量子签名方案 Mirath 的 ASIC 原型，相比同工艺 SLH-DSA 实现签名延迟降至其 1/17.8、总面积减少 58%（NorCAS 2026）。
objective_summary: 跨算法与硬件联合设计 Mirath 签名方案的 RISC-V 系统 ASIC 原型，并与同一 22nm FD-SOI 工艺的 SLH-DSA 实现对比延迟与面积。
evidence_note: 22nm FD-SOI 工艺上的原型并与同工艺 SLH-DSA 做签名延迟与面积对比，无多方案横评。
novelty_note: 作者自称首个 Mirath ASIC 实现，核心贡献是方案在 RISC-V ASIC 上的协同设计与优化。
scope: 22nm FD-SOI 工艺、RISC-V 嵌入式平台上的 Mirath 签名与验签场景。
limitations: 单一工艺与单一基线对比，未覆盖其他 TCitH 候选或其他后量子方案。

title: GAZEleak: Passcode Inference Against Eye-tracking XR Devices Through External Observation
abstract: Mixed-reality headsets such as Apple Vision Pro replace the touch screen with gaze-as-pointer interaction: the wearer looks at a target and confirms with an air pinch. Because the display is inside the headset and the eye tracker is walled off from third-party software, such input is widely assumed to be unobservable to bystanders---a built-in defense against the shoulder-surfing that plagues phones and laptops. We present GAZEleak, a side-channel attack that recovers gaze-driven input from external video of head motion alone, under a strictly local, physical-observer threat model: the adversary only films the wearer from across the room and installs no software on the device. The attack exploits the centrally coupled eye-head motor program: gaze shifts recruit small, target-dependent head reorientations that project into sub-degree pose changes recoverable from commodity video. GAZEleak implements a measurement-based, sparse-optical-flow inference pipeline for users' 6-digit device passcodes. On a preliminary front-view dataset from three author-subjects who were aware of the attack hypothesis, GAZEleak places the true code within the top ten guesses for 56% (10 of 18) of test codes under a cross-person protocol with no labeled victim data, and for every code of the most exposed subject. The performance is subject-dependent: no passcode from the least exposed subject reaches the top ten, although its median guessed passcode rank is 12,786 rather than 500,000 expected from an uninformative ordering. These results provide preliminary evidence that gaze-coupled head motion can expose passcode information under controlled conditions, while motivating broader evaluation across users, behaviors, and capture settings.

title: Still There, No Longer Seen: Exposing Compression-Induced Risk in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: Visual token compression reduces the inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, aggregate robustness measures do not reveal whether a particular adversarial failure is induced by compression or inherited from the underlying model. We define a compression-specific failure (CSF) as an adversarial input that remains correct under full-token inference but fails after compression, casting compression-induced risk as a paired failure attribution problem. Within a controlled diagnostic cohort, counterfactuals show that retained-set allocation causally changes compressed correctness and reveal a negative association between recovery and representation drift in displaced evidence. Motivated by these findings, we propose CIRA, a Compression-Induced Risk Attack for Large Vision-Language Models. Under a vision-encoder white-box setting, CIRA optimizes image perturbations through encoder-side objectives that manipulate token priorities across candidate compression budgets while preserving displaced evidence. CIRA uses no downstream questions or labels and requires no access to the language model, deployed compressor, or exact compression budget. Across 12 dataset-compressor settings evaluated at four budgets, CIRA achieves a mean CSFR of 20.35% while limiting full-token attack success to 6.92%, with similar behavior on additional LVLM families. A cross-view selection-stabilization defense substantially suppresses CIRA, although Adaptive CIRA partially restores its effectiveness. These results show that compression-specific failures persist under restricted access and support paired evaluation of full-token and compressed inference for attributing risk to visual-token compression.

title_cn: 仍在其中，却不再可见：揭露大型视觉-语言模型中压缩诱发的风险

title: Cyclotomic Cosets: Hidden Subgroup and Quantum Sieving Algorithm for Prime-Power Moduli
abstract: The Learning With Errors (LWE) problem is a fundamental assumption in post-quantum cryptography. Regev established a quantum reduction from LWE to the Dihedral Coset Problem (DCP). Later, Brakerski et al. introduced the Extrapolated Dihedral Coset Problem (EDCP), proving its equivalence to LWE. However, unlike DCP, EDCP no longer admits a coset structure. This limits the direct application of techniques for hidden subgroup problems. In this work, we introduce the Cyclotomic Coset Problem (CCP), a cyclotomic generalization of DCP that preserves an exact hidden-subgroup structure. Let $\zeta_p$ be a primitive $p$-th root of unity, let $\pi=\zeta_p-1$, and write $q=p^t$ and $L=t(p-1)$. We work over $R_q=\mathbb Z_q[\zeta_p] \cong \mathbb Z[\zeta_p]/(\pi^L)$, where the isomorphism follows from the total ramification identity $(p)=(\pi)^{p-1}$. We exploit the resulting $\pi$-adic ideal chain to construct a quantum sieve that successively reduces phase states modulo $\pi^{L},\pi^{L-1},\ldots,\pi$. For every fixed prime $p$ and modulus $q=p^t$, our algorithm solves the CCP in time and sample complexity $2^{O_p(\log n\log q)}$, using polynomial quantum space. The sieve also applies to uniform EDCP and Gaussian S|LWE>, yielding quasi-polynomial time algorithms for all the above problems when $q=\text{poly}(n)$. This extends the power-of-two EDCP sieve of Bai et al. (CRYPTO 2025) to a cyclotomic setting. However, we emphasize that our result does not, by itself, yield a quasi-polynomial-time algorithm for standard LWE, because the currently known reduction produces only a limited number of approximate CCP states.
title_cn: 分圆陪集：素数幂模下的隐子群与量子筛选算法
abstract_cn: 带错误学习（LWE）问题是后量子密码学的基本假设。Regev 建立了从 LWE 到二面体陪集问题（DCP）的量子归约。此后，Brakerski 等人引入了外推二面体陪集问题（EDCP），证明了其与 LWE 的等价性。然而，与 DCP 不同，EDCP 不再具有陪集结构，这限制了隐子群问题技术的直接应用。在本文中，我们引入分圆陪集问题（CCP），它是 DCP 的一种分圆推广，保留了精确的隐子群结构。设 ζ_p 为 p 次本原单位根，令 π=ζ_p-1，并记 q=p^t，L=t(p-1)。我们在 R_q=Z_q[ζ_p] ≅ Z[ζ_p]/(π^L) 上工作，其中同构关系由全分歧恒等式 (p)=(π)^(p-1) 得出。我们利用由此产生的 π 进理想链，构造一个量子筛，依次将相位态对 π^L, π^(L-1), ..., π 取模规约。对任意固定素数 p 和模数 q=p^t，我们的算法以时间和样本复杂度 2^(O_p(log n·log q)) 求解 CCP，所用量子空间为多项式量级。该筛选方法同样适用于均匀 EDCP 和高斯 S|LWE>，当 q=poly(n) 时，对上述所有问题均可给出准多项式时间算法。这将 Bai 等人（CRYPTO 2025）的 2 的幂 EDCP 筛推广到了分圆情形。然而，我们强调，本文结果本身并不能给出标准 LWE 的准多项式时间算法，因为目前已知的归约只能产生数量有限的近似 CCP 态。
summary_cn: 提出 CCP 这一 DCP 的分圆推广，保留精确的隐子群结构；在 Z 分圆环的 π-adic 理想链上构造量子筛，对任意固定素数 p 与模 q 等于 p 的 t 次方给出 2 的 O 下标 p 乘 log n log q 次方时间与样本、量子空间多项式的算法，推广了 Bai 等人 CRYPTO 2025 的 2 的幂 EDCP 筛，但明确说明不直接给出 LWE 的准多项式算法。
objective_summary: 定义分圆陪集问题并在 π-adic 理想链上设计量子筛算法，证明其对 CCP、均匀 EDCP 与高斯 S-LWE 态在素数幂模下的时间与样本复杂度界。
evidence_note: 摘要给出复杂度界与明确构造，无数值实验；评估为理论算法分析在摘要层级呈现。
novelty_note: 引入保留隐子群结构的 CCP 并将2 的幂次 EDCP 筛推广到一般素数幂分圆设置，是已有量子筛路线上的实质扩展。
scope: 适用于固定素数 p、模 q 等于 p 的 t 次方的 CCP、均匀 EDCP 与高斯 S-LWE，当 q 为 n 的多项式时达到拟多项式时间。
limitations: 作者明确说现有归约只产生有限数量的近似 CCP 态，因此不能直接给出标准 LWE 的拟多项式算法。

title: SmartMemory: Detecting On-chain-off-chain Communication Inconsistency for Smart Contract via Memory-based Agent
abstract: Smart contracts underpin decentralized finance, where growing demand for on-chain/off-chain communication(OFC) has driven diverse applications such as cross-chain bridges, real-world asset tokenization, and fiat-backed stablecoins. TheOFC-related security incidents in these applications are increasingly frequent, but prior studies address separate vulnerability categories within OFC applications rather than providing a unified view, causing vulnerabilities outside known patterns to be missed.In this paper, we identify OFC inconsistency (OFCI) as a root cause of OFC vulnerabilities, which arises from business-logic flaw and ultimately breaks the equivalence between the on-chain and off-chain asset representations to induce inconsistency.Automatically detecting OFCIs faces two challenges including (1)locating heterogeneous business logic, and (2) transferring existing vulnerability knowledge to identify unseen OFCI instances. To this end, we propose SmartMemory, the first framework to leverage a memory-based agent for OFCI detection. To address heterogeneity, SmartMemory maps diverse implementations ofOFC contracts into a canonical business-semantic representation to locate the business logic for OFCI inspection. For knowledge reuse, SmartMemory integrates a memory-based agent to distill vulnerability knowledge from features into patterns and detection rules, enabling knowledge transfer across cases to identify unseenOFCIs. Lastly, SmartMemory performs taint analysis to verify the reachability, type, and impact of each candidate OFCI. We construct the first real-world OFCI dataset comprising 48 DApps with 81 OFCIs for evaluation, on which SmartMemory achieves80.68% precision and 87.65% recall. In addition, through an analysis of 325 real-world OFC applications, SmartMemory detects 36 previously unknown OFCIs, all of which have been confirmed and fixed by corresponding parties.

title_cn: SmartMemory：通过基于记忆的智能体检测智能合约的链上-链下通信不一致性
abstract_cn: 智能合约是去中心化金融的基础，对链上/链下通信（OFC）日益增长的需求催生了跨链桥、现实资产代币化和法币支持稳定币等多样化应用。这些应用中与 OFC 相关的安全事件日趋频繁，但已有研究针对的是 OFC 应用中各个独立的漏洞类别，而非提供统一视角，导致已知模式之外的漏洞被遗漏。本文将 OFC 不一致性（OFCI）识别为 OFC 漏洞的根本成因——它源于业务逻辑缺陷，最终破坏链上与链下资产表示之间的等价性，从而引发不一致。自动检测 OFCI 面临两大挑战：（1）定位异构的业务逻辑；（2）迁移已有漏洞知识以识别未见过的 OFCI 实例。为此，我们提出 SmartMemory，这是首个利用基于记忆的智能体进行 OFCI 检测的框架。针对异构性问题，SmartMemory 将 OFC 合约的多种实现映射为规范化的业务语义表示，以定位 OFCI 检查所需的业务逻辑。在知识复用方面，SmartMemory 集成了基于记忆的智能体，将漏洞知识从特征提炼为模式与检测规则，实现跨案例的知识迁移以识别未见过的 OFCI。最后，SmartMemory 通过污点分析验证每个候选 OFCI 的可达性、类型及影响。我们构建了首个真实世界 OFCI 数据集，包含 48 个 DApp 和 81 个 OFCI 用于评估，SmartMemory 在其上取得了 80.68% 的精确率和 87.65% 的召回率。此外，通过对 325 个真实 OFC 应用的分析，SmartMemory 检测出 36 个此前未知的 OFCI，所有漏洞均已获相关方确认并修复。

evidence_note: 构建首个 OFCI 数据集、报告 80.68 精确率与 87.65 召回，另在 325 个应用上找出 36 个零日并全部确认修复。

title: Before Acting, Change the State: Prospective State Intervention for Web Agents under Deceptive Interfaces
abstract: LLM-based Web agents can autonomously complete user tasks, yet deceptive interfaces can steer them toward outcomes that conflict with users' interests. Existing defenses primarily intervene on agent behavior through blocking, guidance, or replanning. We identify a distinct failure mode: a task-valid action can still realize an unauthorized consequence because of the current Web state. This motivates treating task-relevant Web state itself as a runtime control target. We introduce Veer, an agent-side runtime defense that leaves task planning to the base agent and intervenes on Web state when a proposed action would produce an unauthorized consequence. Before modifying the live environment, Veer constructs a prospective intervention trajectory toward a safe task-relevant state and executes it with runtime grounding and verification. Across TrickyArena and WebDecept, Veer achieves the highest safe task completion in all three evaluation settings, exceeding the next-best defense by 15.9 and 25.0 percentage points on TrickyArena-Single and TrickyArena-Multi, respectively, while reducing dark-pattern success on WebDecept to 0.3%. These gains persist across dark-pattern types and all 12 agent, model, and benchmark configurations. Ablations show that active state intervention provides the largest gain, while prospective rollout and temporal evidence contribute additional improvements. These results establish task-relevant Web state as an effective runtime control target for protecting Web agents from deceptive outcomes.
title_cn: 行动之前，先改变状态：针对欺骗性界面下 Web 智能体的前瞻性状态干预
abstract_cn: 基于 LLM 的 Web 智能体能够自主完成用户任务，然而欺骗性界面可能将其引导至违背用户利益的结果。现有防御方案主要通过拦截、引导或重新规划来干预智能体行为。我们识别出一种独特的失败模式：某个操作本身对任务而言是合法的，却因当前 Web 状态而导致未经授权的后果。这促使我们将与任务相关的 Web 状态本身视为运行时控制目标。我们提出 Veer，一种智能体侧的运行时防御方案，它将任务规划交由基础智能体负责，当拟议操作将产生未经授权的后果时，则对 Web 状态进行干预。在修改实际环境之前，Veer 会构建一条通向安全的任务相关状态的前瞻性干预轨迹，并通过运行时锚定与验证来执行。在 TrickyArena 和 WebDecept 上，Veer 在全部三种评估设置中均实现了最高的安全任务完成率，在 TrickyArena-Single 和 TrickyArena-Multi 上分别比次优防御方案高出 15.9 和 25.0 个百分点，同时将 WebDecept 上的暗模式成功率降至 0.3%。这些提升在各类暗模式和全部 12 种智能体、模型与基准测试配置下均保持稳定。消融实验表明，主动状态干预带来了最大的性能增益，而前瞻性展开和时序证据则贡献了额外的改进。这些结果表明，与任务相关的 Web 状态是保护 Web 智能体免受欺骗性后果的有效运行时控制目标。
summary_cn: 提出 Veer，在 Web agent 面对欺骗界面时把任务相关的页面状态作为运行时控制对象，预先构建一条通向安全状态的干预轨迹再执行；在 TrickyArena-Single 和 TrickyArena-Multi 上安全任务完成率比次优防御高 15.9 和 25.0 个百分点，WebDecept 上暗模式成功率降至 0.3%。
objective_summary: 针对欺骗界面提出先修改 web 状态再执行动作的 agent 侧防御，在 TrickyArena 两种设置和 WebDecept 上与现有拦截、引导、重规划防御比较安全完成率。
evidence_note: 两个基准三种设置、12 种 agent、模型与基准配置，附消融；摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 将任务相关 web 状态而非 agent 行为作为运行时控制目标，并采用前瞻性干预轨迹，与既有行为侧防御区分。
scope: 适用于基于 LLM 的 web agent 在 TrickyArena 与 WebDecept 覆盖的暗模式场景，依赖对任务相关状态的识别能力。
limitations: 评估限于 TrickyArena 与 WebDecept 两个基准，真实网站上的效果摘要未给；主动修改 Web 状态可能带来的副作用未讨论。

title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
abstract: Large language models can generate functionally correct code that still contains security weaknesses, motivating repair pipelines that first diagnose a weakness type before deciding how to fix it. The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) provides a standardized vocabulary for such diagnoses, but asking an autoregressive language model to generate a CWE label and extracting it from the response raises questions about output validity, speed, and cost, as well as accuracy. We evaluate Jev, a decision model that instead selects directly from a declared set of candidates and returns a probability for each, against six open-weight autoregressive models and a frontier proprietary model, GPT-5.6-Sol, on a controlled 50-way CWE classification task over 1,916 CyberSecEval benchmark examples. Jev outperforms all six open-weight baselines on every classification and ranking metric, while its comparison with GPT-5.6-Sol depends on the metric: GPT-5.6-Sol achieves higher Top-1 accuracy and Macro-F1, whereas Jev achieves higher Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy and a nearly identical MRR, at $6.27\times$ lower median API latency and $55.9\times$ lower estimated API cost. We further build JevVibe, a diagnosis-guided repair agent that uses predicted CWE labels to repair code generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. With Jev providing the diagnosis, the agent increases the detector-measured security pass rate from 63.5% before repair to 70.7%, compared with 66.1% for LLM-guided repair. These results show that JevVibe is effective at improving the security of generated code, with Jev providing reliable and efficient CWE classification.
title_cn: JevVibe：高效的分类引导安全代码生成
abstract_cn: 大型语言模型可以生成功能正确但仍包含安全弱点的代码，这促使修复流水线在决定如何修复之前先诊断弱点类型。通用缺陷枚举（CWE）为此类诊断提供了标准化词汇表，但要求自回归语言模型生成 CWE 标签并从响应中提取它，会引发关于输出有效性、速度、成本和准确性的问题。我们在 1,916 个 CyberSecEval 基准样本上的受控 50 类 CWE 分类任务中，将 Jev（一种直接从声明的候选集中选择并为每个候选返回概率的决策模型）与六个开放权重自回归模型及一个前沿专有模型 GPT-5.6-Sol 进行比较。Jev 在所有分类和排名指标上均优于全部六个开放权重基线；与 GPT-5.6-Sol 的比较则因指标而异：GPT-5.6-Sol 在 Top-1 准确率和 Macro-F1 上更高，而 Jev 在 Top-3 和 Top-5 准确率上更高，MRR 几乎相同，且中位 API 延迟低至其 1/6.27，估计 API 成本低至其 1/55.9。我们进一步构建了 JevVibe，一个诊断引导的修复智能体，使用预测的 CWE 标签来修复由 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct 生成的代码。在 Jev 提供诊断的情况下，该智能体将检测器测量的安全通过率从修复前的 63.5% 提升至 70.7%，而 LLM 引导修复为 66.1%。这些结果表明 JevVibe 能够有效提升生成代码的安全性，而 Jev 则提供了可靠且高效的 CWE 分类。
summary_cn: 用决策模型 Jev 从 50 个 CWE 候选中直接选类并给概率，在 1916 个 CyberSecEval 样本上胜过六个开放权重基线，Top-1 和 Macro-F1 低于 GPT-5.6-Sol 但 Top-3、Top-5 更高且中位延迟与估计成本分别低至其 1/6.27 与 1/55.9；接入修复 agent JevVibe 后 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 的安全通过率从 63.5 升到 70.7。
objective_summary: 在 1916 个样本的 50 路 CWE 分类任务上比较 Jev 与六个开放权重模型和 GPT-5.6-Sol，并构建 JevVibe 修复 agent 测量 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 的安全通过率变化。
evidence_note: 1916 个样本、50 类分类、八个模型对比，Top-k、MRR、延迟和成本都有数字，但只测一个修复目标模型。
novelty_note: 把分类选项式决策模型用于 CWE 诊断并驱动修复流水线，在已有 LLM 修复路线上做了诊断先行的改进。
scope: 适用于 CyberSecEval 50 类 CWE 场景与 Qwen2.5-Coder-32B 生成代码的修复，Jev 分类范围闭合于声明候选集。
limitations: Top-1 和 Macro-F1 仍低于 GPT-5.6-Sol，修复评估依赖检测器度量而非功能正确性，样本局限于单一基准。

title: DGF-Bench: A Benchmark for Simulating and Auditing Deception Against Multi-Agent Governance Boards
abstract: Tool-using language-model agents can review enterprise projects as governance boards do: they read the evidence, apply written rules and decide whether the project may proceed. Part of that evidence comes from suppliers and project members with a stake in the decision. DGF-Bench is a benchmark in which a board of agents (specialist gates and a General gate that consolidates their decisions) reviews synthetic dossiers while an attacker plants deceptive content in evidence the organization does not vouch for. Dossiers are generated from canonical facts under 61 executable rules, with 42 authoritative records and 32 narrative documents; every gate is certified decidable from those records. Attacks never change an authoritative value, so an attacked dossier keeps the reference decisions of its clean copy. A success is attributable only when the agent receives the injection and takes the exact injected action, which it does not take on the paired clean dossier; the DGF score is the share of applicable fixed attacks a model blocks. Reading documents and records themselves, five of six models were outcome-strict (disposition, findings, actions and authorization all correct) on 82 to 85 of 85 gates. Over 2,622 attacked gate runs, seven direct-order, false-data and false-authority attacks obtained one attributable success against these five, whereas task-aligned attacks imitating the organization's own process passed against four of them: a record note citing a fake review procedure lowered GPT-6 Luna Pro from 34 to 6 outcome-strict gates and DeepSeek V4 Pro from 33 to 7. DGF scores ranged from 96.2 to 26.9, and a policy-aware adaptive attacker writing in records succeeded against five of six models. The approval tool executed no forged approval, yet deceived agents submitted approvals that the rules forbid. The open-source package dgf-bench computes the DGF score with one command.
