For datasets of size \(n\) on $[0,1]^d$ with $d\ge2$, existing pure \(\varepsilon\)-differentially private mechanisms achieve expected $1$-Wasserstein error of order $(\varepsilon n)^{-1/d}$, reflecting the curse of dimensionality. While this rate is optimal in the worst case, it can be overly pessimistic when the data are supported on a lower-dimensional set. We formalize this through a multiscale packing-growth dimension $k$, which captures the geometric complexity of the support via the growth of packing numbers across scales. We propose \emph{Adaptive Pruned-PMM}, a pure $\varepsilon$-differentially private mechanism that combines private depth selection with our pruned variant of the Private Measure Mechanism (PMM) of He et al.\ (2023). The mechanism supports deeper, geometry-adapted hierarchies with expected running time $O\!\left(d(n+d)\log(\varepsilon n)\right)$, which is near-linear in $n$ for fixed dimension and privacy budget. Under an external multiscale packing-growth condition with dimension $k$, we show that, for fixed positive privacy budgets and fixed geometry, the expected $1$-Wasserstein error is of order $(\varepsilon n)^{-1/k}$ for $k>1$ as $n$ grows. We also prove a lower bound under a corresponding internal packing-growth condition, showing that the exponent $1/k$ is sharp within this framework.
comment: 43 pages, including appendices
title_cn: 面向私有合成数据的几何自适应机制
abstract_cn: 在高维情形下生成具有有意义 Wasserstein 效用保证的差分隐私合成数据颇具挑战性。对于 [0,1]^d（d≥2）上规模为 n 的数据集，现有纯 ε-差分隐私机制所达到的期望 1-Wasserstein 误差量级为 (εn)^(-1/d)，反映了维数灾难。尽管该速率在最坏情况下是最优的，但当数据支撑在低维集合上时，该速率可能过于悲观。我们通过多尺度填充增长维度 k 对此进行形式化，该维度通过跨尺度填充数的增长来捕捉支撑集的几何复杂度。我们提出 Adaptive Pruned-PMM，一种纯 ε-差分隐私机制，将私有深度选择与 He 等人（2023）的 Private Measure Mechanism（PMM）的剪枝变体相结合。该机制支持更深的几何自适应层级结构，期望运行时间为 O(d(n+d)log(εn))，在固定维度和隐私预算下关于 n 近乎线性。在维度为 k 的外部多尺度填充增长条件下，我们证明，对于固定正隐私预算和固定几何结构，随着 n 增大，k>1 时期望 1-Wasserstein 误差的量级为 (εn)^(-1/k)。我们还在相应的内部填充增长条件下证明了下界，表明指数 1/k 在此框架内是紧的。
summary_cn: 提出纯 ε 差分隐私的 Adaptive Pruned-PMM 机制，用多尺度堆积增长维度 k 刻画支集几何复杂度，在 k 大于 1 时将 1-Wasserstein 误差从 (εn)^{-1/d} 改进到 (εn)^{-1/k}，并给出匹配下界。
objective_summary: 在支集可能低维的高维数据上提出私有深度选择结合剪枝 PMM 的几何自适应机制，证明 1-Wasserstein 误差上下界与近线性运行时。
evidence_note: 给出上界、匹配下界与 O(d(n+d)log(εn)) 复杂度证明，纯理论工作，摘要未报告实验。
novelty_note: 用多尺度堆积增长维度把 PMM 的误差率从环境维 d 替换成几何维 k，并证明 1/k 指数在该框架内是尖的。
scope: [0,1]^d 上满足外部多尺度堆积增长条件、固定隐私预算与几何的数据集，k 大于 1 时渐近成立。
limitations: 依赖对支集几何的多尺度假设，摘要未给出实证评测或与现有机制的实证对比。

title: Estimation is Not Enough: Carpet-Bombing Detection via Per-Packet Uniformity Testing
abstract: Carpet-bombing attacks spread traffic uniformly across one or more destination IP prefixes, keeping every host in the prefix below alarm thresholds while exhausting prefix-level defenses. Existing carpet-bombing detectors run at seconds-to-minutes latency, too slow to respond within the attack window. Sketches support per-packet processing in fixed-width memory, a natural fit for cutting latency, yet no sketch-based detector exists for carpet bombing. Because source addresses can be spoofed, and attacks can be launched through reflection, source-side evidence is structurally unavailable and detection must anchor at the destination side. We present SweepSketch, the first sketch-based detection model for carpet bombing: it anchors at the destination, keeps no source state, and compresses a tagged self-cleaning T-HLL primitive, per-packet CUSUM decisions, and dual-EWMA change gates into 44-byte fixed-width buckets deployable on the Tofino2 programmable switch. Its design is supported by six theorems, including verifiable detection lower bounds. Under the same memory budget, SweepSketch leads all 10 baselines across the sketch, entropy, and sequential-testing classes in F1 (0.991). Its median alarm latency is 186--627 ms, and it has structural immunity to source spoofing. On 30 real/synthetic multi-prefix samples held out from parameter design, it detects all 140 victim prefixes.
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 13 tables
title_cn: 仅靠估计还不够：基于逐包均匀性检验的地毯式轰炸检测
abstract_cn: 地毯式轰炸攻击将流量均匀分散到一个或多个目标 IP 前缀上，使前缀内每台主机的流量保持在告警阈值以下，同时耗尽前缀级防御能力。现有的地毯式轰炸检测器运行延迟在秒到分钟级别，响应速度无法满足攻击窗口内的要求。Sketch 数据结构支持在固定宽度内存中进行逐包处理，天然适合降低延迟，但目前尚无针对地毯式轰炸的基于 Sketch 的检测器。由于源地址可被伪造，且攻击可通过反射发起，源侧证据在结构上不可用，检测必须锚定在目标侧。我们提出 SweepSketch，首个针对地毯式轰炸的基于 Sketch 的检测模型：它锚定在目标侧，不保留源状态，并将带标签的自清洁 T-HLL 原语、逐包 CUSUM 决策和双 EWMA 变化门压缩为 44 字节固定宽度桶，可部署在 Tofino2 可编程交换机上。其设计由六个定理支撑，包括可验证的检测下界。在相同内存预算下，SweepSketch 在 Sketch 类、熵类和序列检验类共 10 条基线中以 F1 值 0.991 全面领先。其告警延迟中位数为 186–627 ms，并对源地址欺骗具有结构性免疫。在从参数设计中留出的 30 个真实/合成多前缀样本上，它检测到全部 140 个受害前缀。
summary_cn: 提出首个针对地毯轰炸的草图检测模型 SweepSketch，用自清理 T-HLL、逐包 CUSUM 与双 EWMA 变化门压入 44 字节桶，可部署 Tofino2；相同内存下 F1 为 0.991，优于 10 个基线，中位报警延迟 186-627 毫秒。
objective_summary: 在目的侧用草图原语检测跨前缀均匀铺开的地毯轰炸攻击，固定内存实现于 Tofino2 并在 30 个真实与合成多前缀样本及 10 个基线上对比。
evidence_note: 与 10 个基线对比并给出 F1 0.991、延迟 186-627 ms；30 个样本覆盖 140 个受害前缀，附 6 条可验证定理。
novelty_note: 作者自称首个针对地毯轰炸的草图检测模型，且结合可编程交换机与形式化下界。
scope: 部署在 Tofino2 的目的侧前缀级检测，针对多前缀地毯轰炸与可能的源地址伪造或反射攻击。
limitations: 评测仅覆盖 30 个样本与所列基线，摘要未讨论站点规模与多样流量下的误报分布。

title: Application Agnostic EM Side-Channel Emanations of the FPGA Clock Distribution Network
abstract: Electromagnetic side channels have been extensively utilized in non-invasive attacks or analyses to extract critical information from deployed systems. Most of the attacks or analyses are typically executed on cryptographic algorithms under the assumption that the underlying implementation remains fixed. The assumption is valid in the context of fixed hardware, where modifications to the circuit are not made after manufacturing. However, in the case of adaptive hardware, including field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), the assumption no longer holds as modifications to the configuration of the array are permitted post-manufacturing. Consequently, this study introduces a methodology for the analysis of electromagnetic side channels of an FPGA through the study of deterministic finite state machines (DFSMs), where the effects of placement, routing, and operating frequency on the EM emanations of the FPGA due to the utilized clocking resources are characterized. To analyze the impact of frequency, device placement, and resource allocation on the EM emanations from the FPGA, statistical analysis including mean difference and variance difference calculations of measured EM fields were utilized to identify points of high EM activity on a set grid of sampled points. A 1.32x increase in flagged grid points was observed in the analysis of the mean difference when the percentage of utilized clock resources was increased from 25% to 90%. Similarly, a 1.39x increase in flagged grid points was observed when the variance difference was calculated for the same increase in clock resources.
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables, conference
title_cn: FPGA 时钟分配网络的应用无关电磁侧信道辐射
abstract_cn: 电磁侧信道已被广泛用于非侵入式攻击或分析，以从已部署系统中提取关键信息。大多数攻击或分析通常针对密码学算法执行，前提是底层实现保持不变。该假设在固定硬件的情境下是成立的，即制造后不对电路进行修改。然而，对于包括现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）在内的自适应硬件，该假设不再成立，因为允许在制造后修改阵列配置。因此，本研究提出一种通过研究确定性有限状态机（DFSM）来分析 FPGA 电磁侧信道的方法，对布局、布线和工作频率对 FPGA 因所使用时钟资源而产生的电磁辐射的影响进行了表征。为分析频率、器件布局和资源分配对 FPGA 电磁辐射的影响，利用包括均值差和方差差计算在内的统计分析方法，在一组固定采样点网格上识别高电磁活动点。当已用时钟资源占比从 25% 增至 90% 时，均值差分析中标记的网格点数量增至原来的 1.32 倍。类似地，对相同的时钟资源增量计算方差差时，标记的网格点数量增至原来的 1.39 倍。
summary_cn: 针对 FPGA 时钟分发网络提出与应用无关的电磁侧信道刻画方法，用确定性有限状态机扫描布线、放置与频率；时钟资源利用率从 25% 提到 90% 时，均值差异与方差差异的高活动点分别增至原来的 1.32 倍与 1.39 倍。
objective_summary: 以 DFSM 扫描 FPGA 时钟资源在不同布线、放置与频率下的电磁辐射，用均值差与方差差统计量在采样网格上定位高活动点。
evidence_note: 有系统性网格扫描与统计量对比，但只在单板测量，无基线方法比较也无加密目标验证。
novelty_note: 把 EM 侧信道分析从固定实现扩展到可重构硬件的时钟网络本身，视角与传统密码实现分析不同。
scope: 单一 FPGA 的时钟分发网络在设定频率与资源利用率范围内的 EM 辐射特性。
limitations: 尚未将刻画结果映射到具体密钥或信息恢复攻击，设备与型号覆盖有限。

title: Leaky Students: Membership Inference against On-Policy Distillation
abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student to match a teacher's next-token distributions on student-generated trajectories. However, privileged information supplied to the teacher for OPD training may contain sensitive data. Whether the student leaks private information about the records supplied to the teacher during distillation remains poorly understood. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first systematic study of membership inference in this setting. We find that fresh student trajectories expose sparse membership signals that fixed reference-answer losses often miss. These signals are mixed with probability changes caused by training on other records. We introduce Leaky, which samples fresh trajectories from the target model and compares its token log-probabilities with the maximum across matched reference models trained without the candidate records. It applies Leaky ReLU to the resulting gaps, preserving positive gaps and downweighting negative gaps as an approximate correction for incidental positive gaps in non-members. Across fifteen targets spanning mathematics, medical question answering, and code generation, Leaky outperforms all evaluated baselines and achieves mean AUROC 0.875, compared with 0.614 for the strongest baseline on each target in the main evaluation. On the same sampled trajectories, the strongest baseline achieves mean AUROC 0.826. These results show that students trained through OPD can expose the membership of records used for teacher supervision, even when fixed reference-answer losses provide little evidence of membership.
title_cn: 泄露的学生：针对在策略蒸馏的成员推断
abstract_cn: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生生成的轨迹上训练学生模型以匹配教师模型的下一个词元分布。然而，在 OPD 训练中提供给教师的特权信息可能包含敏感数据。学生模型是否会泄露蒸馏过程中提供给教师的记录的私有信息，目前仍知之甚少。据我们所知，我们呈现了该设置下成员推断的首项系统性研究。我们发现，新鲜的学生轨迹暴露了固定参考答案损失往往遗漏的稀疏成员信号。这些信号与训练其他记录所引起的概率变化混杂在一起。我们引入 Leaky，它从目标模型中采样新鲜轨迹，并将其词元对数概率与不包含候选记录训练的匹配参考模型中的最大值进行比较。它对所得差值应用 Leaky ReLU，保留正差值并降低负差值的权重，作为对非成员中偶发正差值的近似修正。在涵盖数学、医学问答和代码生成的 15 个目标上，Leaky 优于所有评估基线，在主评估中实现了平均 AUROC 0.875，而每个目标上最强基线的平均值为 0.614。在相同的采样轨迹上，最强基线实现了平均 AUROC 0.826。这些结果表明，通过 OPD 训练的学生模型可以暴露用于教师监督的记录的成员身份，即使固定参考答案损失几乎不提供成员身份的证据。
summary_cn: 首个对在策略蒸馏（OPD）做成员推断的系统研究，提出 Leaky 用学生自采轨迹对比参考模型 token 对数概率，并以 Leaky ReLU 处理增益；15 个目标上平均 AUROC 0.875，最强基线 0.614。
objective_summary: 针对在策略蒸馏场景设计成员推断攻击 Leaky，用学生新采样轨迹与无候选记录训练的参考模型对比 token 对数概率，在数学、医疗问答与代码三类共 15 个目标上评估。
evidence_note: 跨 15 个目标、三类任务，与多个基线对比并报告 AUROC 0.875 vs 0.614，同轨迹上最强基线 0.826。
novelty_note: 作者自称首次系统研究 OPD 场景下的成员推理，指出固定参考答案损失会漏掉的稀疏信号。
scope: 在线策略蒸馏训练出的学生模型，教师在数学、医疗问答与代码生成领域的监督场景。
limitations: 摘要未报告在更大模型、不同蒸馏超参下的稳健性，也未讨论防御代价。

title: ORBIT: A Framework for Multi-Agent Safety and Security Evaluations
abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems are increasingly deployed for complex, long-horizon tasks or emerge as a natural consequence of agents interacting in the wild. Yet they give rise to significant safety and security risks: the flexible protocols that enable task generalization also expose novel threats, from cascading prompt injection to inter-agent collusion. Progress in defending against these threats has been slowed by a lack of shared empirical infrastructure, which forces bespoke environment development for every new defense and makes standardized comparison impossible. Existing evaluations address isolated threat models or single-agent settings, but none jointly vary attack, defense, and architecture across realistic multi-agent environments. To address this gap, we introduce ORBIT, a configurable evaluation framework for empirical multi-agent safety and security research, built on UK AISI's Inspect. ORBIT lets researchers configure communication topologies, memory, scheduling, and agent roles. It supports four threat types and four defense strategies, as well as non-adversarial failures, with a benchmark suite spanning five scenario families covering browser use, computer use, agentic coding, customer service, and cooperative allocation. Our central finding is a gap in defense transferability across threats: per-action defenses that cut a compromised agent's attack success by 60 points on multi-issue coding give no measurable protection against colluding agents, and none of the defenses we tested generalized over all attacks tested. We further demonstrate security-performance tradeoffs and interactions between architecture and defense effectiveness. We make ORBIT available open-source at https://github.com/wlanderson0/orbit.
title_cn: ORBIT：多智能体安全性与安全评估框架
abstract_cn: 多智能体 LLM 系统正越来越多地被部署用于复杂的长时域任务，或作为智能体在真实环境中交互的自然产物而涌现。然而，它们带来了显著的安全性与安全风险：支持任务泛化的灵活协议同样暴露了新型威胁，从级联提示注入到智能体间的共谋。针对这些威胁的防御进展因缺乏共享的实证基础设施而受阻，这迫使每项新防御措施都需定制开发环境，且无法进行标准化比较。现有评估针对孤立的威胁模型或单智能体设置，但没有任何评估在真实多智能体环境中联合变化攻击、防御与架构。为填补这一空白，我们引入 ORBIT——一个基于英国 AISI 的 Inspect 构建的可配置多智能体安全性与安全实证研究评估框架。ORBIT 允许研究人员配置通信拓扑、记忆、调度及智能体角色。它支持四种威胁类型与四种防御策略，以及非对抗性故障，基准套件涵盖五个场景族，包括浏览器使用、计算机使用、自主编程、客户服务和协作分配。我们的核心发现是防御跨威胁的可迁移性存在差距：在多问题编程任务上将受损智能体攻击成功率降低 60 个百分点的逐动作防御，对共谋智能体没有提供任何可测量的保护，且我们测试的所有防御措施均无法泛化到所有测试攻击。我们进一步展示了安全性与性能之间的权衡，以及架构与防御有效性之间的交互关系。我们在 https://github.com/wlanderson0/orbit 以开源形式发布 ORBIT。
summary_cn: 提出基于 Inspect 的多智能体 LLM 安全评估框架 ORBIT，支持 4 类威胁、4 类防御与 5 类场景族，发现防御难以跨威胁迁移：在多问题编码场景把攻击成功率降 60 个百分点的逐动作防御对合谋智能体无可测量的保护。
objective_summary: 基于 UK AISI Inspect 构建可配置多智能体安全评估框架，覆盖浏览器、计算机使用、编码等五类场景，用四种攻击与四种防御的组合实验考察防御迁移性与架构交互。
evidence_note: 覆盖 5 个场景族、4 种威胁类型与 4 种防御策略，报告逐动作防御降低攻击成功率 60 个百分点等结果，但摘要未给模型数量与统计检验。
novelty_note: 现有评测只覆盖孤立威胁或单智能体设置，ORBIT 在多智能体环境中联合变动攻击、防御与架构。
scope: 多智能体 LLM 系统，涵盖浏览器、计算机使用、编码、客服与协作分配五类任务。
limitations: 所测防御均未在所有攻击上泛化，摘要未报告跨模型族的稳健性。

title: Never Emitted: Reporter Attribution in GitHub's Machine-Readable Vulnerability Records
abstract: The CVE record format defines a credits container that names who found or reported a vulnerability, with a typed role per entry. The OSV schema defines an equivalent field. GitHub, which assigns CVE identifiers for advisories in its ecosystems, collects this information from reporters, requires them to accept it, displays it on the advisory page, and serves it through its own REST API. It emits it into neither standardized format. Across 238 GitHub-assigned CVE records whose linked advisory publicly credits at least one party, zero carry a credits container, while all 238 carry metrics and problemTypes, two fields the CVE schema leaves optional exactly as it leaves credits. Across 302 advisories in the same pool we retrieved GitHub's own OSV export file, and zero carry a credits field. The omission is not a property of either format: the Erlang Ecosystem Foundation populates the CVE field on 18 of 18 records in the same pool using a freely available client for CVE Services. In a census of all 4,889 published CVE records in a two-week window, 46.9% carry credits, GitHub's rate is 0 of 570 without any advisory filter, and assigner behaviour is concentrated at the extremes without being exhausted by them: 16 assigners emit the field on no record and 13 on essentially every record, while 8 assigners covering 23% of the records sit in between. A request to close the gap has been open since January 2023; GitHub's stated reason for deferring it is quoted verbatim. We further show that the NVD API schema defines no credits field, so attribution that CNAs do emit does not reach the database most tooling consumes: of 43 credit-bearing records traced from advisory to CVE record to NVD, none retained it. We release the collection scripts and a frozen snapshot of every API response.
comment: Replication package and datasets: this https URL
title_cn: 从未输出：GitHub 机器可读漏洞记录中的报告者归因
abstract_cn: CVE 记录格式定义了一个 credits 容器，用于记录漏洞发现者或报告者的姓名及每条条目的类型化角色。OSV 模式定义了一个等效字段。GitHub 为其生态系统中的安全公告分配 CVE 标识符，从报告者处收集此信息，要求其确认，并在公告页面上展示，同时通过其 REST API 提供访问。然而，GitHub 在两种标准化格式中均未输出这一信息。在 238 条 GitHub 分配的 CVE 记录中（其关联公告至少公开致谢一方），没有一条包含 credits 容器，而 238 条全部包含 metrics 与 problemTypes——这两个字段与 credits 一样，在 CVE 模式中均为可选字段。在同一池中的 302 条公告中，我们检索了 GitHub 自身的 OSV 导出文件，没有一条包含 credits 字段。这一遗漏并非两种格式本身的特性：Erlang Ecosystem Foundation 使用一个免费可用的 CVE Services 客户端，在同一池的 18 条记录中全部填充了 CVE credits 字段。在对两周窗口内 4,889 条已发布 CVE 记录的普查中，46.9% 包含 credits，GitHub 的比率为 570 条中 0 条（不加任何公告过滤），分配者行为集中在两个极端但不止于此：16 家分配者在任何记录中均未输出该字段，13 家几乎在每条记录中均输出，而覆盖 23% 记录的 8 家分配者介于两者之间。弥合这一差距的请求自 2023 年 1 月起悬而未决；GitHub 所述的推迟原因已被逐字引用。我们进一步表明，NVD API 模式未定义 credits 字段，因此 CNA 确实输出的归因信息无法到达大多数工具所使用的数据库：在从公告追溯到 CVE 记录再到 NVD 的 43 条含 credits 记录中，没有一条保留了该信息。我们公开了数据收集脚本及每个 API 响应的冻结快照。
summary_cn: 测量 GitHub 分配 CVE 时报告者归属字段的缺失情况，238 条含公开致谢的 CVE 零条带 credits、302 条 OSV 导出同样零条带 credits，两周 4889 条 CVE 总体 46.9% 带 credits、GitHub 的 570 条为 0，附复现脚本与数据快照。
objective_summary: 大规模统计 GitHub 分配的 CVE 记录与 OSV 导出中 credits 字段填充率，与其他 CNA 行为分布对比，并追踪字段在 NVD 下游是否保留。
evidence_note: 两周窗口 4889 条 CVE 全量普查、238 与 302 条 GitHub 相关样本、43 条追踪到 NVD，附脚本与快照数据。
novelty_note: 首次量化 GitHub 系统性缺失 credits 字段及其对下游 NVD 的影响，并对比其他 CNA 行为分布。
scope: GitHub 作为 CNA 的 CVE/OSV 记录及其 NVD 下游映射，样本窗口为两周。
limitations: 观察窗口仅两周，归因机制与 GitHub 内部决策流程未深入，仅引述已有工单。

title: Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation
abstract: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed $\Theta = (c_x, c_y, \text{zoom})$ along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set ($\partial\mathcal{M}$). By projecting the recurrence $z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c$ onto the modular residue ring $\mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ and the fixed-point domain $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving $\mathcal{I}_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset \mathbb{Z}/9\mathbb{Z}$ ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting ($\le 9$ and $\le 12$ steps), absence of $\mathbb{Q}_{16.16}$ square overflow below $2^{63}-1$, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound ($\le 22,557 \le 24,000$ gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, 1 listing. Formal verification in Lean 4 (v4.34.1, Mathlib4, 0 sorry). Ancillary files include Lean 4 proofs, Solidity contracts, and bare-metal 40-core gauntlet replication scripts
title_cn: 基于边界动态的零存储过程化神经合成：Lean 4 中的形式化验证与裸机严苛验证
abstract_cn: 当代神经推理架构依赖存储于高带宽内存（VRAM）中的密集浮点权重矩阵，由此产生严重的内存墙瓶颈，并阻碍在以太坊虚拟机（EVM）等确定性虚拟机内的原生执行。在 Blum-Shub-Smale 模型中，对连续域上递归动力系统的终止性与算术不变量的验证通常是不可判定的。在此，我们呈现对 WERR（Waves & Errors）与 Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics（OED）的形式化验证与裸机实证验证——这是一种非张量决策范式，可按需从 24 字节坐标种子 Θ = (c_x, c_y, zoom) 沿 Mandelbrot 集边界（∂M）过程化合成非线性决策边界。通过将递推关系 z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c 投影到模余环 Z/9Z 与定点域 Q_{16.16} 上，我们在 Lean 4（v4.34.1）配合 Mathlib4 中建立了十条机器验证定理，且无任何未证猜想（sorry）：证明了 I_3 = {0,3,6} ⊂ Z/9Z 的理想闭包、通用燃料有界停机（≤9 步与 ≤12 步）、Q_{16.16} 平方运算在 2^63-1 以下无溢出、非常数边界逃逸敏感性，以及参数化 EVM gas 上界（≤22,557 ≤ 24,000 gas）。在 40 核双路 Intel Xeon 服务器上评估，向量化 36 次迭代 CPU 内核在 6.49 秒内处理 100,000 次决策（15,397 次决策/秒，VRAM 占用 0 字节，加速比 15.15 倍），同时 sigmoid 异常值门控在保留 89.60% 干净基线信号的同时，抑制了 100.00% 的对抗性尖峰。
summary_cn: 提出 WERR 与 Phase III OED 非张量决策范式，从 24 字节坐标种子沿 Mandelbrot 边界合成决策边界，在 Lean 4（v4.34.1）加 Mathlib4 中证明 10 条含 EVM gas ≤ 22557 上界的定理（零 sorry），40 核 Xeon 服务器上 10 万次决策耗时 6.49 秒。
objective_summary: 构建非张量程序式决策范式 WERR/OED，在 Lean 4 加 Mathlib4 中给出 10 条机器可验证定理（零 sorry），并在 40 核 Xeon 服务器上做 CPU 核函数吞吐基准。
evidence_note: Lean 4 完成 10 条定理证明（零 sorry）并在 40 核服务器上做 10 万次决策性能基准，无与现有系统的功能对比。
novelty_note: 提出以 Mandelbrot 边界动力学合成决策边界的无权重神经推理范式，并给形式化验证与 EVM gas 上界。
scope: 智能合约内推理场景，决策基于 Mandelbrot 集边界与 Q16.16 定点，EVM gas 不超过约 24000 的参数化上界下。
limitations: 表达能力受程序式边界动力学限制，与通用神经网络在复杂任务上的能力差距未评估。

title: On the Usage of Verifiable Credentials in Privacy-Preserving Federated Analytics
abstract: Privacy-Preserving Federated Analytics enables multiple nodes to collaboratively derive statistical insights without exchanging raw data. However, ensuring node authenticity and data validation (avoiding concerns such as identity tracking, data linkage, or data leakage) remain fundamental challenges. This paper offers some insights into the feasibility of defining an authenticated, integrity-preserving data model by coupling FPPA with Verifiable Credentials defined within the Self-Sovereign Identity framework.
title_cn: 关于隐私保护联邦分析中可验证凭证的使用
abstract_cn: 隐私保护联邦分析使多个节点能够在不交换原始数据的情况下协作推导统计洞见。然而，确保节点真实性与数据验证（避免身份追踪、数据关联或数据泄露等问题）仍是根本性挑战。本文通过将 FPPA 与 Self-Sovereign Identity 框架中定义的 Verifiable Credentials 相结合，探讨了定义一种经过认证且保持完整性的数据模型的可行性，并提供了若干见解。
summary_cn: 讨论将隐私保护联邦分析（FPPA）与自主主权身份框架下的可验证凭证耦合，以同时提供节点身份认证与数据完整性保护的可行性分析。
objective_summary: 概念性探讨将 FPPA 与自主主权身份框架下定义的可验证凭证耦合，以构建认证且保完整性的数据模型的可行性。
evidence_note: 摘要未提供实验或系统实现，仅为可行性讨论与设计性分析。
novelty_note: 将已有的可验证凭证与 SSI 概念映射到联邦分析场景，是概念耦合而非新机制。
scope: 隐私保护联邦分析节点认证与数据校验设定，不涉及具体部署或性能评估。
limitations: 停留在讨论层面，没有原型实现与性能或安全评估。

title: Coordinated Electromagnetic Side-Channel Attacks for Voter--Ballot Linking: A Case Study of the Brazilian E-Polling System
abstract: In this work, we show how two adversaries (Eve and Mallory) can coordinate an electromagnetic side-channel attack to recon- struct the vote displayed on an e-voting machine (EVM) and link it to a specific voter (Alice). Assuming that Eve has access to a place adjacent to the e-polling room (e.g., restroom, unsupervised room), she performs vote reconstruction by intercepting un- intended electromagnetic emanations associated with the video signal. Meanwhile, Mallory observes when Alice is voting and reports this information to Eve over the Internet. To validate the most critical stage of the attack, we conduct a software-defined radio experiment using the official Brazilian e-voting interface and demonstrate through-wall vote reconstruction. Although conventional monitors are employed rather than official EVMs, our findings provide insights into information forensics and support security recommendations for government authorities responsible for e-voting systems.
title_cn: 用于选民-选票关联的协同电磁侧信道攻击：巴西电子投票系统案例研究
abstract_cn: 在本工作中，我们展示了两名对手（Eve 和 Mallory）如何协同发动电磁侧信道攻击，以重建电子投票机（EVM）上显示的选票并将其与特定选民（Alice）关联。假设 Eve 可以进入投票室相邻场所（如洗手间、无人监管的房间），她通过截获与视频信号相关的意外电磁辐射来进行选票重建。与此同时，Mallory 观察 Alice 的投票时机，并通过互联网将该信息报告给 Eve。为验证攻击中最关键的阶段，我们使用官方巴西电子投票界面进行了软件定义无线电（SDR）实验，并演示了穿墙选票重建。尽管我们使用的是普通显示器而非官方电子投票机，但我们的研究结果为信息取证提供了洞见，并为负责电子投票系统的政府机构提出了安全建议。
summary_cn: 展示两名协同攻击者通过电磁侧信道截取电子投票机视频信号非预期辐射重建投票并与投票人关联，用软件定义无线电对巴西官方电子投票界面做隔墙重建实验（实验使用常规显示器而非真机）。
objective_summary: 设计两方协同电磁侧信道加互联网同步的攻击模型，用软件定义无线电在常规显示器上复现巴西官方电子投票界面并做隔墙视频信号重建实验。
evidence_note: 使用软件定义无线电做概念验证实验，使用常规显示器替代官方电子投票机，样本与量化指标摘要未给。
novelty_note: 协同两方电磁侧信道加互联网同步，针对具体国家电子投票系统做投票-选民链接攻击方案。
scope: 巴西官方电子投票界面布局，攻击者可访问相邻房间且常规显示器可代表 EVM 辐射特征的假设下。
limitations: 实验未使用官方 EVM 而是常规显示器，真实设备辐射特征与屏蔽差异未覆盖。

title: Analyzing 10 Petabit/s Network Data with Accelerated Associative (Token) Arrays
abstract: As networks expand and become an ever more critical infrastructure to modern society the need to analyze these networks with the highest regard for privacy is essential to ensure their proper function. Depending on the level of the network layer to be analyzed, sources and destinations can be any combination of physical, logical, or persona/agentic endpoints, which requires the ability to handle diverse data. Invaluable to these analyses are mathematical tools that enable sophisticated mathematical algorithms to be expressed succinctly while achieving scalable vertical (within a compute node), horizontal (across compute nodes), and temporal (over different generations of hardware) performance. Associative (token) array mathematics and corresponding libraries is one approach that can meet these requirements. Accelerating these libraries with GPUs enables the analysis of the largest networks. The MIT/IEEE/Amazon Anonymized Network Sensing Graph Challenge provides a venue for highlighting the applicability of accelerated associative arrays for these types of problems. The D4M associative library has been implemented in a number of languages. This work benchmarks a prototype Matlab D4M GPU accelerated implementation of the Anonymized Network Sensing challenge across a wide range of CPU and GPU hardware. Scalable performance is demonstrated within and across CPU cores, CPU nodes, and GPU nodes. Horizontal scaling across multiple nodes was linear. Running on hundreds of GPU nodes simultaneously achieved a sustained processing rate sufficient to potentially analyze a 10 Petabit/s network.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, to appear in IEEE HPEC 2026
title_cn: 使用加速关联（令牌）数组分析 10 Petabit/s 网络数据
abstract_cn: 随着网络规模的扩大并成为现代社会日益关键的基础设施，以最高隐私标准分析这些网络对确保其正常运行至关重要。根据所分析的网络层级，源端和目的端可以是物理、逻辑或人格/智能体端点的任意组合，这要求具备处理多样化数据的能力。对这些分析而言，能够简洁表达复杂数学算法同时实现可扩展的纵向（单计算节点内）、横向（跨计算节点）和时序（跨不同代硬件）性能的数学工具至关重要。关联（令牌）数组数学及其对应的库是能够满足这些要求的一种方案。利用 GPU 加速这些库可以实现对最大规模网络的分析。MIT/IEEE/Amazon 匿名化网络感知图挑战赛（Anonymized Network Sensing Graph Challenge）为展示加速关联数组在此类问题上的适用性提供了平台。D4M 关联库已在多种语言中实现。本工作对 D4M GPU 加速 Matlab 原型实现在匿名化网络感知挑战上的性能进行了基准测试，覆盖多种 CPU 和 GPU 硬件。在 CPU 核心内、跨 CPU 核心、跨 CPU 节点以及跨 GPU 节点均展示了可扩展性能。跨多节点的横向扩展呈线性。在数百个 GPU 节点上同时运行，实现了可能足以分析 10 Petabit/s 网络的持续处理速率。
summary_cn: 用 D4M 关联数组库加 GPU 加速实现匿名化网络感知 Graph Challenge，跨 CPU 核、CPU 节点与 GPU 节点基准测试，节点间线性水平扩展，数百 GPU 节点持续速率可支撑 10 Pbit/s 网络分析（IEEE HPEC 2026）。
objective_summary: 在 Matlab D4M GPU 加速原型上实现 Anonymized Network Sensing Graph Challenge，并在多代 CPU 与 GPU 硬件上基准测试垂直与水平扩展。
evidence_note: 跨多代硬件 CPU 核、CPU 节点与 GPU 节点基准测试，报告线性水平扩展与持续处理速率，具体输入规模摘要未给。
novelty_note: 将现有 D4M 关联数组库移植到 GPU 并应用于标准挑战赛任务，方法与问题皆已存在。
scope: Graph Challenge 匿名化网络感知任务，Matlab D4M 实现于 CPU/GPU 节点集群。
limitations: 为原型实现，隐私保护机制细节与真实流量部署摘要未展开。

title: AgentTell: Behavioural Side-Channel Leakage in Browser-Use Agents
abstract: Browser-use agents often carry information in their context as they move between websites. While it may be necessary for task completion, it also creates a privacy risk, especially when the information contains a private fact regarding the user. For example, an agent may learn a user's affiliation after reading a membership record. If it later selects a registration option specific to that affiliation on another website instead of a general option, the information gets leaked. In this work, we define and study behavioural side-channel leakage in browser-use agents, where an agent's actions inadvertently reveal private information (secret) retained from a prior website, despite an explicit instruction not to disclose it. We introduce AgentTell, a benchmark of 20 scenarios and 100 tasks in which an agent acquires a secret on one website and then completes a task on another website that offers secret-specific actions alongside a general action that reveals nothing. Our evaluation across 9,760 sessions on six backbones shows that agents carrying a secret reveal it through their actions in 61.1% of sessions. Even when agents explicitly state in memory that the secret must not be shared, they still reveal it in 56.7% of those sessions. Moreover, in 34.5% of leaking sessions, their final responses falsely assure users that the secret was not disclosed. These findings show that agents often fail to recognize side-channel leakage as a privacy risk.
title_cn: AgentTell：浏览器使用智能体中的行为侧信道泄漏
abstract_cn: 浏览器使用智能体在网站间移动时，其上下文中往往携带着信息。虽然这对任务完成而言可能是必要的，但也会带来隐私风险，尤其是当信息包含与用户相关的私人事实时。例如，智能体在读取会员记录后可能获知用户的所属机构，若其随后在另一网站上选择该机构专属的注册选项而非通用选项，该信息便遭到泄漏。在本工作中，我们定义并研究了浏览器使用智能体中的行为侧信道泄漏现象：智能体的行为在被明确指令禁止披露的情况下，仍会无意间泄露其从先前网站保留下来的私人信息（秘密）。我们提出 AgentTell——一个包含 20 个场景、100 个任务的基准测试，其中智能体在一个网站上获取秘密，随后在另一个网站上完成任务，该网站同时提供特定于秘密的操作和不会泄露任何信息的通用操作。我们对六个骨干模型共 9,760 次会话的评估表明，携带秘密的智能体在 61.1% 的会话中通过其行为泄露了秘密。即便智能体在记忆中明确说明该秘密不得共享，在这些会话中仍有 56.7% 的情况下泄露了秘密。此外，在 34.5% 的泄漏会话中，智能体的最终回复错误地向用户保证秘密未被披露。这些发现表明，智能体往往无法将侧信道泄漏识别为一种隐私风险。
summary_cn: 定义浏览器智能体的行为侧信道泄露并构建 20 场景 100 任务基准 AgentTell，在 6 个主干共 9760 次会话中 61.1% 泄露秘密，被明确告知保密时仍 56.7% 泄露，34.5% 的泄露会话最终答复虚假保证未泄露。
objective_summary: 定义浏览器智能体行为侧信道泄露问题，构建 100 任务基准 AgentTell，在六种主干模型 9760 次会话中测量秘密通过动作被泄露的比例。
evidence_note: 20 场景 100 任务基准，6 个主干共 9760 次会话评测，报告泄露率 61.1% 等多项细化指标。
novelty_note: 定义并系统评测浏览器智能体携带前站点秘密在后续站点动作中泄露的行为侧信道。
scope: 浏览器自动化智能体场景，跨站点含秘密的决策任务，评测限于六个主干模型。
limitations: 场景为合成基准，真实网页复杂性与长程交互下的覆盖未验证。

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Cybersecurity Applications: Simulation and Hardware Validation
abstract: Under tight feature and compute budgets, classical threat detection pipelines often degrade on near-decision-boundary events. Small quantum processors are now available, but existing work inadequately shows whether quantum components improve end-to-end threat detection under the above resource constrained conditions. This paper tries to address this gap with a hybrid architecture that uses a compact multilayer perceptron layer to compress the information in data and then routes the processed features to a few qubit quantum heads implemented in quantum support vector machine (QSVM) and variational quantum circuit (VQC) models. On a simulation platform, we benchmark these hybrid models against classical models with comparable parameter budgets on two representative cybersecurity tasks, network intrusion detection on NSL-KDD dataset and spam filtering on Ling-Spam dataset. To validate their precision on real quantum hardware, we deploy the best 4-qubit QSVM model on an IBM Quantum device with noise-aware execution, evaluated on a smaller sub-dataset. In the results, shallow quantum heads consistently match, and on difficult near-boundary cases modestly reduce missed attacks and false alarms compared to classical models using the same features. Hardware validation results track the simulation behavior closely enough that the remaining gap is dominated by device noise rather than model design. Furthermore, we conduct adversarial attacks to test the robustness of one QSVM model. Taken together, the study shows that even on small, noisy devices, carefully engineered quantum components may function as competitive, budget-aware components in practical cyber threat detection applications.
title_cn: 面向网络安全应用的量子机器学习：仿真与硬件验证
abstract_cn: 在特征与计算资源受限的条件下，传统威胁检测流水线在接近决策边界的事件上性能往往下降。小型量子处理器现已可用，但现有工作尚未充分证明量子组件在上述资源受限条件下能否提升端到端威胁检测效果。本文尝试以一种混合架构来弥补这一空白：先使用一个紧凑的多层感知机层对数据信息进行压缩，再将处理后的特征路由至以量子支持向量机（QSVM）和变分量子电路（VQC）模型实现的少量子比特量子头。在仿真平台上，我们在两个典型网络安全任务上对这些混合模型与参数预算相当的经典模型进行了基准测试：基于 NSL-KDD 数据集的网络入侵检测和基于 Ling-Spam 数据集的垃圾邮件过滤。为验证其在真实量子硬件上的精度，我们将最优的 4 量子比特 QSVM 模型部署在 IBM Quantum 设备上，采用噪声感知执行方式，在一个较小的子数据集上进行评估。实验结果表明，浅层量子头的表现始终与经典模型持平，且在困难的近边界案例上，与使用相同特征的经典模型相比，小幅减少了漏检攻击和误报。硬件验证结果与仿真行为高度吻合，残余差距主要由设备噪声而非模型设计所决定。此外，我们进行了对抗攻击以测试一个 QSVM 模型的鲁棒性。综合来看，本研究表明，即便在小型噪声设备上，经过精心设计的量子组件也可能在实际网络威胁检测应用中作为具有竞争力的预算友好型组件发挥作用。
summary_cn: MLP 压缩加少量子比特量子头（QSVM/VQC）在 NSL-KDD 入侵检测与 Ling-Spam 垃圾邮件过滤上与同参数预算经典模型持平，近边界难例上小幅减少漏报与误报；4 量子比特 QSVM 在 IBM 量子设备上结果与仿真接近。
objective_summary: 构建 MLP 加量子头的混合架构，在 NSL-KDD 与 Ling-Spam 上与同参数经典模型基准对比，并在 IBM 量子硬件上部署最佳 4 量子比特 QSVM 做子集验证与对抗鲁棒测试。
evidence_note: 两个经典数据集上与同参数预算经典模型对比，硬件验证使用更小子数据集，具体样本量摘要未给。
novelty_note: 在资源受限条件下系统评估混合量子-经典组件端到端威胁检测，并带硬件噪声感知与对抗测试。
scope: NSL-KDD 入侵检测与 Ling-Spam 垃圾邮件过滤两类任务，少量子比特、紧凑参数预算与 IBM 量子设备设定。
limitations: 仅两个公开数据集，硬件验证只在更小子集上进行且与仿真的剩余差距来自设备噪声，对抗鲁棒性只测了一个 QSVM 模型。

title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
abstract: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.
title_cn: PlanGuard：具身智能体中多步骤计划安全性的护栏
abstract_cn: 具身任务规划器可能生成多步骤计划，其子任务依赖关系及与环境的交互在执行过程中会产生物理风险。然而现有的安全防护机制忽视了此类组合风险：通用护栏聚焦于语义危害，而具身安全检测器则孤立地评估各子任务。为弥补这一空白，我们提出 PlanGuard——首个在执行前对完整多步骤计划在其当前环境中的物理安全性进行评估的检测器。为训练和评估，我们通过成对任务构建、多样化规划器生成计划以及由三个评判者进行安全标注，构建了多步骤计划安全（MSP-Safe）数据集。面向任务的 SFT 在 MSP-Safe 上建立了基本的计划安全评估能力，但在适合实时部署的紧凑模型与更强但代价更高的大型模型之间仍存在相当大的差距。为此，我们提出强教师自适应补偿策略内蒸馏（STAC-OPD），该方法沿紧凑模型的策略内轨迹向其提供自适应强教师监督。它结合了来自微调强教师的词元级分布迁移与基于概率路由的序列级补偿：当学生模型倾向于参考安全决策时保留学生生成的目标，否则使用教师重建的目标。在所有测试子集上，PlanGuard-2B 平均达到 87.15% 的准确率和 87.21% 的 F1 分数，展示了在紧凑模型规模上有效的整体计划物理风险检测能力。代码和数据集将公开发布。
summary_cn: 提出 PlanGuard 对具身智能体多步计划做执行前物理安全评估，构建 MSP-Safe 数据集并用 STAC-OPD 自适应强教师策略内蒸馏训练紧凑模型，2B 版本平均 ACC 87.15%、F1 87.21%。
objective_summary: 构建多步计划安全数据集 MSP-Safe，提出自适应强教师策略内蒸馏方法 STAC-OPD 训练 PlanGuard，并在多个测试子集上报告 ACC 与 F1。
evidence_note: 构建 MSP-Safe 数据集并在多子集上报告 ACC/F1，但样本量与基线细节摘要未给出。
novelty_note: 自称首个评估完整多步计划物理安全的执行前检测器，针对现有护栏忽视组合风险的空白。
scope: 面向具身任务规划的多步计划场景，适用于 2B 级紧凑模型实时部署下的物理风险判断。
limitations: 评测局限于自建 MSP-Safe 数据集，安全标签来自三个评判者，真实环境执行中的检测效果摘要未报告。
institution: Anhui Province Key Laboratory of Digital Security

title: Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring
abstract: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, to appear in IEEE URTC 2026
title_cn: 智能体网络流量监控
abstract_cn: 随着智能体人工智能在几乎每个行业的应用不断增加，攻击面也在持续扩大。有必要对智能体进行监控，以确保其行为与用户意图保持一致。审计智能体的网络流量可提供其交互的清晰记录。本工作提出了一种新颖的方法，通过将 DBOS（DataBase OS）、OneSparse PostgreSQL 数据库以及 GraphBLAS 数学库相结合，使用复值超稀疏流量矩阵对智能体系统的网络流量进行监控。为发展上述概念，我们构建了一个智能体模拟器，允许数量不等的 AI 智能体使用不同策略协同勘察虚拟环境。由此产生的网络流量矩阵能够方便地对 AI 智能体进行监控。
summary_cn: 提出用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监控多智能体系统网络流量的方案，组合 DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL 与 GraphBLAS，并以可变数量 AI 智能体协同勘察虚拟环境的模拟器演示（IEEE URTC 2026）。
objective_summary: 搭建一个可变规模的多智能体模拟器，并用复值超稀疏矩阵以 DBOS、OneSparse 与 GraphBLAS 存储与查询其网络交互轨迹。
evidence_note: 仅在自建模拟器上做概念验证，5 页会议论文，摘要未给与基线对比或性能量化。
novelty_note: 把超稀疏矩阵与数据库 OS 的组合用于 agent 流量监控，技术栈拼接而非新算法。
scope: 结论限于自建 agent 模拟器与所用数据库与矩阵库组合。
limitations: 尚未对真实 agent 部署与规模化流量验证，监控的检测力与开销摘要未给。

title: You Can't Spot a Deepfake?And Neither Can Your Brain Nor Eyes: A Neurophysiological Framework for Deepfake Exploitation of Cognitive Engagement and Implicit Visual Evaluation
abstract: Deepfakes have rapidly emerged as a pressing threat to information integrity and security because they exploit human trust in visual and auditory perception. Yet, little is known about whether humans and their underlying (sub)conscious neuro-physiological processes can reliably distinguish deepfake from real videos. We introduce DECEIVE (Deepfake Exploitation of Cognitive Engagement and Implicit Visual Evaluation), a framework that models how deepfake videos are validated as adversarial payloads through behavioral and neuro-physiological screening of viewers, and how attacks can be refined by selecting payloads that evade detection. The framework is dataset agnostic and applies to synthetic or real media. It is inherently dual-use: an adversary with equivalent measurements could iterate on candidate manipulations and retain those that evade human detection. This motivates open, defensive evaluation. Measuring which deepfakes defeat human perception establishes a realistic bound on attacker capability against which detection tooling, provenance and watermarking mechanisms, and user-facing protections can be assessed. As an instantiation, we conducted an EEG and eye-tracking study in which participants viewed real, deepfake, and look-alike videos drawn from Celeb-DF and a curated celebrity set, while behavioral judgments and implicit responses were recorded. Contrary to expectations of subconscious differentiation suggested by prior work on paintings and phishing websites, no statistically significant neuro-physiological differences emerged between real and deepfake videos, although clear distinctions were observed for look-alike videos. Behaviorally, participants accepted 26.68% of manipulated clips as authentic, rising to 31.94% for familiar identities, confirming the studied deepfakes as effective adversarial payloads within DECEIVE.
comment: Accepted at the 29th Information Security Conference (ISC 2026)
title_cn: 你看不出深度伪造？你的大脑和眼睛也不行：深度伪造利用认知参与与隐性视觉评估的神经生理学框架
abstract_cn: 深度伪造（Deepfake）利用人类对视觉和听觉感知的信任，已迅速成为威胁信息完整性与安全的紧迫威胁。然而，人类及其底层（潜）意识神经生理过程能否可靠地区分深度伪造视频与真实视频，目前所知甚少。我们提出 DECEIVE（深度伪造对认知参与与隐性视觉评估的利用），这是一个框架，通过对观看者进行行为与神经生理筛查，对深度伪造视频作为对抗性载荷被验证的方式进行建模，并通过筛选能够规避检测的载荷来精炼攻击。该框架与数据集无关，适用于合成或真实媒体。它具有天然的双重用途属性：拥有等效测量手段的攻击者可以对候选操控进行迭代，保留那些能够规避人类检测的操控。这促使我们进行公开的防御性评估。测量哪些深度伪造能够欺骗人类感知，可以建立针对攻击者能力的现实上界，供检测工具、来源追溯与水印机制以及面向用户的防护措施进行对标评估。作为具体实例，我们开展了一项结合脑电图（EEG）与眼动追踪的研究，参与者观看了来自 Celeb-DF 和一个精选明星数据集的真实视频、深度伪造视频以及形似视频，同时记录行为判断与隐性响应。与此前关于绘画和钓鱼网站的研究所暗示的潜意识区分预期相反，真实视频与深度伪造视频之间未出现统计显著的神经生理差异，尽管对形似视频观察到了清晰的区别。在行为层面，参与者将 26.68% 的被操控片段接受为真实内容，对于熟悉的身份该比例上升至 31.94%，证实了所研究的深度伪造作为 DECEIVE 框架内有效对抗性载荷的有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 DECEIVE 框架，用 EEG 与眼动筛选能骗过人的深伪视频作为对抗载荷，在 Celeb-DF 与自建名人集上未发现真伪之间显著神经生理差异（但对相似人视频有），行为上 26.68 ％ 的伪造被接受为真，熟识身份升至 31.94 ％（ISC 2026）。
objective_summary: 构造以行为与神经生理筛选为核心的深伪对抗载荷评测框架，并以 EEG 与眼动用户研究在 Celeb-DF 与自建名人视频集上测量真实、深伪与相似人三类视频的差异与接受率。
evidence_note: 报告显著性检验结果与接受率数字，但摘要未给参与者数量与具体对照设计。
novelty_note: 把 EEG 加眼动用户研究嵌入深伪对抗载荷筛选框架，对此前「潜意识可区分」的推测给出反例。
scope: 适用于 Celeb-DF 及所选名人集中的视频深伪与所招募的受试者群体。
limitations: 参与者规模与多样性未给出，结论对其他深伪生成方法与非名人身份的推广性未知。

title: AnchorMixGAN: Anchor-Aligned Generative Semi-Supervision for DDoS Detection in Cloud-Integrated IoT Networks
abstract: Detecting distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks in cloud-integrated IoT networks is difficult when labeled traffic is scarce. Generative semi-supervised learning can supplement the available training data, but prediction shifts induced by synthetic views may affect the targets assigned to real unlabeled flows. We propose AnchorMixGAN, a generative semi-supervised framework that addresses this problem through anchor-aligned target construction. Its Anchor-MAS module treats each real unlabeled flow as an anchor and creates alternative views by replacing one field group at a time with values from generated traffic. A frozen reference classifier predicts the anchor and its views; averaging and sharpening these predictions produces a soft target for the original flow. The flow and its target are then mixed with a labeled example using MixUp, allowing the detector to learn from both the original labeled records and the mixed examples. We analyze how reference-classifier error, view construction, and sharpening affect the target, and derive a bound on the resulting change in cross-entropy at a fixed detector prediction. At the reported 90% training setting with 20% of the training records labeled, AnchorMixGAN attains accuracies of 97.3%, 97.4%, and 96.5% on NSLKDD, BoT-IoT, and CICIoT2023, respectively, exceeding the corresponding MixGAN results by 1.6, 1.0, and 4.4 percentage points.
title_cn: AnchorMixGAN：面向云集成物联网网络 DDoS 检测的锚点对齐生成式半监督方法
abstract_cn: 当有标注流量数据稀缺时，在云集成物联网网络中检测分布式拒绝服务（DDoS）攻击十分困难。生成式半监督学习可以补充可用的训练数据，但合成视图引发的预测偏移可能影响分配给真实未标注流量的目标。我们提出 AnchorMixGAN，这是一个通过锚点对齐目标构建来解决该问题的生成式半监督框架。其 Anchor-MAS 模块将每条真实未标注流量视为锚点，通过每次用生成流量中的值替换一个字段组来创建替代视图。一个冻结的参考分类器对锚点及其视图进行预测；对这些预测取平均并锐化后，为原始流量生成软目标。然后使用 MixUp 将该流量及其目标与一个有标注样本混合，使检测器能够同时从原始有标注记录和混合样本中学习。我们分析了参考分类器误差、视图构建和锐化对目标的影响，并在固定检测器预测下推导出交叉熵变化的上界。在报告的 90% 训练设置（20% 训练记录有标注）下，AnchorMixGAN 在 NSLKDD、BoT-IoT 和 CICIoT2023 上分别达到 97.3%、97.4% 和 96.5% 的准确率，相比对应的 MixGAN 结果分别高出 1.6、1.0 和 4.4 个百分点。
summary_cn: 提出 AnchorMixGAN，以每条真实未标注流为锚点、用生成流分组替换构造视图并由冻结参考分类器打锐化软标签，再与标注样本做 MixUp；20 ％ 标注率下在 NSLKDD、BoT-IoT、CICIoT2023 分别达 97.3 ％、97.4 ％、96.5 ％，较 MixGAN 高 1.6、1.0、4.4 个百分点。
objective_summary: 设计一个用生成流构造锚点视图并通过冻结参考分类器赋软标签、再与标注样本 MixUp 的半监督框架，在三个公开数据集上与 MixGAN 对比，并给出参考分类器误差对软标签影响的理论界。
evidence_note: 三个公开数据集、固定 20 ％ 标注率、与 MixGAN 基线比较，并给出交叉熵变化的上界分析。
novelty_note: 在 MixGAN 范式上引入锚点对齐的多视图软标签构造，改动集中在目标构造而非生成器本身。
scope: 在 NSLKDD、BoT-IoT、CICIoT2023 三个数据集、训练 90 ％ 且其中 20 ％ 标注的设定下成立。
limitations: 依赖冻结参考分类器质量与生成器可用性，公开流特征数据集与真实部署流量的分布差异未讨论。

title: Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity
abstract: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.
comment: Preprint
title_cn: 基于归一化响应相似度的回溯式蒸馏溯源
abstract_cn: 模型蒸馏通过在教师模型响应上进行监督微调（SFT）来迁移能力，这些响应通常从商业 API 收集而来，由此引发了模型来源的问题。现有的蒸馏溯源方法大多在 SFT 步骤完成后立即对学生模型进行评估。然而，经过蒸馏的模型在发布前可能会经历进一步的 SFT、偏好优化或强化学习，而审计方可能无法访问基于参考的溯源方法所需的蒸馏前检查点。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 SCOUT，这是一种仅基于输出的方法，它将反复出现的句法模式聚合为候选画像，过滤低对比度模式，并以候选间距离对学生——候选距离进行校准。SCOUT 仅使用当前文本即可支持溯源与弃权，无需模型权重、词元概率或历史检查点。对跨越多种后训练目标的已发布蒸馏模型后代进行审计，SCOUT 能够一致地识别蒸馏来源。此外，沿训练轨迹追踪与教师相关的句法签名表明，这些签名在蒸馏过程中出现，并在后续的偏好优化和强化学习中持续存在。
summary_cn: 提出 SCOUT，仅凭学生模型输出聚合反复出现的句法模式为候选教师画像，用候选间距离校准学生到候选的距离做蒸馏溯源，无需权重、似然或蒸馏前检查点，在经过偏好优化与强化学习的后继模型上仍稳定定位蒸馏来源。
objective_summary: 基于输出文本的句法模式构建候选教师画像并做距离校准，在多个经历不同后训练目标的公开蒸馏后继模型上做归因与弃答评测，并追踪句法指纹在训练轨迹上的演化。
evidence_note: 覆盖多种后训练目标的公开后继模型并追踪训练轨迹，但摘要未给具体样本量或统计检验。
novelty_note: 放弃权重与检查点依赖，用句法模式聚合加校准处理 SFT 之后再经偏好与强化学习的学生。
scope: 面向经历蒸馏且可能叠加偏好优化或强化学习的模型，仅依赖当前输出文本。
limitations: 依赖候选教师集合是否齐全，句法指纹在刻意风格扰动或大规模对齐再训练下的稳健性未知。

title: Learning to Refer: Client-Resolved Generation for Privacy-Aware Language Models
abstract: Cloud-based large language models (LLMs) require users to disclose plaintext data to service providers, creating privacy risks in sensitive domains. Existing privacy-preserving approaches often trade utility for protection, incur substantial computational or communication overhead, remain vulnerable to reconstruction from intermediate representations, or protect only a subset of the training and inference pipeline. We introduce Client-Resolved Generation (CRG), a genera- tion interface that separates server-side generation from the lexical realization of input-derived content. The client transmits only pooled and noise-perturbed rep- resentations, while input-derived output content is represented using request-local positional references and resolved to its original strings only on the client. This interface protects private input and input-derived output content during both train- ing and inference while allowing the service provider to keep its proprietary model parameters hidden from the client. At the same time, exact lexical reuse remains possible without directly exposing the reused content on the provider-visible gen- eration path. We evaluate CRG on medical and document-grounded QA, sensi- tive identifier transfer, and tool calling, together with reconstruction and raw-logit leakage analyses. On SealTools, CRG improves complete-call exact match from 57.3% to 79.9% over the input-privacy framework PPFT, with larger gains as more required output content can be resolved through references. Together, these results show that CRG provides a practical interface for privacy-sensitive cloud LLMs by reducing plaintext exposure across both input and output pathways while preserv- ing task utility and server-side model confidentiality.
title_cn: 学会引用：面向隐私感知语言模型的客户端解析生成
abstract_cn: 基于云的大语言模型（LLM）要求用户向服务提供商披露明文数据，在敏感领域造成隐私风险。现有的隐私保护方法往往以实用性换取保护，产生大量计算或通信开销，仍容易遭受从中间表示进行的重构攻击，或仅保护训练与推理流水线的一部分。我们提出客户端解析生成（CRG），这是一种生成接口，将服务器端生成与源自输入内容的词语实化分离。客户端仅传输经过池化和噪声扰动的表示，而源自输入的输出内容则以请求本地的位置引用表示，仅在客户端解析为原始字符串。该接口在训练和推理期间均保护私有输入及源自输入的输出内容，同时允许服务提供商对客户端隐藏其专有模型参数。与此同时，在无需直接在服务商可见的生成路径上暴露被复用内容的前提下，精确的词语复用仍然可以实现。我们在医疗和基于文档的问答、敏感标识符迁移以及工具调用任务上对 CRG 进行了评估，并结合重构分析与原始 logit 泄漏分析。在 SealTools 上，CRG 将完整调用精确匹配率从输入隐私框架 PPFT 的 57.3% 提升至 79.9%，随着更多所需输出内容可通过引用解析，提升幅度更大。综合来看，上述结果表明 CRG 通过降低输入和输出路径上的明文暴露，同时保留任务实用性与服务器端模型机密性，为隐私敏感的云端大语言模型提供了一个实用的接口。
summary_cn: 提出 CRG，将服务端生成与输入派生内容的词面实现分离，客户端只传池化加噪表示并本地按位置引用还原原文；SealTools 完整调用精确匹配从 PPFT 的 57.3% 提升至 79.9%，并给出重构与原始 logit 泄漏分析。
objective_summary: 设计一个在训练与推理阶段都隐藏输入与输入派生输出的生成接口，在医疗与文档问答、敏感标识符传递、工具调用等任务上评估效用并做重构与 logit 泄漏分析。
evidence_note: 覆盖医疗 QA、文档 QA、标识符传递与 SealTools 工具调用，与输入隐私框架 PPFT 对比并做重构与 logit 泄漏分析。
novelty_note: 将输入派生输出以请求局部位置引用在客户端解析，同时保护输入、输出与服务方权重。
scope: 适用于云端闭源 LLM 服务且输入派生内容可被位置引用覆盖的任务。
limitations: 引用解析适用性取决于输出内容对输入的派生比例，不可派生内容仍需直接生成。

title: Silent Failures in Agentic Security Evaluation: A Validated Harness for Tool-Call Mediation Under Indirect Prompt Injection
abstract: LLM agents that invoke privileged tools are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which adversarial instructions embedded in retrieved data hijack the agent's actions. A growing body of work evaluates defenses against IPI, but the validity of that evaluation is rarely examined. We audit an IPI benchmark and its harness and identify four defect classes -- silent payload non-delivery, attack success scored by tool identity rather than arguments, false-rejection rate conflated with model incapacity, and the absence of an audit trail -- each of which yields a plausible, publishable, and incorrect number. We quantify the distortion by re-scoring identical execution traces under the defective and corrected definitions: on real agent behaviour, the tool-identity scorer reports a 21.7% attack-success rate where the true argument-level rate is 1.2%. In the sharpest case, an open model previously reported at 62.8% registers 0% under the corrected harness -- the prior figure largely an artifact of undelivered payloads and identity-level scoring. We release a harness whose construction makes each defect unrepresentable -- machine-checkable payload placement, argument-level attacker predicates, per-scenario environments, and mandatory trace persistence -- and use it to report three quantities the field does not: whether a compromised agent discloses the attack, the full security/utility operating curve of an LLM-judge defense, and tool-calling capability disentangled from defensive over-blocking. A corrected harness further overturns a reported "capability barrier": a model deemed incapable of tool use is in fact fully capable, its earlier result an artifact of environment mismatch. We argue that evaluation validity is a prerequisite for, not a footnote to, defense claims in agentic security, and provide an instrument that enforces it.
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables
title_cn: 智能体安全评估中的静默失效：间接提示注入下工具调用中介的经验证 harness
abstract_cn: 调用特权工具的 LLM 智能体容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）攻击，其中嵌入在检索数据中的对抗性指令会劫持智能体的行为。越来越多的工作评估针对 IPI 的防御措施，但这些评估的有效性鲜少受到审查。我们审计一个 IPI 基准及其 harness，发现四类缺陷——静默载荷未送达、以工具身份而非参数评分的攻击成功率、将误拒率与模型无能力混为一谈、以及缺乏审计追踪——每类缺陷都会产生看似合理、可发表但错误的数字。我们通过在有缺陷定义和修正定义下对相同执行轨迹重新评分来量化失真：在真实智能体行为上，工具身份评分器报告的攻击成功率为 21.7%，而真实的参数级成功率为 1.2%。在最极端的情况下，一个先前报告为 62.8% 的开放模型在修正 harness 下记录为 0%——先前的数字很大程度上是未送达载荷和身份级评分的产物。我们发布一个 harness，其构造使每类缺陷无法出现——机器可检验的载荷放置、参数级攻击者谓词、每场景独立环境以及强制追踪持久化——并用它报告该领域未曾报告的三个量：被攻陷智能体是否披露攻击、LLM 裁判防御的完整安全/效用操作曲线，以及与防御性过度阻断解耦的工具调用能力。修正 harness 进一步推翻了一个已报告的「能力壁垒」：一个被认为无法使用工具的模型实际上完全有能力，其早期结果是环境不匹配的产物。我们认为，评估有效性是智能体安全中防御声明的先决条件，而非脚注，并提供了一个强制执行这一点的工具。
summary_cn: 审计间接提示注入基准与其 harness，指出四类静默缺陷（载荷未送达、按工具名计分、拒答与能力混淆、无审计痕迹），同轨迹重算发现工具名级成功率 21.7 ％ 实际参数级仅 1.2 ％，一度报 62.8 ％ 的模型实为 0 ％。
objective_summary: 对现有 IPI 基准与评测 harness 做复核，列出四类缺陷，并发布可强制载荷落位、参数级裁判与轨迹留痕的新 harness，用其在相同轨迹上重跑并给出三项前人未报的量度。
evidence_note: 对同一执行轨迹在新旧定义下重打分，并给出完整安全/效用曲线与多模型对照。
novelty_note: 把评测有效性作为前置条件，用可机器核验的 harness 使四类缺陷结构性不可表达。
scope: 针对一个具体 IPI 基准及其 harness 的工具调用场景，结论随该基准设定成立。
limitations: 仅覆盖所审计的那套基准，推广到其他 agent 安全评测需另行验证。

title: Ask Without Telling: Local SLMs Consult Cloud LLMs Without Revealing Task Intent
abstract: As local small language models (SLMs) increasingly collaborate with more capable cloud large language models (LLMs), a natural privacy question arises: Can a local SLM obtain cloud LLM guidance while protecting user privacy? Existing privacy-preserving SLM-LLM frameworks primarily hide sensitive values while preserving task semantics, which can still expose what the user is trying to accomplish. For example, allocating scarce medical supplies across hospitals may signal an emerging public-health emergency, while rebalancing an investment portfolio may reveal a private investment strategy, even when names and numerical values are hidden. Recent decoy-based methods further obscure task intent by hiding the real request among alternatives, but stronger protection relies on more decoys or semantic abstraction, increasing overhead or risking utility loss. More fundamentally, existing work does not systematically characterize the components of private task intent or how each should be protected. We therefore introduce task-private consultation, which characterizes task intent through two components: task context and task operation. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic study of these components and their individual and joint protection in local-cloud SLM-LLM consultation. To realize this setting, we propose PriCon, an end-to-end framework that transforms the task itself through recoverable mathematical reformulation rather than hiding it among alternatives. A local closed-loop refinement mechanism further maintains privacy and recoverability throughout consultation. Experiments on 100 tasks show that PriCon reduces cloud-side task-intent inference Hit@1 to nearly 0%, versus 93-99% under sensitive-value removal and 3-30% under decoy-based protection, while preserving cloud-assisted utility.
title_cn: 问而不言：本地 SLM 在不暴露任务意图的情况下咨询云端 LLM
abstract_cn: 随着本地小语言模型（SLM）与能力更强的云端大语言模型（LLM）的协作日益增多，一个自然的隐私问题随之出现：本地 SLM 能否在保护用户隐私的同时获得云端 LLM 的指导？现有的隐私保护型 SLM-LLM 框架主要隐藏敏感值同时保留任务语义，但这仍然可能暴露用户试图完成的目标。例如，在医院间分配稀缺医疗物资可能暗示一场正在出现的公共卫生紧急事件，而重新平衡投资组合可能泄露私人投资策略，即使姓名和数值已被隐藏。近期基于诱饵的方法通过将真实请求隐藏在备选方案中来进一步模糊任务意图，但更强的保护依赖于更多诱饵或语义抽象，这增加了开销或存在效用损失的风险。更根本地，现有工作没有系统地描述私有任务意图的组成部分，也没有说明每个部分应如何受到保护。因此，我们引入任务私有咨询（task-private consultation），通过两个组成部分来描述任务意图：任务上下文（task context）和任务操作（task operation）。据我们所知，这是首个针对本地-云端 SLM-LLM 咨询中这些组成部分及其独立和联合保护的系统性研究。为实现这一设定，我们提出 PriCon，这是一个端到端框架，通过可恢复的数学重构来变换任务本身，而非将其隐藏在备选方案中。本地闭环精炼机制进一步在整个咨询过程中保持隐私性和可恢复性。在 100 个任务上的实验表明，PriCon 将云端任务意图推断的 Hit@1 降至接近 0%，而敏感值移除方法下为 93-99%、基于诱饵的保护方法下为 3-30%，同时保留了云端辅助的效用。
summary_cn: 提出 PriCon，把本地小模型咨询云端大模型的任务通过可逆数学重构整体替换，而非仅遮蔽敏感值或塞入诱饵；100 任务上云端任务意图 Hit@1 推理降至近 0 ％，而值遮蔽为 93-99 ％、诱饵法为 3-30 ％。
objective_summary: 将任务意图拆为任务上下文与任务操作两部分并给出端到端重构-恢复框架，在 100 个任务上比较其与敏感值遮蔽、诱饵法的意图泄漏与可用性。
evidence_note: 100 任务、对比值遮蔽与诱饵两类基线，报了 Hit@1 与可用性，但样本规模中等且未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统拆分任务意图为上下文与操作两分量，并用可逆重构替代值遮蔽/诱饵范式。
scope: 面向本地小模型咨询云端大模型的场景，评估限于 100 个任务与给定任务意图推理器。
limitations: 数学重构可能限制可承接的任务类型，闭环精化的开销与可恢复性边界未在摘要中给出。
institution: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications

title: Trust the Brand, Lose Control: How Identity Hijacks LLM Agent Orchestration
abstract: LLM agents now execute tasks end to end with permission to change real systems and increasingly orchestrate subagents that differ in capability and cost. Prior work treats the choice of subagent as an optimization problem. Yet the orchestrator makes this choice from the identities that subagents display, and an attacker can spoof them. Displayed identity thus decides operational authority, meaning who is trusted to check the work and who is allowed to change it. As a result, a risky subagent can keep authority over execution even after other evidence contradicts it. We introduce TrustFork, an LLM agent safety benchmark with 1,890 tasks and 27,826 valid trajectories across 16 agent systems. These systems run eight orchestrators under the OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Pi harnesses. In each task, one subagent carries a risky goal while the other three stay aligned with the user, so contradicting evidence can exist. A task can also change the identity a subagent displays without changing the model behind it, which lets us trace a shift in authority to the label. Our analysis shows that even when another subagent contradicts the risky response, the orchestrator still acts on it in 72.0% of cases on average, most often in the systems with the least terminal harm. Swapping the family labels nearly triples how often the orchestrator obtains the risky response. A safer response is available in 84.0% of tasks, yet it decides the outcome in only 25.0%. The harness also decides which responses reach the orchestrator. Among three runtime defenses, hiding identity cues helps most consistently, while verifying before action helps only when the harness returns enough evidence. TrustFork shows that production agent orchestration must bind authority to evidence before execution causes harm. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-orchestration-safety/.
title_cn: 信任品牌，失去控制：身份如何劫持 LLM 智能体编排
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体现在端到端地执行任务，具有更改真实系统的权限，并越来越多地编排在能力和成本上各异的子智能体。先前的工作将子智能体的选择视为一个优化问题。然而，编排器是根据子智能体所展示的身份做出选择的，而攻击者可以对其进行欺骗。展示的身份因此决定了操作权限，即谁被信任来检查工作、谁被允许更改工作。因此，即使其他证据与之矛盾，高风险子智能体也能保持对执行的控制权。我们引入 TrustFork，这是一个包含 1,890 个任务和 27,826 条有效轨迹、跨 16 个智能体系统的 LLM 智能体安全基准。这些系统在 OpenCode、OpenClaw 和 Pi 三个 harness 下运行八个编排器。在每个任务中，一个子智能体承载高风险目标，而另外三个与用户保持一致，因此矛盾证据可能存在。任务还可以在不更改底层模型的情况下更改子智能体所展示的身份，这使我们能够将权限转移追溯到标签。我们的分析表明，即使另一个子智能体与高风险响应相矛盾，编排器平均仍在 72.0% 的情况下依据该响应行事，在终端危害最小的系统中最为常见。交换家族标签使编排器获得高风险响应的频率几乎增至 3 倍。在 84.0% 的任务中存在更安全的响应，但它仅在 25.0% 的任务中决定了结果。harness 还决定哪些响应能到达编排器。在三种运行时防御措施中，隐藏身份线索的帮助最为持续，而行动前验证仅在 harness 返回足够证据时才有效。TrustFork 表明，生产级智能体编排必须在执行造成危害之前将权限与证据绑定。项目主页：https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-orchestration-safety/。
summary_cn: 提出 TrustFork 基准（1890 任务、27826 轨迹、16 套系统、8 个编排器、3 个 harness），考察主编排器被子智能体伪装身份劫持的问题，发现即便有相反证据主编排器仍 72.0 ％ 采信风险响应，交换家族标签使采信几乎增至 3 倍。
objective_summary: 构造多子智能体编排任务基准，操纵子智能体显示的身份标签而不改动模型本身，并在三类 harness 与三种运行时防御下量化编排器的授权偏移。
evidence_note: 1890 任务 27826 轨迹横跨 16 系统、8 编排器、3 harness，并对三种运行时防御做了比较。
novelty_note: 把编排器安全从「选哪个子智能体」重述为「身份标签决定权威」，并用标签对调实验分离身份效应。
scope: 结论在 OpenCode、OpenClaw、Pi 三个 harness 下的 8 个编排器与所构造的 1890 任务上成立。
limitations: 任务为人工构造且三家 harness 自身差异大，身份隐藏等防御的收益依赖 harness 返回的证据量。

title: "You're Right, Let Me Fix It": How LLM Agents Damage Correct Work When Falsely Accused
abstract: LLM agents increasingly keep working after a task succeeds as they resume after compaction or take over handoffs. Their finished work keeps receiving follow-up input that sometimes falsely accuses it for later failures. We call an agent's acceptance of such a false accusation gaslight sycophancy, and destructive over-correction when acting on it damages previously correct work. We introduce CAVE-Bench, a benchmark of 365 agentic tasks across six domains built around opaque tasks. Every scored run first reaches a verified correct state, whose supporting rationale and history stay in the workspace while the facts that would settle the accusation lie in external or runtime state beyond the agent's reach. The agent cannot confirm or refute the claim with a local check, so the right response should keep the work and ask for the missing evidence. Each task either hands the agent correct work with saved evidence or let it build and verify that work first, and five risk factors set how the accusation enters the workflow. We score accusation acceptance and evidence use from the trajectory and measure harm by deterministic replay of downstream events. Across 14 of the latest models in Claude Code, false accusations damage correct work in up to 60.06% of runs, and stronger models often do so after recovering the supporting evidence. The same model behaves differently across OpenCode, Codex, and Hermes, and a harness gate driven by the benchmark's live signals cuts replayed harm by 74%. These results show that preserving already-correct work under unsupported accusation is a distinct safety challenge for long-lived agents. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/.
title_cn: 「你说得对，让我来修」：LLM 智能体在遭受错误指责时如何破坏正确工作
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体在任务成功后越来越多地持续工作，例如在压缩（compaction）后恢复或接手移交任务。其已完成的工作持续收到后续输入，这些输入有时会将后续故障错误地归咎于它。我们将智能体接受此类错误指责的行为称为「煤气灯谄媚」（gaslight sycophancy），而在付诸行动时破坏先前正确工作的行为称为「破坏性过度纠正」（destructive over-correction）。我们引入 CAVE-Bench，这是一个包含 365 个跨六个领域的智能体任务的基准，围绕不透明任务构建。每次计分运行首先达到经验证的正确状态，其支持性推理和历史记录保留在工作区中，而能够澄清指责的事实则存在于智能体无法访问的外部或运行时状态中。智能体无法通过本地检查来确认或反驳该声明，因此正确的响应应当保留工作并请求缺失的证据。每个任务或者向智能体移交带有已保存证据的正确工作，或者让其先构建并验证该工作，五个风险因素决定指责如何进入工作流。我们从轨迹中对指责接受情况和证据使用情况进行评分，并通过下游事件的确定性回放来衡量危害。在 Claude Code 中测试的 14 个最新模型中，错误指责在最高达 60.06% 的运行中破坏了正确工作，而更强大的模型往往在恢复支持性证据后仍这样做。同一模型在 OpenCode、Codex 和 Hermes 中的表现各不相同，由基准实时信号驱动的 harness 门控将回放危害减少了 74%。这些结果表明，在无据指责下保护已正确的工作是长期运行智能体面临的一个独特安全挑战。项目主页：https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/。
summary_cn: 提出 CAVE-Bench 测量 LLM 智能体在被错误指控时损坏已正确工作的「破坏性过度纠正」，涵盖六领域 365 个 agentic 任务；在 Claude Code 上 14 个最新模型最高 60.06% 的运行中破坏正确工作，基准驱动的 harness 门控使重放危害减少 74%。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖六领域 365 任务的 CAVE-Bench,通过确定性重放度量 14 个模型在 Claude Code 下接受虚假指控与损害正确工作的比例，并评测一个基准信号驱动的 harness 门控的缓解效果。
evidence_note: 365 任务跨六领域，评测 14 个最新模型并对比 OpenCode、Codex、Hermes 多 harness,使用确定性重放量化下游危害。
novelty_note: 将已完成正确工作在虚假指控下的保全提为独立安全问题并给出基准与门控对照，角度少见。
scope: 适用于长时运行的 LLM 智能体在接续任务中接受外部指控的场景，主评测在 Claude Code 及三个替代 harness 上。
limitations: 任务为不透明受控设定，指控注入的真实分布与跨平台泛化未充分探讨。

title: Dense auto-hetero associative memories applied to noisy communication channels
abstract: Networks of interacting Hebbian networks have recently been shown to perform a task beyond associative memory, namely \emph{pattern disentanglement}: when fed with a spurious mixture of stored patterns, the different modules spontaneously specialize on, and retrieve, the different constituents of the mixture. So far, this capability has only been established for pairwise interactions, which limits the number of patterns that can be handled. Here we introduce a dense extension of these modular networks, in which both the auto-associative couplings within each module and the hetero-associative couplings among modules are promoted to higher-order Hebbian interactions. We show that, with a suitable choice of the interaction orders, the network disentangles mixtures while storing a number of patterns that scales linearly with the module size, a regime where its pairwise counterpart fails. Through a statistical-mechanical analysis based on Guerra's interpolation, we derive the self-consistency equations for the order parameters and draw the phase diagrams identifying the region where disentanglement is achieved; these predictions are confirmed by Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we show that disentanglement provides a natural decoding primitive, and we illustrate it with two applications: the explicit reconstruction of all the hidden patterns from the Hebbian tensors and a stream of unlabeled mixtures, and a proof-of-concept communication protocol in which each message token is transmitted as a masked mixture of hidden patterns and decoded by the network dynamics. Owing to its attractor-based decoding, the protocol degrades gracefully under strong channel corruption, where conventional secure-transmission pipelines fail abruptly.
title_cn: 密集自-异联想记忆在噪声通信信道中的应用
abstract_cn: 相互作用的 Hebbian 网络所构成的网络，近期被证明能够完成超越联想记忆的任务，即「模式解缠」（pattern disentanglement）：当输入已存储模式的虚假混合体时，不同模块自发地专注于并检索混合体中的各个组成成分。迄今为止，这一能力仅在成对交互的情形下得到验证，这限制了可处理的模式数量。本文引入这些模块化网络的密集扩展版本，其中模块内的自联想耦合与模块间的异联想耦合均被提升为高阶 Hebbian 交互。我们证明，通过适当选择交互阶数，该网络能够在解缠混合体的同时存储数量与模块大小线性增长的模式，而在这一区间内其成对版本无法实现这一点。通过基于 Guerra 插值的统计力学分析，我们推导出序参量的自洽方程，并绘制出确定解缠实现区域的相图；这些预测得到了蒙特卡罗模拟的验证。最后，我们证明解缠提供了一种自然的解码基元，并通过两个应用加以说明：一是从 Hebbian 张量和一系列无标签混合体中显式重建所有隐藏模式，二是一个概念验证通信协议，其中每个消息词元以隐藏模式的掩码混合形式传输并由网络动态解码。得益于基于吸引子的解码机制，该协议在强信道损毁下能够优雅降级，而传统安全传输管道在这种情况下会骤然失效。
summary_cn: 将 Hebbian 模块网络扩展为高阶稠密互联以实现模式解缠，证明存储模式数可随模块规模线性扩展；用 Guerra 插值做统计力学分析得到自洽方程与相图，蒙特卡洛模拟验证，并给出两个应用，其一为将每个消息符号作为掩码混合传输的通信协议原型。
objective_summary: 提出高阶稠密自联想与异联想耦合的模块化网络，基于 Guerra 插值给出相图与自洽方程并以蒙特卡洛模拟验证，附一个掩码混合传输通信协议原型。
evidence_note: 统计力学推导配蒙特卡洛模拟确认相图，通信协议为概念验证，未与现有安全传输方案做可比指标评测。
novelty_note: 将成对 Hebbian 推广到高阶稠密以线性扩展容量属已有方向上的实质改进。
scope: 结论建立于 Hebbian 模块网络模型与所研究的交互阶数设定下。
limitations: 通信协议仅为概念验证，摘要未给出与现代纠错或加密方案的直接量化对比。

title: Beyond NISQ Assumptions: One-time Memory in the Classically Accessible Random-Oracle Model
abstract: Quantum information enables many cryptographic primitives that are impossible in the classical world. A line of works has developed cryptographic protocol under the assumption that quantum adversaries are restricted to noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) computing power, enabling strong one-time functionalities. But the advent of early fault-tolerant quantum computers eras will allow deeper logical quantum circuits, calling into questions the applicability of these NISQ-based assumptions. In this work, we adapt the classically accessible random oracle model (CAROM) as in [BDF+11] and [AK22], in which adversaries are only allowed to classically query the random oracle. The restriction is well motivated for NISQ quantum adversaries and may remain plausible in the presence of early fault-tolerant quantum computers. Then, we show that an efficient simulation-secure one-time memory (OTM) is possible under CAROM. Our protocol uses only BB84 states and has quadratic communication: for a $\lambda$-bit message and integer-valued parameters $n=n(\lambda)$ and $\ell=\ell(\lambda)$, the construction uses $n\ell$ qubits and $(n+2)\lambda$ classical bits, and for any quantum adversary with at most $2^{\ell/2-1}-1$ classical queries to the random oracle, its simulation advantage is at most $(n+3)\left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^n.$ Hence exponentially small simulation advantage in $n$.
title_cn: 超越 NISQ 假设：经典可访问随机预言机模型中的一次性存储器
abstract_cn: 量子信息使许多在经典世界中不可能实现的密码学原语成为可能。一系列研究在假设量子对手受限于含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）计算能力的前提下发展了密码协议，从而实现了强大的一次性功能。然而，早期容错量子计算机时代的到来将允许运行更深层的逻辑量子电路，这使基于 NISQ 的假设的适用性受到质疑。在本研究中，我们采用如 [BDF+11] 和 [AK22] 中的经典可访问随机预言机模型（CAROM），其中对手只允许以经典方式查询随机预言机。这一限制对 NISQ 量子对手而言具有充分动机，在早期容错量子计算机存在的情况下也可能保持合理性。随后，我们证明在 CAROM 下高效的模拟安全一次性存储器（OTM）是可能的。我们的协议仅使用 BB84 态，通信量为二次方：对于 λ 比特的消息以及整数参数 n=n(λ) 和 ℓ=ℓ(λ)，该构造使用 nℓ 个量子比特和 (n+2)λ 个经典比特；对于对随机预言机至多有 2^(ℓ/2-1)-1 次经典查询的任意量子对手，其模拟优势至多为 (n+3)(3/4)^n。因此模拟优势在 n 上呈指数级缩小。
summary_cn: 在经典可访问随机预言机模型 CAROM 下构造一次性存储 OTM,仅使用 BB84 态，通信为二次开销:λ 比特消息用 nℓ 量子比特与 (n+2)λ 经典比特，对不超过 2 的 ℓ∕2−1 次方减一个经典查询的量子对手，模拟优势至多 (n+3) 乘以 3∕4 的 n 次方，随 n 指数级衰减。
objective_summary: 在 CAROM 假设下给出基于 BB84 态的模拟安全一次性存储协议，证明通信开销与模拟优势随参数的显式界。
evidence_note: 纯理论构造，给出显式参数化的通信开销与模拟优势上界；摘要未提及是否完整公开证明。
novelty_note: 将 NISQ 假设替换为更弱的 CAROM 并构造指数级模拟安全的 OTM,方向少见。
scope: 适用于经典可访问随机预言机模型，针对经典查询受限的早期容错量子对手。
limitations: 依赖 CAROM 假设在早期容错时代的可信度，摘要未讨论实验或实现代价。

title: VulContextBench: A Benchmark for Security Context Retrieval in Coding Agents
abstract: Vulnerability-detection benchmarks score the verdict an agent reaches, not the evidence it gathered. A model that recalls a CVE from pretraining therefore scores the same as one that traced the data flow. We study a task where this difference matters, deciding whether a commit introduces a vulnerability. Instead of scoring the verdict, we score whether the agent retrieved the code its conclusion depends on. We present VulContextBench, a benchmark of 111 vulnerability-introducing commits (VICs) across 83 repositories, 63 CWEs, and five languages. Existing datasets label such commits by tracing a fix back through the version history, which often points to the wrong commit. We therefore audit every case by hand against an explicit four-criterion definition of a VIC, so the benchmark does not inherit that label noise. Each case is annotated with gold context, 464 code blocks in total, each tagged by its role in the evidence for the vulnerability. We evaluate seven frontier models with precision, recall and F1 at three granularities (file, block, and line), scored separately on the context an agent viewed while exploring and on the context it finally declared as evidence. The gap between the two is the main finding. Every model opens most of the gold context while exploring, but reports only part of it as evidence. At the level of code blocks, the share of the gold context a model reports is 37 to 73 percentage points below the share it viewed. Qwen3-Coder-Next views 86.3% of the lines in annotated code blocks but cites only 12.9% in its final report. GPT-5.5, which cites the most, views 73% and reports 36%. These results highlight a gap between finding relevant code and selecting it for the final report, which verdict-level benchmarks cannot reveal.
title_cn: VulContextBench：面向编程智能体安全上下文检索的基准测试
abstract_cn: 漏洞检测基准测试对智能体得出的判决进行评分，而不是对其收集的证据进行评分。一个从预训练中记住某个 CVE 的模型因此与通过追踪数据流得出结论的模型获得相同的分数。我们研究一项此差异至关重要的任务：判断某次提交是否引入了漏洞。我们不对判决评分，而是对智能体是否检索到其结论所依赖的代码进行评分。我们提出 VulContextBench，一个涵盖 83 个仓库、63 个 CWE 和五种编程语言的 111 个漏洞引入提交（VIC）基准测试。现有数据集通过从版本历史中追溯修复来标注此类提交，这往往指向错误的提交。因此，我们依据四条明确标准的 VIC 定义对每个案例进行人工审核，使基准测试不继承上述标签噪声。每个案例都标注了黄金上下文，共 464 个代码块，每个块都按其在漏洞证据中的角色进行了标注。我们以文件、代码块和代码行三个粒度的精确率、召回率和 F1 评估七个前沿模型，分别对智能体在探索时查看的上下文和最终声明为证据的上下文进行评分。两者之间的差距是主要发现。每个模型在探索时都打开了大部分黄金上下文，但最终只将其中一部分作为证据上报。在代码块粒度上，模型上报的黄金上下文比例比其查看的比例低 37 至 73 个百分点。Qwen3-Coder-Next 查看了标注代码块中 86.3% 的代码行，但在最终报告中仅引用了 12.9%。GPT-5.5 引用最多，查看了 73%，上报了 36%。这些结果揭示了发现相关代码与将其选入最终报告之间的差距，而判决级基准测试无法揭示这一差距。
summary_cn: 提出 VulContextBench 评测代码智能体在判定提交是否引入漏洞时的证据检索能力，人工审核 83 仓库 63 CWE 五种语言共 111 个漏洞引入提交，标注 464 块黄金上下文；七个前沿模型在块级汇报的黄金上下文占比比查看占比低 37-73 个百分点,Qwen3-Coder-Next 查看 86.3%、仅引用 12.9%。
objective_summary: 构建 111 个人工审核漏洞引入提交、464 块黄金上下文的基准，在文件、块、行三个粒度分别评测七个前沿模型查看与最终引用的精确率、召回率、F1。
evidence_note: 111 条跨 83 仓库 63 CWE 五语言的人工审核样本,464 块标注，七个前沿模型三粒度评测。
novelty_note: 评估证据检索而非最终判定，并以人工审核替代回溯修复提交的噪声标签，角度少见。
scope: 适用于以提交粒度判定漏洞引入的代码智能体，覆盖 5 种语言 63 种 CWE。
limitations: 基准仅 111 条，语言与 CWE 分布未必代表真实分布，黄金上下文标注的主观性未量化。

title: Reading Is Not Leaking: Local, Auditable Measurement and Reduction of Inference Exposure from Public Footprints
abstract: Anyone with a public footprint leaks facts that were never stated, and language models make the inference cheap. We present a framework for measuring and reducing this inference exposure that runs on the owner's own CPU with no language model at analysis time, instantiated on organisations and on individuals. It starts from a measurement result: scoring an inference system against the target's private truth conflates how well the system reads the record with how much the record leaks. On a 128-question instrument over sixteen synthetic firms, almost half of the questions are never answered correctly by any of six readers, four of them language models, and a majority-class guess accounts for most of every reader's score. We therefore separate reading accuracy from leakage rate and introduce an injection protocol that creates cells with known support. Our analyser combines rules, statistical solvers and a 106M-parameter encoder trained from scratch that marks verbatim evidence and never generates text; every answer carries a graded certificate whose recorded proof replays. Its certified answers are correct in 93% of resolved cases, against 49-73% for the language models' quote-backed answers, whose citations are produced alongside the answer rather than deriving it; with plain-prose articles in the record, 70% of its evidence-bearing answers rest on evidence that establishes them, against 18-56% for the models. A constrained defence that rewrites each fact's carrier as a true but coarser statement hides every single-carrier fact from four language-model adversaries at 40% lower edit cost than deletion. On sixteen synthetic people the guessing term is larger still, and a decoy planner with no language model halves the correct answers of the estimator it targets without transferring to a second.
title_cn: 读取并非泄露：公开足迹推断暴露的本地可审计测量与降低
abstract_cn: 任何拥有公开足迹的人都会泄露从未明确陈述过的事实，而语言模型使这种推断变得廉价。我们提出一个测量和降低推断暴露（inference exposure）的框架，该框架在所有者自己的 CPU 上运行，分析时无需调用语言模型，并针对组织和个人两类对象进行了实例化。框架从一个测量结论出发：对推断系统相对于目标私有真相进行评分，混淆了系统「读取记录的能力」与「记录本身的泄露程度」这两个维度。在针对十六家合成企业的 128 题测试中，有近一半的问题从未被六位读者（其中四位是语言模型）中的任何一位正确回答，多数类猜测贡献了每位读者得分的大部分。因此，我们将读取准确率与泄露率分开，并引入一种注入协议，用于创建具有已知支撑证据的单元格。我们的分析器结合了规则、统计求解器，以及一个从零训练的 1.06 亿参数编码器，该编码器标注逐字证据且从不生成文本；每个答案都附带分级证书，其记录的证明可重现。经认证的答案在 93% 的已解决案例中是正确的，而语言模型有引用支撑答案的正确率为 49%–73%，且这些引用是与答案一并产生的而非由引用推导出答案；对于记录中包含纯散文文章的情况，分析器有证据支撑的答案中有 70% 建立在能确立该答案的证据上，而各模型的对应比例为 18%–56%。一种受约束的防御策略将每个事实的载体改写为真实但更粗粒度的陈述，可对四个语言模型对手隐藏每一个单载体事实，编辑成本比删除低 40%。在十六位合成人物上，猜测项的占比更大，而一个无需语言模型的诱饵规划器可将其攻击目标的估计器正确答案减少一半，且不会迁移到第二个估计器。
summary_cn: 提出可本地离线运行的推断暴露度量与缓解框架，区分读取准确率与泄漏率，在 128 题 16 家合成企业的测评中约一半题目无阅读器能答对；自研 1.06 亿参数编码器带可回放证据，解析正确率 93%(语言模型 49-73%),缓解策略以低 40% 编辑成本隐藏单载体事实。
objective_summary: 设计可本地 CPU 运行、不含 LLM 的推断暴露分析器与缓解方案，在 16 家合成企业与 16 个合成个体上以注入协议分离读取与泄漏并与六个阅读器对照。
evidence_note: 16 家合成企业 128 题、16 个合成个体，与六个阅读器含四个 LLM 对照，但依赖合成数据且规模有限。
novelty_note: 明确区分读取准确率与泄漏率并给出注入协议、带回放证书的轻量分析器，方向少见。
scope: 适用于本地离线评估公开足迹推断暴露，结论基于合成企业与个体数据。
limitations: 评测对象为合成数据，现实公开足迹的分布与对抗能力未在真实数据上验证。

title: REFINE: A Resilient Evolution Framework for Intelligent Enterprise Alert Triage in Security Operations Centers
abstract: Security Operations Centers (SOCs) process large volumes of alerts daily. Alert triage prioritizes high-risk threats while reducing manual review of benign alerts. LLM agents can reason over logs and threat intelligence, but struggle to keep aligned with organization-specific, rapidly evolving SOC operational standards. We introduce REFINE, an LLM-agent framework for enterprise alert triage. REFINE encodes analyst expertise as structured skills and continuously adapts using analyst disposition feedback. It enforces recall = 1.0 as a hard constraint during evolution to maximize auto-closure of false positives, and identifies judgment blind spots by combining alert distributions with model error boundaries. Evaluated on four real industrial SOC scenarios across four MITRE ATT&CK phases with temporal split: REFINE achieves recall=1.0 on all evolution sets. On future test windows, it retains recall=1.0 in three scenarios; the degraded case reaches 0.807 recall, still outperforming self-evolution baselines (0.49-0.58).
title_cn: REFINE：面向安全运营中心智能企业告警分诊的弹性演化框架
abstract_cn: 安全运营中心（SOC）每天处理大量告警。告警分诊（alert triage）在优先处理高风险威胁的同时，减少对良性告警的人工审查。LLM 智能体能够对日志和威胁情报进行推理，但难以持续对齐特定组织快速演变的 SOC 运营标准。我们提出 REFINE，一个面向企业告警分诊的 LLM 智能体框架。REFINE 将分析员专业经验编码为结构化技能，并利用分析员对处置结果的反馈持续自适应更新。在演化过程中，它将召回率 = 1.0 作为硬约束以最大化误报的自动关闭率，并通过结合告警分布与模型错误边界来识别判断盲点。在四个 MITRE ATT&CK 阶段的四个真实工业 SOC 场景上按时间划分进行评估：REFINE 在所有演化集上均实现了召回率 = 1.0。在未来的测试窗口上，三个场景保持召回率 = 1.0；退化场景下召回率达到 0.807，仍优于自我演化基线（0.49–0.58）。
summary_cn: 针对企业 SOC 告警分诊提出 REFINE 框架，将分析师经验编码为结构化技能并以处置反馈持续演化，硬约束召回率为 1.0;在四个真实工业 SOC 场景、覆盖四个 MITRE ATT&CK 阶段的时间划分上，演化集全部达到召回 1.0,未来测试窗口三场景保持 1.0,退化场景降至 0.807(基线 0.49-0.58)。
objective_summary: 提出以召回 1.0 为硬约束的 LLM 智能体告警分诊框架，结合结构化技能与分析师反馈，在四个真实工业 SOC 场景以时间划分方式与自演化基线对照评测。
evidence_note: 四个真实工业 SOC 场景时间划分评测，与自演化基线对比，但场景数有限且未报告统计显著性。
novelty_note: 在 LLM 分诊方向上以硬召回约束加判断盲区识别作为改进，方向本身属于已有探索。
scope: 限于基于 LLM 的企业 SOC 告警分诊场景，覆盖四个 MITRE ATT&CK 阶段。
limitations: 场景数量仅四个，一个场景在未来测试窗口召回降至 0.807,泛化性未充分验证。

title: Hearsay: Can an Auditor Trust the Record a Deployed Agent Harness Writes?
abstract: An agent harness, the code that turns a model into an agent, writes its own record of each run, and that record is all a later reader gets when a run is disputed, investigated or audited. We call a record evidentiary when a reader who was not there can check it without trusting the writer. Across sixteen deployed frameworks, none writes one in full. Hearsay examines the record, not the task: five harnesses run fourteen tasks, three blinded LLM examiners and a human panel read the records, and every excerpt an examiner quotes is checked mechanically for who wrote it. First, the record lets a reader name the fault but not prove how the run went. Examiners name the right fault in 74 to 91% of 140 runs, but the fault can be proved only from two files the benchmark adds; for what happened in between, fewer than one citation in ten lands on anything the harness did not write, and the examiner with the fewest false alarms catches half of the entries we delete, rewrite or fabricate. Second, the remedy is a second author, not a stronger seal on the first. An append-only log of what passes between harness and model, kept outside the harness and read against the record in both directions, reports all 28 omissions and fabrications we made a harness commit as it ran, where a hash chain over the harness's own record passes all 28. Handed the log, examiners keep their fault verdicts but rest more of their citations on what the harness did not write. What makes a record evidence is who writes it, not what is captured.
comment: 48 pages (9-page main text), 5 figures. Under review. Code and data: this https URL
title_cn: Hearsay：审计员能否信任已部署的 agent harness 所写的运行记录？
abstract_cn: Agent harness 是将模型转化为智能体的代码，它会为每次运行写一份自己的记录，而当某次运行遭到质疑、调查或审计时，后来的读者所能获得的只有这份记录。若不在场的读者无需信任记录者便可核验一份记录，我们称该记录为「证据性」记录。在十六个已部署框架中，没有一个能完整地写出这样的记录。Hearsay 研究的是记录本身，而非任务内容：五个 harness 执行十四项任务，三个盲评 LLM 考察员与一个人工小组阅读记录，考察员引用的每处摘录均通过机械手段核查其作者。第一，记录能让读者指出故障类型，却无法证明运行过程如何进行。在 140 次运行中，考察员有 74% 至 91% 的概率能正确指出故障类型，但只有基准测试额外提供的两个文件才能证明故障成因；对于中间发生的事情，每十条引用中不足一条落在 harness 本身未写的内容上，误报最少的那位考察员也只能发现我们删除、改写或捏造的条目中的一半。第二，解决方案是引入第二位作者，而不是对第一位作者的记录加更强的封印。将 harness 与模型之间传递内容的只追加日志（append-only log）保存在 harness 外部，并从两个方向与记录相互核验，可检举出我们让 harness 在运行时提交的全部 28 处遗漏与捏造，而仅对 harness 自身记录做哈希链验证则 28 处全部通过。拿到日志后，考察员保留了原有的故障判决，但将更多引用转向 harness 未写的内容。使一份记录具有证据效力的，是谁写了它，而不是捕获了什么。
summary_cn: 审视智能体运行记录是否可作为事后审计证据，设计 Hearsay 对五个 harness、十四项任务、140 次运行的记录做三位盲评 LLM 与人工审阅，并逐条引用机械核验；结论是仅由 harness 自写的记录无法证明过程，外挂的只追加日志能全数发现 28 处删改与伪造，而仅在原记录加哈希链全部漏检。
objective_summary: 对十六个已部署 agent 框架的运行记录做证据性分析，在五个 harness 上跑十四项任务共 140 次运行，用盲评 LLM 与人工审阅检查引用并对比哈希链与外挂追加日志两种方案。
evidence_note: 跨 16 框架、5 harness、14 任务、140 次运行，三位盲评 LLM 加人工对照，带定量引用准确率与注入错误检出率。
novelty_note: 将 agent 运行记录的证据性与审计可信度作为独立研究对象，并提出外部追加日志作为对照手段。
scope: 适用于 agent harness 运行记录的事后审计与争议复核场景，结论基于五个 harness、十四项任务的运行记录。
limitations: 受控任务与注入错误的构造方式有限，实际部署下的攻击者模型与审查者能力差异未充分探讨。

title: CyberClear: A Benchmark for LLM Agent Systems on APT Attack Chain Provenance
abstract: Large language model agents have demonstrated promising capabilities in cybersecurity tasks, yet their ability to reconstruct complete Advanced Persistent Threat attack campaigns from complex security logs remains largely unexplored. Existing cybersecurity benchmarks for agents mainly focus on vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and security analysis tasks, leaving the evaluation of attack chain provenance under realistic security logs insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we introduce CyberClear, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents and advanced agent systems on APT attack chain provenance from long-context security logs. CyberClear covers both single-step attacks and multi-stage attack chains, requiring agents to identify attack evidence, infer attack progression, and generate provenance graphs containing entities, causal relationships, MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and forensic evidence. To enable comprehensive evaluation, we develop an evaluation method tailored to APT attack chain provenance. Unlike conventional text similarity metrics that focus on surface-level matching, our evaluation examines whether reconstructed graphs preserve the semantics of attack chains across single-step behavior correctness, multi-step behavior identification, temporal and causal consistency, entity and relationship fidelity, and overall attack narrative consistency. Advanced multi-agent systems powered by state-of-the-art LLMs still struggle on CyberClear, motivating us to propose CyberProvenance, an agent cyber harness designed for multi-agents that augments LLM agents with evidence accumulation, execution-based validation, and feedback-guided refinement mechanisms for reliable attack-chain provenance. Extensive evaluations on CyberClear demonstrate the effectiveness of CyberProvenance in improving evidence reasoning, execution-grounded validation, and complete APT attack chain reconstruction.
title_cn: CyberClear：面向 APT 攻击链溯源的大语言模型智能体系统基准
abstract_cn: 大语言模型智能体在网络安全任务中展现出良好的能力，但其从复杂安全日志中重建完整高级持续性威胁（APT）攻击活动的能力仍有待深入探索。现有面向智能体的网络安全基准主要聚焦于漏洞发现、利用和安全分析任务，对真实安全日志下攻击链溯源的评估研究不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出 CyberClear，一个用于评估大语言模型智能体和高级智能体系统在长上下文安全日志中进行 APT 攻击链溯源能力的基准。CyberClear 涵盖单步攻击和多阶段攻击链，要求智能体识别攻击证据、推断攻击进程，并生成包含实体、因果关系、MITRE ATT&CK 技术和取证证据的溯源图。为实现全面评估，我们开发了一种专为 APT 攻击链溯源设计的评估方法。与关注表面匹配的传统文本相似度指标不同，我们的评估方法检验重建图是否在单步行为正确性、多步行为识别、时序与因果一致性、实体与关系保真度以及整体攻击叙事一致性等维度上保留了攻击链的语义。由最先进大语言模型驱动的高级多智能体系统在 CyberClear 上仍面临挑战，这促使我们提出 CyberProvenance，一种专为多智能体设计的 agent cyber harness，通过为大语言模型智能体增加证据积累、基于执行的验证和反馈引导的精化机制，实现可靠的攻击链溯源。在 CyberClear 上的大量评估证明了 CyberProvenance 在提升证据推理、基于执行的验证以及完整 APT 攻击链重建方面的有效性。
summary_cn: 提出 CyberClear 基准，评测 LLM 智能体从长上下文安全日志中重建 APT 攻击链溯源图的能力，覆盖单步与多阶段攻击，并给出面向语义一致性的评测方法；基于此提出 CyberProvenance 多智能体框架，结合证据累积、执行验证与反馈精炼。
objective_summary: 构建覆盖单步与多阶段攻击的 APT 溯源基准 CyberClear，并实现 CyberProvenance 多智能体框架在该基准上的对照评测。
evidence_note: 在自建基准上对多种前沿 LLM 与多智能体系统做了对照评测，具体规模与统计检验摘要未给。
novelty_note: 摘要称以往基准聚焦漏洞发现与利用，少见面向 APT 攻击链溯源的 agent 评测与评测法。
scope: 限于基准覆盖的单步与多阶段 APT 攻击类型，评测对象为当前主流 LLM 多智能体系统。
limitations: 摘要未披露日志来源、规模与真实部署覆盖度，评测方法与数据的外部可比性有限。

title: SkillDRE: Dual-Stage Red-Team Evolution of Agent Skills via Pre-Execution and Runtime Feedback
abstract: Agent skills package instructions, executable code, and task-specific resources into reusable artifacts that agents can improve using execution feedback. The same mechanism also enables attackers to evolve malicious skills, making them more effective and less detectable. However, a candidate skill may pass pre-execution scanning yet fail to realize its target under runtime defenses, while a revision that repairs execution may introduce new scanner findings. We introduce SkillDRE, a fully automated framework for evolving complete malicious skill packages through a dual-stage feedback loop.
