title_cn: 持久计费状态：工具调用 LLM 智能体中的钱包拒绝攻击与防御
abstract_cn: 多步工具调用 LLM 智能体依赖宿主运行时在多轮之间保存状态。当运行时把外部工具的返回内容带入后续模型输入时，提供商会再次对其计量。由此，一个已被准入的恶意或被攻陷工具可以把不可信数据转化为由受害者付费的反复处理，而无需受害者凭据或本地运行时权限。我们将这类被保留的内容称为持久计费状态，并把宿主关于它是否以及如何进入后续计费上下文的决策形式化为持久计费状态边界。我们提出了对这一准入后生命周期的首个系统性安全研究。我们推导出六种钱包拒绝（denial-of-wallet）攻击向量，并构建了 DOW-BENCH——一个在六个模型家族上评估的端到端测试框架。在 243 次执行中，用量遥测显示单会话累计输入的最大值达到该会话首次调用输入的 14,293 倍。受控的历史策略重跑隔离出原始保留的贡献：保留原始历史使平均有效会话成本增加 21.2–35.9%。压缩在 10/12 与 11/12 个依赖历史的任务上成功，而删除在每个提供商下均仅为 2/12。为治理这一边界，我们把确定性的历史变换与四个宿主侧不变式相结合，在重新摄入之前约束提示量、上下文增长、递归机会与累计花费。该内核遏制了 123 次评估回放语料中所有反复发生的攻击。在 24 个 Mistral Small 4 工作流上，一个按进展授权的策略取得 22/24 个经预言机验证的任务成功且无任何完成前中断，而固定上限下为 13/24。在扫描的 3,830 个 MCP 服务器与传输层仓库中，只有 71 个暴露了任何代码可见的防护代理指标，且没有一个覆盖全部四类防护。这些结果确立了持久计费状态作为一等安全对象的地位，并把重新摄入之前确立为其由宿主掌控的控制点。
summary_cn: 提出「持久计费状态」与六种钱包拒绝攻击：单会话累计输入最高达首调用 14,293 倍；宿主侧不变式遏制 123 次回放中全部反复攻击；3,830 个 MCP 仓库仅 71 个有防护迹象。
objective_summary: 形式化工具返回在多轮上下文中被重复计费的边界，构建 DOW-BENCH 测量六类攻击，并以宿主侧不变式防护内核、工作流对照实验与 MCP 仓库扫描验证。
evidence_note: 六模型家族 243 次执行、受控历史策略重跑、123 次回放与 24 工作流对照、3,830 仓库扫描；未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 把跨轮保留的工具返回视为可被放大计费的安全对象，是此前未被系统研究的攻击面。
scope: 结论适用于按 token 计费、在多轮中保留工具返回的工具调用智能体运行时与所测模型家族。
limitations: 防护效用仅在 Mistral Small 4 的 24 个工作流上评估；仓库扫描基于代码可见代理指标。

title: Where Cyber Agents Struggle: Bottleneck Analysis of Multi-Stage LLM Agents
abstract: Multi-stage LLM-based cyber agents may complete attack workflows while remaining brittle, costly, or reliant on incorrect interpretations of execution evidence. Success rates alone obscure inefficiency, adaptation through retries, and recognition of success or failure. We present an end-to-end diagnostic study of an Autonomous Adversary system with orchestrator, executor, and validator LLMs in enterprise-like lateral-movement scenarios. Six frontier models are evaluated across two scenarios and three modes: expert-defined, self-scaffolded, and fully autonomous. We assess validator consistency and evidence grounding; introduce a subtask-conditioned, cost-aware score for abnormal token use, retries, and runtime; and use comparative LLM-as-a-Judge analysis to identify planning deficiencies, including tool misalignment, plan similarity, over-specification, inadequate probing, and weak recovery. Validators are generally relevant and evidence-grounded but often nonspecific and overly optimistic. Bottlenecks cluster in credential and lateral-movement tasks, spread with scenario complexity, and vary more under full autonomy. Reliable evaluation must assess outcomes, evidence interpretation, resource use, and adaptation after failure.

title_cn: 网络智能体卡在哪里：多阶段 LLM 智能体的瓶颈分析
abstract_cn: 多阶段的基于 LLM 的网络智能体可能完成攻击工作流，却依然脆弱、代价高昂，或依赖对执行证据的错误解读。仅凭成功率会掩盖低效、借助重试实现的适应，以及对成功或失败的识别。我们对一个由编排器、执行器与验证器 LLM 组成的自主对手（Autonomous Adversary）系统，在类企业的横向移动场景中开展端到端诊断研究。我们在两个场景和三种模式（专家定义、自建脚手架与完全自主）下评估了六个前沿模型。我们评估验证器的一致性与证据依据；引入一个以子任务为条件、考虑成本的评分，用于衡量异常的 token 用量、重试与运行时间；并使用对比式 LLM-as-a-Judge 分析来识别规划缺陷，包括工具错配、计划相似、过度规定、探查不足与恢复能力弱。验证器总体上相关且有证据依据，但常常不够具体且过于乐观。瓶颈集中在凭据与横向移动任务上，随场景复杂度扩散，并在完全自主模式下变化更大。可靠的评估必须同时评估结果、证据解读、资源使用以及失败后的适应。
summary_cn: 对含编排器/执行器/验证器的自主攻击智能体做端到端诊断：六个前沿模型、两个横向移动场景、三种自主度下，瓶颈集中于凭据与横向移动任务，验证器常偏乐观（FPS 2026）。
objective_summary: 在类企业横向移动场景中以六个前沿模型、三种自主模式评估多阶段攻击智能体，结合成本感知评分与 LLM-as-a-Judge 分析定位瓶颈。
evidence_note: 六模型×两场景×三模式的对比；场景数量少，规划缺陷依赖 LLM 裁判判定，摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 在成功率之外引入子任务成本评分与验证器证据依据评估，是对攻击智能体评估方法的实质细化。
scope: 结论限于所构建的自主对手架构、两个类企业横向移动场景与所测六个模型。
limitations: 仅两个场景；LLM-as-a-Judge 分析的可靠性取决于裁判模型本身。

title: Don't Read the Log: Execution Traces Contaminate Verifiers in Video-Generation Agents
abstract: Agentic video-generation systems close a loop between a generator and a verifier: an LLM plans shots, calls a text-to-video model, and a multimodal judge decides whether the result satisfies the request. To diagnose where a long workflow fails, recent harnesses deliberately show the judge more than the video-the agent's execution trace, its plan, the narration it synthesized. We ask whether this auxiliary text moves the judge's verdict on purely \emph{visual} requirements, holding the frames fixed. On a benchmark of 109 generated two-event clips with manual labels, in which the requested event is either visibly completed or visibly missing, a trace that reports a successful tool call makes three open-weight Qwen-VL judges (7B, 8B, 32B) accept $78$--$90\%$ of the failures, up from $7$--$19\%$ without text, and a contradicting trace makes them reject up to $100\%$ of correct clips; an instruction to ``use only the frames'' does not remove the effect. Frontier closed judges are essentially unmoved on the same clips, showing that the vulnerability is a property of the judge's learned trust in tool logs rather than of the task. Plan-derived text carries no clip-specific information, so it can only shift a judge's operating point, and in a repair loop that shift becomes a cap on the true pass rate that no repair policy can exceed; the cap matches simulation to two decimals. In the loop, contamination is exploited without any adversarial agent: an honest LLM planner that always regenerates ends with a judge pass rate of $1.00$ and a human-labelled pass rate of $0.28$, and a pipeline in which a cheap checker writes its verdict into the trace launders that checker's errors into a stronger final judge ($0.69$ false accepts).
title_cn: 别读日志：执行轨迹污染视频生成智能体中的验证器
abstract_cn: 智能体化视频生成系统在生成器与验证器之间形成闭环：一个 LLM 规划镜头、调用文生视频模型，再由一个多模态裁判判定结果是否满足请求。为诊断长工作流在何处失败，近期的框架刻意让裁判看到视频之外的更多内容——智能体的执行轨迹、其规划以及它合成的旁白。我们在保持画面帧不变的前提下，探究这些辅助文本是否会改变裁判对纯视觉要求的判定。在一个包含 109 个带人工标注的生成双事件片段的基准上（其中所请求的事件要么明显完成、要么明显缺失），一条报告工具调用成功的轨迹使三个开放权重 Qwen-VL 裁判（7B、8B、32B）接受了 78–90% 的失败片段，而无文本时仅为 7–19%；一条与之矛盾的轨迹则使它们拒绝多达 100% 的正确片段；「只使用画面帧」的指令并不能消除这一效应。前沿闭源裁判在相同片段上基本不受影响，表明这一脆弱性源于裁判对工具日志习得的信任，而非任务本身的属性。由规划派生的文本不携带任何特定于片段的信息，因此只能移动裁判的工作点；而在修复循环中，这种移动成为真实通过率的上限，任何修复策略都无法超越；该上限与模拟结果吻合到小数点后两位。在循环中，污染无需任何对抗性智能体即被利用：一个总是重新生成的诚实 LLM 规划器最终的裁判通过率为 1.00，而人工标注的通过率为 0.28；在一个由廉价检查器把自身判定写入轨迹的管线中，该检查器的错误被「洗白」进更强的最终裁判（错误接受达 0.69）。
summary_cn: 发现视频生成智能体中执行轨迹会污染多模态裁判：报告成功的轨迹使 Qwen-VL 裁判对失败片段的接受率从 7–19% 升至 78–90%；闭环中裁判通过率 1.00 而人工标注仅 0.28。
objective_summary: 在固定画面帧的受控设定下，测量执行轨迹等辅助文本对多模态裁判视觉判定的影响，并以修复循环实验与模拟分析其对真实通过率的上限效应。
evidence_note: 109 个人工标注片段、三个开放裁判加闭源对照、有无文本与矛盾轨迹对照、模拟吻合；基准规模较小，未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 揭示诚实流程中的执行日志即可污染裁判，并给出通过率上限分析，区别于对抗性注入研究。
scope: 结论限于所测 Qwen-VL 开放裁判、双事件视频片段与所述修复循环；闭源裁判基本不受影响。
limitations: 基准仅 109 个片段、单一任务类型；受影响的开放裁判只覆盖 Qwen-VL 一个系列。

title: Who Is Behind the Harness? Fingerprinting LLMs through Agentic Behavior
abstract: LLMs increasingly operate through coding-agent harnesses that inspect repositories, invoke tools, and modify files. Substituting the model behind such an agent can therefore change security-relevant decisions, including whether it verifies changes or recovers safely from failures. Existing LLM fingerprints largely infer identity from direct text or token distributions. In coding agents, these signals are mediated by system instructions, controller logic, tools, and execution feedback, limiting their transfer. We present LIDAR (LLM Identification from Decisions and Actions at Runtime), an active black-box fingerprinting method for coding-agent execution. Three coding probe pairs expose post-edit verification, transient-failure recovery, and specification--test conflict resolution under controlled changes. LIDAR represents the resulting trajectories with complementary instance-level and distribution-level features and compares them with clean references using a lightweight probabilistic identifier. It requires no access to model weights, logits, or provider internals. Across 36 models from seven families and two agent harnesses, LIDAR achieves high Top-1 accuracy and MRR and outperforms four existing fingerprinting and API-auditing baselines. Ablations confirm that the two feature levels, all probe pairs, and their controlled variants contribute. These results show that agent execution behavior provides model-identity evidence beyond final outputs.
title_cn: 谁在框架背后？通过智能体行为为 LLM 做指纹识别
abstract_cn: LLM 越来越多地通过编码智能体框架（harness）运行，这些框架会检查代码仓库、调用工具并修改文件。因此，替换此类智能体背后的模型可能改变与安全相关的决策，包括它是否验证修改、能否从失败中安全恢复。现有的 LLM 指纹大多从直接文本或 token 分布推断身份。在编码智能体中，这些信号受到系统指令、控制器逻辑、工具与执行反馈的中介，限制了其迁移性。我们提出 LIDAR（LLM Identification from Decisions and Actions at Runtime），一种面向编码智能体执行的主动黑盒指纹方法。三组编码探针对在受控变化下暴露编辑后验证、瞬时失败恢复以及规格与测试冲突的处理。LIDAR 用互补的实例级与分布级特征表示所得轨迹，并通过一个轻量级概率识别器将其与干净参考进行比较。它不需要访问模型权重、logits 或提供商内部信息。在来自七个家族的 36 个模型和两种智能体框架上，LIDAR 取得了较高的 Top-1 准确率与 MRR，并优于四种现有的指纹与 API 审计基线。消融实验证实，两个特征层级、全部探针对及其受控变体都有贡献。这些结果表明，智能体执行行为提供了超出最终输出的模型身份证据。
summary_cn: 提出基于编码智能体执行行为的黑盒 LLM 指纹方法 LIDAR：以三组探针对捕获编辑后验证、失败恢复与规格-测试冲突处理，在 7 个家族 36 个模型、两种框架上优于四个基线。
objective_summary: 设计暴露智能体决策行为的编码探针，以轨迹的实例级与分布级特征识别模型身份，并在 36 个模型、两种框架上与四个基线对比及做消融验证。
evidence_note: 7 个家族 36 个模型、两种框架、四个基线对比与消融；摘要未给具体准确率数字与统计检验。
novelty_note: 身份证据从文本或 token 分布转向智能体执行轨迹中的决策行为，是新的指纹信号来源。
scope: 结论适用于可主动下发探针任务的编码智能体场景、所测两种框架与 36 个模型。
limitations: 依赖干净参考轨迹；对刻意伪装行为或未见框架的鲁棒性摘要未涉及。

title: Privacy Leakage Through AI-mediated Analysis of Smartphone Data
abstract: Over the past thirty years, the online advertising industry built a large-scale data collection ecosystem, with the goal of tracking a user's online activity to infer their demographics and interests. Traditionally, the ecosystem relied upon the collation and analysis of highly-structured text data like user IP addresses, GPS coordinates, e-commerce purchase histories, and visited URLs. However, recent ML models can parse not only structured text, but also multimedia files and unstructured text inputs---meaning a user's photos, videos, inboxes, and calendars are now ripe for automated analysis. The privacy risks are particularly acute in the context of smartphone apps. A user's phone already acts as a natural collation point for sensitive user information, but users may not understand that permitting an app to, for example, access a user's photo does not just give the app access to the bytes in the photo: the app also receives access to inferences about the user that are enabled by the photo. To explore these privacy risks, we built Priva-See, an LLM-based inference system for app-collected user data; Priva-See reflects our best understanding of how real-life adtech companies would leverage machine learning to build user profiles. Through an IRB-approved user study, 465 participants deployed Priva-See on their phones; Priva-See made privacy-invasive inferences despite having access to only a subset of a user's data. We see the experience significantly impacted participant willingness to share permissions data moving forward. Based on the observed privacy violations, we suggest changes to how smartphone OSes should gather user consent for data access, to better inform users about downstream data usage capability.
title_cn: 经由 AI 分析智能手机数据造成的隐私泄露
abstract_cn: 过去三十年里，在线广告行业构建了一个大规模数据收集生态，目的是追踪用户的在线活动以推断其人口统计特征与兴趣。传统上，该生态依赖于对高度结构化文本数据的整理与分析，如用户 IP 地址、GPS 坐标、电商购买记录和访问过的 URL。然而，近来的 ML 模型不仅能解析结构化文本，还能解析多媒体文件与非结构化文本输入——这意味着用户的照片、视频、收件箱与日历如今都可被自动化分析。在智能手机应用的场景下，隐私风险尤为突出。用户的手机本就是敏感用户信息的天然汇集点，但用户可能并不理解：例如允许应用访问自己的照片，并不只是让应用获得照片中的字节，应用还获得了借助这张照片可推断出的关于用户的信息。为探究这些隐私风险，我们构建了 Priva-See——一个针对应用所收集用户数据的基于 LLM 的推断系统；Priva-See 体现了我们对现实中广告技术公司将如何利用机器学习构建用户画像的最佳理解。在一项经 IRB 批准的用户研究中，465 名参与者在自己的手机上部署了 Priva-See；尽管只能访问用户数据的一个子集，Priva-See 仍做出了侵犯隐私的推断。我们看到，这段经历显著影响了参与者今后共享权限数据的意愿。基于观察到的隐私侵犯，我们就智能手机操作系统应如何收集用户对数据访问的同意提出修改建议，以更好地告知用户下游的数据使用能力。
summary_cn: 构建基于 LLM 的应用数据推断系统 Priva-See，经 IRB 批准的 465 人真机部署研究显示其仅凭部分数据即做出侵犯隐私的推断，并显著改变参与者共享权限的意愿。
objective_summary: 构建模拟广告技术公司能力的 LLM 推断系统，并通过 465 人真实手机部署的用户研究检验其推断能力及对用户权限共享意愿的影响。
evidence_note: 465 名参与者真机部署的 IRB 用户研究，报告意愿的显著变化；推断系统为作者模拟，摘要未提对照组。
novelty_note: 把 LLM 对照片、邮件、日历等非结构化数据的推断纳入应用权限隐私风险，并在真实用户数据上呈现。
scope: 结论限于 Priva-See 所模拟的推断能力、其可访问的数据子集与该参与者样本。
limitations: 系统代表作者对广告商做法的推测，未必反映真实产业实践；意愿变化依赖自报。

title: An Exposition of GPT Astra's Proof of Lower Bound on DP Continual Counting
abstract: The goal of this note is to give a detailed proof, to the best of our understanding, of the recent presentation by Harrison and Leeman (arXiv:2609.17650v01 and arXiv:2609.17650v02) of the proof by Astra on the lower bound for differentially private continual counting. We believe a more natural and easy proof is possible and hope that this note will help in that effort. Prior to the initial preprint by Harrison and Leeman (arXiv:2609.17650v01), Bairaktari and Larsen (arXiv:2607.00876) gave an elegant proof to show a lower bound of $\Omega(\log^{3/2}(n))$ for both pure and approximate-DP continual counting, and in personal communication had informed us that they have a proof of optimal $\Omega(\log^{2}(n))$ for pure-differential private continual counting as well. They have subsequently published their $\Omega(\log^{2}(n))$ bound, which is now a joint work of Bairaktari, Dahl, and Larsen (arXiv:2607.00876v3). Their new result is an elegant extension of their technique for approximate-differential privacy. Although the two proofs are technically different, the Astra argument uses related tree geometry introduced in Bairaktari and Larsen.

title_cn: GPT Astra 关于差分隐私连续计数下界证明的详解
abstract_cn: 本笔记的目标是，在我们所能理解的范围内，为 Harrison 与 Leeman 近期（arXiv:2609.17650v01 与 arXiv:2609.17650v02）所呈现的、由 Astra 给出的差分隐私连续计数下界证明提供一个详细证明。我们相信存在更自然、更简单的证明，并希望本笔记有助于这一努力。在 Harrison 与 Leeman 的初版预印本（arXiv:2609.17650v01）之前，Bairaktari 与 Larsen（arXiv:2607.00876）给出了一个优雅的证明，表明纯差分隐私与近似差分隐私的连续计数都有 Ω(log^(3/2)(n)) 的下界，并在私下交流中告知我们，他们对纯差分隐私连续计数也有最优 Ω(log^2(n)) 下界的证明。他们随后发表了该 Ω(log^2(n)) 界，现为 Bairaktari、Dahl 与 Larsen 的合作成果（arXiv:2607.00876v3）。他们的新结果是其近似差分隐私技术的一个优雅推广。尽管两个证明在技术上不同，Astra 的论证使用了 Bairaktari 与 Larsen 引入的相关树几何。
summary_cn: 为他人预印本中 GPT Astra 生成的差分隐私连续计数下界证明补写完整详细证明，并梳理其与 Bairaktari 等人 Ω(log^2 n) 等既有下界证明在树几何技术上的关系。
objective_summary: 对由 GPT Astra 生成、经他人预印本呈现的差分隐私连续计数下界证明做完整详细的书面重述，并说明其与既有证明技术的关系。
evidence_note: 给出完整详细证明；但属对他人证明的整理重述，作者注明结论基于其对原论证的理解。
novelty_note: 下界结论已有（含 Bairaktari 等人的独立证明）；贡献在于补全并阐明 AI 生成证明的细节。
scope: 限于差分隐私连续计数问题的下界，以及 Astra 证明所用的树几何论证框架。
limitations: 不提出新结果；作者承认可能存在更自然简洁的证明，对原论证的理解可能有偏差。

title: Stress-Testing Structure-Aware Calibration of Malware Graph Neural Networks under Type Shift
abstract: Post-hoc malware calibrators can condition confidence on graph structure, but their structural inputs may leave the support represented by validation data under malware-type shift. We study this risk on MalNet-Tiny by holding out each of four malware types across three seeds, freezing a graph isomorphism network, and fitting post-hoc mappings only on known-type data. Adding eight community covariates to a generic-topology calibrator increases mean negative log likelihood (NLL) by 0.1369; a type-cluster bootstrap gives a 95% interval of [-0.0125, 0.2864]. A capacity-matched control adds eight label-independent nuisance variables over 20 deterministic repeats and increases NLL by only 0.0415, indicating that input count explains part but not all of the degradation. We then use calibration data to define a community-support guard: predictions outside the 95th percentile of calibration-standardized community displacement revert to the generic calibrator. The guard reduces combined NLL by 0.1133 and high-confidence errors from 43.25 to 33.25 per 400-sample cell, while its NLL remains close to the generic baseline. These results show how structural covariates can create support-sensitive confidence errors and how a label-free fallback can recover most of the resulting loss.

title_cn: 类型偏移下恶意软件图神经网络结构感知校准的压力测试
abstract_cn: 事后恶意软件校准器可以让置信度以图结构为条件，但在恶意软件类型偏移下，其结构输入可能超出验证数据所覆盖的支撑范围。我们在 MalNet-Tiny 上研究这一风险：在三个随机种子下轮流留出四种恶意软件类型中的每一种，冻结一个图同构网络，并且只在已知类型数据上拟合事后映射。向通用拓扑校准器加入八个社区协变量会使平均负对数似然（NLL）上升 0.1369；按类型聚类的 bootstrap 给出的 95% 区间为 [-0.0125, 0.2864]。一个容量匹配的对照在 20 次确定性重复中加入八个与标签无关的干扰变量，仅使 NLL 上升 0.0415，表明输入数量能解释部分但非全部的性能退化。随后我们利用校准数据定义一个社区支撑守卫：凡校准标准化社区位移超出第 95 百分位的预测，都回退到通用校准器。该守卫使合并 NLL 降低 0.1133，并把高置信错误从每 400 样本单元 43.25 个降到 33.25 个，同时其 NLL 仍接近通用基线。这些结果表明结构协变量如何造成对支撑敏感的置信错误，以及无标签的回退机制如何挽回由此造成的大部分损失。
summary_cn: 在 MalNet-Tiny 类型留出设定下压力测试结构感知校准：社区协变量使 NLL 升 0.1369（区间跨零）；支撑守卫回退使 NLL 降 0.1133、高置信错误 43.25→33.25。
objective_summary: 在 MalNet-Tiny 上以留出类型、多种子与容量匹配对照检验结构协变量对事后校准的影响，并提出基于校准数据的社区支撑回退守卫加以验证。
evidence_note: 四类型×三种子留出、类型聚类 bootstrap 区间、20 次容量匹配对照；单数据集单模型，主效应区间跨零。
novelty_note: 指出结构协变量在类型偏移下引发支撑敏感的置信错误，并给出无标签回退守卫，属校准方向的实质改进。
scope: 结论限于 MalNet-Tiny、冻结的图同构网络、四种留出类型与所测事后校准器。
limitations: 单一小型数据集与模型；退化效应的区间包含零，摘要未给守卫收益的区间。

title: Unsnarling the Red Tape: Computational Infrastructure for Regulatory Systems
abstract: Regulatory complexity is increasingly recognized as an impediment to innovation, institutional responsiveness, and long-run economic growth, with regulatory accumulation estimated to reduce the U.S. GDP growth rate by nearly a full percentage point annually. This paper argues that computational approaches--including knowledge representation, artificial intelligence, natural-language processing, and cryptography--can help reduce forms of regulatory "red tape" by improving efficiency, transparency, and institutional responsiveness. We develop a framework for understanding the sources of regulatory friction and how they can be mitigated to support compliance, analysis, and reform. We further argue that effective modernization requires treating regulation not merely as legal text, but as a complex institutional and informational system that can be partially represented, analyzed, coordinated, and improved computationally while preserving legal legitimacy and procedural accountability.

title_cn: 理顺繁文缛节：面向监管体系的计算基础设施
abstract_cn: 监管复杂性日益被视为创新、制度响应能力与长期经济增长的障碍，据估计监管累积每年使美国 GDP 增长率降低近整整一个百分点。本文认为，计算方法——包括知识表示、人工智能、自然语言处理与密码学——能够通过提升效率、透明度与制度响应能力，帮助减少各种形式的监管「繁文缛节」。我们构建了一个框架，用于理解监管摩擦的来源以及如何缓解这些摩擦，以支持合规、分析与改革。我们进一步认为，有效的现代化要求不只把监管视为法律文本，而是将其视为一个复杂的制度与信息系统：它可以在保持法律正当性与程序问责的同时，被部分地以计算方式表示、分析、协调与改进。
summary_cn: CRA 产业委员会报告：论证知识表示、AI、NLP 与密码学等计算方法可减少监管繁文缛节，给出监管摩擦来源与缓解框架，主张把监管作为可计算的制度信息系统来对待。
objective_summary: 以论述方式提出监管摩擦来源与计算化缓解框架，主张将监管建模为制度与信息系统；不包含实证或原型验证。
evidence_note: 概念框架性报告，仅引用 GDP 增长影响的既有估计；摘要未给实证数据、案例评估或原型。
novelty_note: 计算化监管已有相关探索；本文贡献在于把多类计算方法整合为统一的论述框架。
scope: 以美国监管背景为引的框架层面主张，未落到具体系统、法域或技术实现。
limitations: 缺乏实证或原型评估；安全与密码学只是手段之一，主体并非安全问题。

title: ForgetMimic: Motion Unlearning for Reinforcement Learning Humanoid Control
abstract: Humanoid control, leveraging human demonstrations, has achieved diverse, agile, and natural locomotion behaviors through reinforcement learning (RL). While this paradigm has yielded remarkable performance in physical humanoid control, how to eliminate specific motions from learned policies remains insufficiently explored. Addressing this issue is motivated by pressing safety and privacy concerns: the removal of malicious, poisoned, or suboptimal motions, as well as copyright-protected motions subject to the right to be forgotten under regulations such as the GDPR, is of critical importance. To this end, we propose {ForgetMimic}, the first motion-level unlearning method designed specifically for physical-world humanoid control. The core idea of ForgetMimic is as follows: given a policy $\pi_\theta$ trained on $N$ motions, our method degrades performance on a target subset of $K$ motions while preserving the effectiveness of the remaining $N-K$ motions. Furthermore, we identify and resolve two key training mechanisms in robot control that lead to unlearning failure. We conduct extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 and H2 humanoid robots across 12 motions, including Dance, Fight, Flip, and others. Experimental results demonstrate that ForgetMimic effectively eliminates memory of designated motions while maintaining the normal operation of all other motions.

title_cn: ForgetMimic：面向强化学习人形机器人控制的动作遗忘
abstract_cn: 借助人类示范，人形机器人控制已通过强化学习（RL）实现了多样、敏捷且自然的运动行为。尽管这一范式在物理人形机器人控制中取得了显著性能，如何从已学得的策略中消除特定动作仍未得到充分探索。解决这一问题源于紧迫的安全与隐私关切：移除恶意、被投毒或次优的动作，以及受版权保护、适用 GDPR 等法规下被遗忘权的动作，至关重要。为此，我们提出 ForgetMimic，首个专为物理世界人形机器人控制设计的动作级遗忘方法。ForgetMimic 的核心思想是：给定一个在 N 个动作上训练的策略 π_θ，我们的方法降低其在 K 个目标动作子集上的表现，同时保持其余 N-K 个动作的有效性。此外，我们识别并解决了机器人控制中导致遗忘失败的两个关键训练机制。我们在 Unitree G1 与 H2 人形机器人上针对 12 个动作（包括 Dance、Fight、Flip 等）开展了大量实验。实验结果表明，ForgetMimic 能有效消除对指定动作的记忆，同时维持其他所有动作的正常运行。
summary_cn: 提出首个面向 RL 人形机器人控制的动作级遗忘方法 ForgetMimic，在 Unitree G1/H2 的 12 个动作上消除指定动作并保留其余动作表现。
objective_summary: 提出从已训练人形控制策略中移除指定动作子集的遗忘方法，分析并处理两个导致遗忘失败的训练机制，在两款机器人 12 个动作上实验验证。
evidence_note: 两款人形机器人、12 个动作的实验；摘要未报告量化指标、基线对比与统计检验。
novelty_note: 自称首个面向人形 RL 控制的动作级遗忘方法，并指出机器人控制中两个导致遗忘失败的训练机制。
scope: 结论限于基于人类示范训练的 RL 人形控制策略、Unitree G1/H2 与所测 12 个动作。
limitations: 动作与平台数量有限；遗忘后能否被再训练恢复等对抗性检验摘要未涉及。

title: A Gmail-Based Phishing Detection Prototype for Nigerian Fintech Emails Using Sender Checks and BiLSTM Classification
abstract: Phishing emails that impersonate Nigerian fintech providers can combine deceptive sender addresses, lookalike links, and locally familiar language. This study presents a Gmail browser extension that integrates sender-domain and URL checks with a bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) classifier. The extension compares visible sender addresses and links with profiles for eight fintech platforms, obtains a phishing probability from a locally hosted Flask service, and displays a legitimate, warning, or phishing verdict when an email is opened. The BiLSTM classifier was evaluated on 8,943 test messages from a cleaned dataset of 59,622 phishing and legitimate emails. The test confusion matrix recorded 4,308 true negatives, no false positives, one false negative, and 4,634 true positives. These counts correspond to 99.99% accuracy, 100.00% precision, 99.98% recall, and 99.99% F1 score. Tokenized sequence analysis identified 5.79% overlap between the training and test sets, which may inflate performance estimates for independent messages. A Gmail demonstration showed the integrated extension producing user-visible verdicts, although the complete system was not evaluated on a labeled test set. The findings establish the feasibility of the implemented prototype while leaving its end-to-end detection performance and generalization to unseen attacks open for further evaluation.

title_cn: 基于发件人检查与 BiLSTM 分类的尼日利亚金融科技邮件 Gmail 钓鱼检测原型
abstract_cn: 冒充尼日利亚金融科技服务商的钓鱼邮件可能结合具有欺骗性的发件人地址、仿冒链接和本地常见的语言表达。本研究提出一个 Gmail 浏览器扩展，将发件人域名与 URL 检查同双向长短期记忆（BiLSTM）分类器相结合。该扩展将可见的发件人地址与链接同八个金融科技平台的档案进行比对，从本地托管的 Flask 服务获取钓鱼概率，并在打开邮件时显示「合法」「警告」或「钓鱼」判定。BiLSTM 分类器在一个经清洗、包含 59,622 封钓鱼与合法邮件的数据集中的 8,943 封测试邮件上进行了评估。测试混淆矩阵记录了 4,308 个真阴性、0 个假阳性、1 个假阴性和 4,634 个真阳性。这些计数对应 99.99% 的准确率、100.00% 的精确率、99.98% 的召回率和 99.99% 的 F1 分数。分词序列分析发现训练集与测试集之间存在 5.79% 的重叠，这可能使针对独立邮件的性能估计偏高。Gmail 演示显示集成后的扩展能够产生用户可见的判定，但完整系统未在带标签的测试集上进行评估。这些发现确立了所实现原型的可行性，而其端到端检测性能及对未见攻击的泛化能力仍有待进一步评估。
summary_cn: Gmail 钓鱼检测扩展结合发件人与 URL 检查和 BiLSTM，BiLSTM 测试准确率 99.99%，但训练与测试重叠 5.79%，完整系统未做标注评估。
objective_summary: 实现面向尼日利亚金融科技钓鱼邮件的 Gmail 扩展原型，在 59,622 封邮件数据集的 8,943 封测试集上评估 BiLSTM 分类器，并以演示展示集成效果。
evidence_note: 单一测试集 8,943 封、无 baseline 对比；训练与测试有 5.79% 重叠，完整系统未做标注评估。
novelty_note: 发件人规则检查加 BiLSTM 分类属常规组合，特色在面向尼日利亚金融科技的本地化场景。
scope: 结论限于所用清洗数据集与八个尼日利亚金融科技平台档案，量化结果仅针对 BiLSTM 组件。
limitations: 作者自陈训练与测试存在重叠，端到端系统性能及对未见攻击的泛化均未评估。

title: Contraction and Statistical Inference under Privacy for Uniformly Bounded Distributions
abstract: We investigate $c$-interior pointwise maximal leakage (PML) as a tool for contraction analyses and disclosure control. Based on the strong adversarial threat models from maximal leakage, $c$-interior PML generalizes local differential privacy (LDP) to data-generating distributions with densities uniformly bounded away from zero by $c>0$. Viewing $c$-interior PML as an algebraic constraint on a kernel yields more flexible (and often tighter) contraction analyses than standard LDP. We provide tight bounds on the Dobrushin coefficient, and bound the contraction coefficient of the Hockeystick-divergence. We further derive strong data processing inequalities on $f$-divergences under $c$-interior PML constraints when the input distributions to the divergence are restricted to be in the $c$-interior. These results extend beyond the regime of pure LDP to cover a larger class of kernels, including, e.g., arbitrary stochastic matrices. We apply the results to minimax theory and provide asymptotically optimal strategies under $c$-interior PML constraints for binary hypothesis testing and mean estimation. The results show that disclosure control with PML allows analysts to reason about systems in a more differentiated manner: For example, it allows us to quantify the privacy leakage of deterministic systems, and can give precise adversarial guarantees with respect to arbitrary distributional assumptions. Interestingly, a recurring theme in the disclosure analyses is that if the privacy problem is relatively regular (if the density bound $c$ is large), private inference can be possible without incurring any additional cost in terms of sample complexity.
title_cn: 一致有界分布下隐私约束的收缩性与统计推断
abstract_cn: 我们研究 c-内部逐点最大泄露（c-interior pointwise maximal leakage，PML）作为收缩分析与披露控制工具的作用。基于最大泄露中的强对手威胁模型，c-内部 PML 将本地差分隐私（LDP）推广到密度一致有下界 c>0（即一致远离零）的数据生成分布。将 c-内部 PML 视为对核（kernel）的代数约束，可以得到比标准 LDP 更灵活（且往往更紧）的收缩分析。我们给出 Dobrushin 系数的紧界，并界定了 Hockey-stick 散度的收缩系数。我们进一步推导了在 c-内部 PML 约束下、当散度的输入分布被限制在 c-内部时 f-散度的强数据处理不等式。这些结果超出了纯 LDP 的范围，覆盖更大一类核，例如任意随机矩阵。我们将这些结果应用于极小极大理论，给出 c-内部 PML 约束下二元假设检验与均值估计的渐近最优策略。结果表明，基于 PML 的披露控制使分析者能够以更细致区分的方式推理系统：例如，它允许量化确定性系统的隐私泄露，并能针对任意分布假设给出精确的对抗保证。有趣的是，披露分析中反复出现的一个主题是：若隐私问题相对规则（即密度下界 c 较大），隐私推断可以在样本复杂度上不产生任何额外代价。
summary_cn: 研究把 LDP 推广到密度有下界 c 的 c-内部逐点最大泄露（PML），给出 Dobrushin 系数紧界与 f-散度强数据处理不等式，并得到二元假设检验与均值估计的渐近最优策略。
objective_summary: 以核的代数约束视角分析 c-内部 PML 下的收缩系数与强数据处理不等式，并应用于二元假设检验和均值估计的极小极大分析。
evidence_note: 纯理论工作，给出紧界、强数据处理不等式与渐近最优策略；无实证实验，证明细节摘要中无法核查。
novelty_note: 把 PML 视为核的代数约束做收缩分析，扩展到纯 LDP 之外的核类，属已有方向的实质推进。
scope: 结论限于密度一致有下界 c 的数据生成分布与 PML 对手威胁模型。
limitations: 依赖密度下界 c 的分布假设，c 较小时优势减弱；缺少真实数据或系统上的应用演示。

title: Physalia: Redistribution-Resistant Content Protection for Decentralized Storage
abstract: In decentralized storage systems, access control is often implemented by encrypting the data before upload and sharing the decryption key with authorized parties. A leaked key, however, makes the data publicly accessible, which lowers the barrier to content piracy below that of traditional systems, where piracy requires redistributing the full data. We present Physalia, an end-to-end access-control system for decentralized storage that secret-shares the data itself, instead of just the key, across multiple servers. Leaking the data then requires transmitting it in full: We formalize this intuition and introduce the redistribution bandwidth an adversary must pay to leak protected content and show that Physalia raises it to the size of the data. Sharing across untrusted servers requires robustness against corrupted shares. We develop a robustness transform that turns any computational secret sharing scheme into a robust one and which is of independent interest. In contrast to existing schemes that rely on error correction, it uses signatures with ephemeral keys and adds only constant-size metadata per share. We show that this transform is secure and evaluate Physalia end-to-end on the Walrus decentralized storage system with an on-chain access policy.
title_cn: Physalia：面向去中心化存储的抗再分发内容保护
abstract_cn: 在去中心化存储系统中，访问控制通常通过在上传前加密数据、并与授权方共享解密密钥来实现。然而，一旦密钥泄露，数据便可被公开访问，这使内容盗版的门槛低于传统系统——在传统系统中，盗版需要重新分发完整数据。我们提出 Physalia，一个面向去中心化存储的端到端访问控制系统，它将数据本身（而不仅是密钥）以秘密共享的方式分布到多个服务器上。这样一来，泄露数据就需要完整传输数据：我们将这一直觉形式化，引入对手泄露受保护内容所必须付出的再分发带宽，并证明 Physalia 将其提升到数据本身的大小。在不可信服务器间共享需要对被篡改的份额具备鲁棒性。我们设计了一种鲁棒性变换，可将任意计算型秘密共享方案转化为鲁棒方案，该变换本身也具有独立价值。与依赖纠错的现有方案不同，它使用临时密钥签名，且每个份额只增加常数大小的元数据。我们证明了该变换是安全的，并在 Walrus 去中心化存储系统上结合链上访问策略对 Physalia 进行了端到端评估。
summary_cn: Physalia 对数据本身而非仅密钥做秘密共享，使泄露须付出与数据等大的再分发带宽，并给出每份额仅增常数元数据的通用鲁棒性变换，在 Walrus 上端到端评估。
objective_summary: 形式化再分发带宽并设计基于数据秘密共享的访问控制系统与鲁棒性变换，给出变换的安全性证明，并在 Walrus 存储系统上结合链上访问策略做端到端评估。
evidence_note: 给出再分发带宽形式化与变换安全性证明，并在 Walrus 上端到端实现；摘要未报告性能数值与基线对比。
novelty_note: 提出再分发带宽这一安全度量，并以临时密钥签名替代纠错实现通用鲁棒秘密共享。
scope: 适用于多服务器去中心化存储与链上访问策略，安全性依赖秘密共享的门限假设。
limitations: 只提高泄露成本而非阻止泄露，授权用户仍可完整转发数据；存储与带宽开销摘要未量化。

title: ODPure: Backdoor Purification for Object Detection via Ensemble Corruption Consensus
abstract: With the development of applications like autonomous driving, object detection has gained significant attention, while also highlighting critical vulnerabilities like backdoor attacks that severely compromise model integrity. Specifically, such attacks involve altering the categories of objects (i.e., object misclassification), removing bounding boxes (i.e., object disappearance), or generating bounding box proposals for non-existent objects (i.e., object generation) when a predefined trigger is present in the input. Although backdoor defenses for image classification are well-established, the research for object detection remains comparatively underexplored. Existing defenses address these threats by scanning outputs or models for potential backdoors but require discarding either malicious data or models. This remedy fails to enable a continuous and accurate perceptual stream for the object detection pipeline. To address such limitations, we propose ODPure, a novel input-stage black-box defense for object detection, which is based on input purification that ensures stable perception flows. Tailored to the dense prediction nature of object detectors, our Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection (CRS) paradigm operates by neutralizing triggers through a diverse portfolio of corruptions to generate a massive pool of redundant proposals, then recovering fine-grained structural cues via generative priors, and finally employing voting to reach a consensus on the resulting detections. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method provides robust defense against diverse backdoor attacks and trigger types while preserving baseline accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure.
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures (including supplementary materials); Code available at this https URL
title_cn: ODPure：基于集成损坏共识的目标检测后门净化
abstract_cn: 随着自动驾驶等应用的发展，目标检测受到广泛关注，同时也暴露出后门攻击等严重损害模型完整性的关键漏洞。具体而言，当输入中存在预定义触发器时，此类攻击会改变物体类别（即物体误分类）、移除边界框（即物体消失），或为不存在的物体生成边界框候选（即物体生成）。尽管针对图像分类的后门防御已较为成熟，面向目标检测的研究仍相对不足。现有防御通过扫描输出或模型来发现潜在后门以应对这些威胁，但需要丢弃恶意数据或模型。这种补救方式无法为目标检测流水线提供连续且准确的感知流。为解决这些局限，我们提出 ODPure，一种面向目标检测的新型输入阶段黑盒防御，它基于输入净化，确保稳定的感知流。针对目标检测器的密集预测特性，我们的损坏-重建-选择（Corruption-Reconstruction-Selection，CRS）范式首先通过多样化的损坏组合中和触发器，生成大量冗余候选框；然后借助生成式先验恢复细粒度结构线索；最后通过投票就所得检测结果达成共识。全面的实验表明，我们的方法能够对多种后门攻击与触发器类型提供稳健防御，同时保持基线精度。代码已公开：https://github.com/Alex66366/ODPure。
summary_cn: 提出输入阶段黑盒防御 ODPure，以多样化损坏中和触发器、生成式先验重建、投票共识三步净化目标检测输入，应对误分类、消失、生成三类后门并保持精度；代码公开。
objective_summary: 提出损坏-重建-选择的输入净化范式防御目标检测后门，在多种后门攻击与触发器类型上实验验证防御效果与干净精度保持。
evidence_note: 摘要称覆盖多种攻击与触发器类型的全面实验，但未给出数据集、指标数值与对比基线。
novelty_note: 将输入净化与集成投票适配到目标检测的密集预测，区别于需丢弃数据或模型的扫描式防御。
scope: 适用于黑盒访问下的目标检测模型与所测后门攻击和触发器类型。
limitations: 大量损坏与生成式重建带来推理开销；对自适应攻击者的鲁棒性摘要未提及。

title: MimicSat: A Reconfigurable Cyber-Physical Testbed For Small Satellite Systems and Cybersecurity Research
abstract: MimicSat provides a common experimental environment for examining how changes in satellite subsystem behavior propagate to mission outcomes across software-based and hardware-based execution. Its design is motivated by controlled spacecraft cybersecurity studies involving attacks, faults, and defensive responses. In MimicSat, a mission encompasses the spacecraft and ground activities required to achieve defined objectives, and an experiment consists of one or more mission runs used to study selected conditions or interventions. To support such studies, MimicSat offers software-based and hardware-based execution environments that implement the same mission functions and data exchanges, while allowing specific functions to be realized differently. A shared mission definition preserves command and telemetry semantics across environments, and collected observations retain provenance about the originating participants and acquisition paths. As a result, mission behavior can be compared across execution configurations without redefining the surrounding mission. This paper presents the architectural principles of MimicSat, its software and hardware execution forms, and their integrated operation. MimicSat also supports satellite systems engineering, mission operations, resilience studies, and related experimental use cases.
comment: First two listed authors have equal contributions
title_cn: MimicSat：面向小卫星系统与网络安全研究的可重构信息物理测试床
abstract_cn: MimicSat 提供了一个通用实验环境，用于考察卫星子系统行为的变化如何在基于软件与基于硬件的执行中传播到任务结果。其设计动机来自涉及攻击、故障与防御响应的受控航天器网络安全研究。在 MimicSat 中，一次任务涵盖实现既定目标所需的航天器与地面活动，一次实验则由一个或多个任务运行组成，用于研究选定的条件或干预。为支持此类研究，MimicSat 提供基于软件和基于硬件的执行环境，二者实现相同的任务功能与数据交换，同时允许特定功能以不同方式实现。共享的任务定义在不同环境间保持指令与遥测语义一致，采集到的观测数据保留了关于来源参与方与获取路径的溯源信息。因此，无需重新定义周边任务即可在不同执行配置之间比较任务行为。本文介绍了 MimicSat 的架构原则、其软件与硬件执行形式以及二者的集成运行。MimicSat 还支持卫星系统工程、任务运营、韧性研究及相关实验用例。
summary_cn: 提出小卫星信息物理测试床 MimicSat，软件与硬件执行环境共享任务定义并保留观测溯源，可跨配置比较攻击、故障与防御对任务结果的影响。
objective_summary: 描述 MimicSat 的架构原则、软硬件两种执行形式及其集成运行方式，摘要未报告实验评估。
evidence_note: 仅描述架构与软硬件实现形式，摘要未报告任何实验、量化评估或对比。
novelty_note: 新意在于软硬件执行共享同一任务定义并保留观测溯源，偏工程整合。
scope: 适用于小卫星任务的受控实验场景，与真实在轨系统的保真度差距未说明。
limitations: 摘要未给出任何攻击或故障实验结果，测试床的保真度与实用性尚未经实证检验。
institution: The University of Texas at San Antonio

title: Pinpointing Super-Quadratic Quantum Enumeration Speedups: Exact and Certified Evaluation of the Guessing-Moment Exponent under Product-Distribution Advice
abstract: Grover's algorithm gives an optimal quadratic query advantage for black-box search. In cryptanalysis, however, the search often comes with additional probabilistic advice over the candidates, frequently of product form, e.g. from side-channel leakage on independent key coordinates. Classically, guessing in likelihood order is optimal in expectation. In the quantum setting, Montanaro showed how to achieve an optimal expected query complexity, beating plain Grover on every non-uniform advice distribution (up to a constant overhead factor). What has been missing so far is a finite-size method for evaluating the quantum-classical guessing-moment separation induced by a given advice distribution. We provide such a method for product-distribution advice, thereby sharpening the previous entropy-based estimate of Bashiri et al. We reduce the classical and quantum guessing moments to functionals of the one-dimensional surprisal distribution, obtained for product advice by convolving the per-coordinate surprisal laws. When the surprisals lie on a common arithmetic grid (the commensurate case), the logarithmic moments and hence the speedup exponent can be evaluated as finite sums without discretization error; exponential tilting makes this computation numerically stable. For general product advice, we discretize the surprisals onto a common grid and derive an a-posteriori bound on the resulting binning error. We apply the framework to cold-boot leakage on seeds and block-cipher keys, to template-attack posteriors, and to synthetic i.i.d. Bernoulli posteriors calibrated to residual ranks reported for Keccak side-channel attacks on ML-KEM and ML-DSA. The resulting exponents substantially exceed 2 in several skewed-advice settings, reaching up to 3.97 in these synthetic models, and include cases where the previous entropy-based bound did not establish an exponent above 2.
comment: 19 pages, 2 tables, accepted at PQQS '26
title_cn: 精确定位超二次量子枚举加速：乘积分布辅助信息下猜测矩指数的精确与可认证评估
abstract_cn: Grover 算法为黑盒搜索提供了最优的二次查询优势。然而在密码分析中，搜索往往伴随关于候选项的额外概率性辅助信息（advice），且常为乘积形式，例如来自独立密钥坐标上的侧信道泄露。在经典情形下，按似然顺序猜测在期望意义上是最优的。在量子情形下，Montanaro 展示了如何达到最优的期望查询复杂度，在每一种非均匀辅助分布上都优于朴素 Grover（至多相差一个常数开销因子）。迄今所缺少的，是一种用于评估给定辅助分布所诱导的量子与经典猜测矩分离的有限规模方法。我们针对乘积分布辅助信息给出了这样一种方法，从而改进了 Bashiri 等人此前基于熵的估计。我们将经典与量子猜测矩归约为一维惊奇度（surprisal）分布的泛函；对于乘积辅助信息，该分布通过对各坐标的惊奇度分布作卷积得到。当惊奇度位于同一算术网格上（可公度情形）时，对数矩以及由此得到的加速指数可作为有限和精确求值，没有离散化误差；指数倾斜（exponential tilting）使该计算在数值上稳定。对于一般的乘积辅助信息，我们将惊奇度离散化到公共网格上，并推导出由此产生的分箱误差的后验界。我们将该框架应用于种子与分组密码密钥上的冷启动（cold-boot）泄露、模板攻击的后验分布，以及按已报道的针对 ML-KEM 与 ML-DSA 的 Keccak 侧信道攻击残余秩校准的合成独立同分布 Bernoulli 后验。所得指数在若干偏斜辅助信息设置下显著超过 2，在这些合成模型中最高达到 3.97，其中包括先前基于熵的界未能确立指数大于 2 的情形。
summary_cn: 为乘积分布辅助信息给出量子与经典猜测矩分离指数的有限规模精确求值与离散误差后验界，应用于冷启动与侧信道后验，合成模型中指数最高达 3.97（PQQS'26）。
objective_summary: 将猜测矩归约为一维惊奇度分布的泛函，给出可公度情形的精确有限和与一般情形的分箱误差后验界，并在冷启动、模板攻击与合成 Bernoulli 后验上数值计算加速指数。
evidence_note: 给出归约、精确求值与分箱误差后验界的推导，并在多类泄露模型上数值应用；最高指数来自合成模型。
novelty_note: 填补有限规模量子与经典猜测矩分离评估方法的空缺，较 Bashiri 等人的熵估计更紧。
scope: 结论限于乘积形式辅助分布与 Montanaro 式量子猜测下的期望查询复杂度。
limitations: 最显著的指数来自合成模型；分析以查询复杂度为度量，未涉及实际量子资源开销。

title: Do Electromagnetic Side-Channel Attacks Threaten Electronic Polling Stations? Scenarios and Recommendations
abstract: This paper investigates the threat to ballot secrecy in the Brazilian electronic voting machine (UEB) posed by electromagnetic side-channel attacks, also known as TEMPEST attacks. In these attacks, screen content can be reconstructed remotely by intercepting electromagnetic emanations associated with the target device's video signal. This work is motivated by a recent ruling by a Brazilian electoral court concerning an attempt to violate ballot secrecy using electronic equipment. Based on publicly available information about the electoral system, attack scenarios against polling stations are proposed. Experiments using software-defined radio show that the effectiveness of TEMPEST attacks strongly depends on the lack of oversight resulting from public unawareness of the threat. Finally, awareness guidelines are proposed for voters, poll workers, and party representatives to mitigate attack risks within a polling station.
comment: English version of work originally published in Portuguese in the XXVI Proceedings of the Brazilian Symposium on Cybersecurity (SBSEG), 2026
title_cn: 电磁侧信道攻击是否威胁电子投票站？场景与建议
abstract_cn: 本文研究电磁侧信道攻击（又称 TEMPEST 攻击）对巴西电子投票机（UEB）选票保密性构成的威胁。在此类攻击中，通过截获与目标设备视频信号相关的电磁辐射，可以远程重建屏幕内容。本工作的动机来自巴西一家选举法院近期就一起利用电子设备企图破坏选票保密性事件所作的裁决。基于选举系统的公开信息，本文提出了针对投票站的攻击场景。使用软件定义无线电（SDR）的实验表明，TEMPEST 攻击的有效性在很大程度上取决于公众对该威胁缺乏认识所导致的监督缺失。最后，本文为选民、投票站工作人员和政党代表提出了提高威胁意识的指南，以降低投票站内的攻击风险。
summary_cn: 分析 TEMPEST 电磁侧信道对巴西电子投票机选票保密性的威胁，提出投票站攻击场景，SDR 实验显示攻击效果主要取决于监督缺失，并给出意识指南（SBSEG 2026 葡文版英译）。
objective_summary: 基于公开的选举系统信息构建投票站攻击场景，用软件定义无线电实验评估 TEMPEST 屏幕重建攻击的可行条件，并据此提出面向各方的意识指南。
evidence_note: 有 SDR 实验，但摘要未报告距离、重建质量等量化指标，无对照与统计检验。
novelty_note: TEMPEST 屏幕重建为已知攻击，新意在于面向巴西投票站流程的场景化威胁分析。
scope: 结论限于巴西 UEB 投票机及其投票站流程，场景依据公开信息推断。
limitations: 实验条件与真实投票站的差距未量化；缓解措施仅为意识指南，未评估技术性防护。

title: GUIAuditor: Enabling Post-hoc Child Safety Forensics via Action-Guided GUI Provenance on Mobile Devices
abstract: The proliferation of smart devices exposes children to online risks like grooming and financial scams that are deeply embedded within legitimate applications. Current approaches rely on automated prevention and detection, a paradigm that is fundamentally limited by its inherent fallibility. Whether rule-based or AI-driven, they inevitably produce false positives and negatives, failing to provide reliable protection. In this paper, we argue for a complementary, human-in-the-loop, post-hoc forensic paradigm. We present GUIAuditor, the first system designed to realize this vision by creating GUI Provenance: a queryable, semantic record of a child's interaction sequence. To generate this, GUIAuditor leverages a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to translate the temporal sequence of GUI events into a human-understandable narrative. To make this practical on mobile devices, a novel evidence distillation pipeline reduces the data requiring analysis by over 89.2% compared to periodic sampling approaches adopted by industry standards, with negligible impact on accuracy. On a new dataset of 295 interaction clips, GUIAuditor achieves a 95.23% Macro-F1 Score in logging significant events and, crucially, its two-stage forensic query engine successfully retrieves the correct evidence as the top result for over 90.20% of natural language questions. An end-to-end evaluation on three modern smartphones shows that the full pipeline, including on-device MLLM inference, adds 2.1W of power draw and 7.4s of per-event latency, with a peak memory footprint of ${\sim}$3.1GB. These results show that post-hoc GUI forensics can run on modern mobile devices and provide useful context for guardian-led safety review.
comment: Accepted by ACM IMWUT/Ubicomp 2026
title_cn: GUIAuditor：通过动作引导的 GUI 溯源实现移动设备上的事后儿童安全取证
abstract_cn: 智能设备的普及使儿童暴露于深度嵌入合法应用中的网络风险，如诱骗（grooming）与金融诈骗。现有方法依赖自动化的预防与检测，这一范式因其固有的易错性而存在根本局限。无论基于规则还是由 AI 驱动，它们都不可避免地产生误报与漏报，无法提供可靠的保护。本文主张一种互补的、人在回路的事后取证范式。我们提出 GUIAuditor，这是首个为实现这一愿景而设计的系统，它构建 GUI 溯源（GUI Provenance）：一种关于儿童交互序列的可查询语义记录。为生成该记录，GUIAuditor 利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将 GUI 事件的时间序列转换为人类可理解的叙述。为使其在移动设备上切实可行，一种新的证据蒸馏流水线相比行业标准所采用的周期性采样方法，将需要分析的数据量减少了 89.2% 以上，且对准确率的影响可忽略。在一个包含 295 个交互片段的新数据集上，GUIAuditor 记录重要事件的 Macro-F1 达到 95.23%；更关键的是，其两阶段取证查询引擎对超过 90.20% 的自然语言问题能将正确证据作为首位结果检索出来。在三款现代智能手机上的端到端评估显示，包括端侧 MLLM 推理在内的完整流水线增加 2.1W 功耗和每事件 7.4 秒延迟，峰值内存占用约 3.1GB。这些结果表明，事后 GUI 取证可以在现代移动设备上运行，并为监护人主导的安全审查提供有用的上下文。
summary_cn: GUIAuditor 以端侧 MLLM 生成儿童手机 GUI 溯源记录，分析数据量减少逾 89.2%，事件记录 Macro-F1 95.23%，首位检索命中逾 90.20%（IMWUT/UbiComp 2026）。
objective_summary: 构建基于 MLLM 的移动端 GUI 溯源与两阶段取证查询系统，在 295 个交互片段的自建数据集及三款手机上评估事件记录准确率、检索率与功耗延迟开销。
evidence_note: 自建 295 片段数据集、与周期性采样对比、三款手机端到端开销测量；数据集规模小，未见统计检验。
novelty_note: 提出人在回路的事后取证范式与 GUI 溯源概念，区别于自动预防与检测思路。
scope: 结论适用于所测三款手机、295 片段自建数据集与所用端侧 MLLM 配置。
limitations: 数据集小且为自建；每事件 7.4 秒延迟与约 3.1GB 内存可能限制在低配设备上部署。

title: Safety-Aware Zero Trust Enforcement for IoT and Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: Zero Trust (ZT) replaces the implicit trust of perimeter-based security with explicit, continuous, context-aware authorization. This shift is particularly relevant to IoT and cyber-physical systems, whose heterogeneous, long-lived, and remotely connected components make persistent trust untenable. Yet their physical coupling complicates ZT adoption: restricting a suspicious component can reduce cyber exposure while removing telemetry or control capabilities required for operation. Existing work mainly models physical harm caused by attacks, with less attention to consequences introduced by enforcement itself. We introduce Safety-Aware Zero Trust (SA-ZT), which treats restriction-induced physical consequences as policy inputs. We map the NIST ZT tenets to nine IoT/CPS convergence strains, distinguish IoT-amplified challenges from those specific to cyber-physical coupling, and derive corresponding operational requirements. SA-ZT extends the NIST ZT Architecture with a Safety Engine and a Telemetry Broker. The Safety Engine selects among admissible responses by jointly considering residual cyber risk and restriction-induced consequences, while the Telemetry Broker mediates raw telemetry visibility and estimator influence. With command-side enforcement, these entities separate raw visibility, automated influence, and state-changing authority, preserving observations for monitoring while constraining their influence on automated control. An IEEE 30-bus case study under false-data-injection attack illustrates how SA-ZT makes cyber containment, telemetry visibility and influence, physical consequences, and authorization timing explicit, providing an implementable and inspectable representation of cyber-physical enforcement trade-offs.
title_cn: 面向物联网与信息物理系统的安全感知（Safety-Aware）零信任执行
abstract_cn: 零信任（ZT）以显式、持续、上下文感知的授权取代基于边界的安全中的隐式信任。这一转变对物联网（IoT）与信息物理系统（CPS）尤为重要：其组件异构、生命周期长且远程互联，使持久信任难以成立。然而，这类系统的物理耦合使 ZT 的采用变得复杂：限制可疑组件虽能降低网络暴露，却可能同时移除运行所需的遥测或控制能力。现有工作主要建模攻击造成的物理危害，较少关注执行措施本身引入的后果。我们提出安全感知零信任（Safety-Aware Zero Trust，SA-ZT），将限制措施引发的物理后果作为策略输入。我们将 NIST ZT 原则映射到九种 IoT/CPS 融合张力（convergence strains），区分被 IoT 放大的挑战与信息物理耦合特有的挑战，并推导出相应的运行需求。SA-ZT 在 NIST ZT 架构中扩展了安全引擎（Safety Engine）与遥测代理（Telemetry Broker）。安全引擎综合考虑残余网络风险与限制引发的后果，在可接受的响应中进行选择；遥测代理则居间管控原始遥测的可见性及其对估计器的影响。结合命令侧执行，这些实体将原始可见性、自动化影响与改变状态的权限相分离，在保留观测数据用于监控的同时约束其对自动控制的影响。一个遭受虚假数据注入攻击的 IEEE 30 节点系统案例研究展示了 SA-ZT 如何使网络遏制、遥测可见性与影响、物理后果以及授权时机显式化，从而为信息物理执行中的权衡提供可实现、可检查的表示。
summary_cn: 提出 SA-ZT，把零信任限制措施本身引发的物理后果纳入策略输入，在 NIST ZT 架构上增设安全引擎与遥测代理，并以 IEEE 30 节点虚假数据注入案例演示。
objective_summary: 将 NIST 零信任原则映射到九类 IoT/CPS 融合张力并扩展其架构，以 IEEE 30 节点电网虚假数据注入案例说明执行权衡的显式表示。
evidence_note: 仅一个 IEEE 30 节点案例研究作示意，摘要未给出 baseline 对比或量化统计结果。
novelty_note: 把执行措施本身的物理后果作为零信任策略输入，区别于只建模攻击危害的既有工作。
scope: 结论基于 NIST ZT 架构与 IEEE 30 节点电网案例，其他 CPS 类型未验证。
limitations: 验证仅为单一 IEEE 30 节点案例研究，未见实际部署开销与大规模系统可扩展性的评估。

title: No Place to Hide: An Analysis on Protected Order Flow Sandwich Attacks
abstract: Front-running has long plagued Ethereum's public mempool, earning it the nickname of a "dark forest", where predators lurk for profitable transactions. In response, Ethereum and other blockchain ecosystems increasingly rely on private RPCs and native protections to shield transactions from adversaries, which we refer to as protected order flow. Yet the effectiveness of these mechanisms in preventing front-running, and what trust assumptions they entail, remain poorly understood. In this work, we conduct the first longitudinal, three-year measurement study of sandwich attacks against protected order flow across six blockchains: Ethereum, Solana, Tron, Base, Arbitrum, and Monad. We introduce detection heuristics that capture wide attacks, both within and across blocks, and filter on bot behavior to distinguish sandwiches from legitimate trading activity. We identify 28.0 million sandwich attacks on Solana, 38,567 on Tron, 30,607 on Ethereum, and 1,889 on Base against transactions intended to be protected from front-running. Reorged blocks expose a further 2,875 Ethereum victims. Unlike conventional public-mempool sandwiches, these attacks rarely occur tightly around their victims and, outside Solana, are carried out by a small number of entities. Our analysis uncovers exposures at every layer: validator- and application-level exposure on Solana, order-flow auctions and reorged blocks on Ethereum, first-come-first-served ordering that fails to prevent latency-based front-running on Tron, and both an RPC bug that exposes pending transactions and predictable victim behavior on Base. These findings show that existing front-running protections can provide substantially weaker guarantees than users expect, highlighting the need for stronger end-to-end defenses against sandwich attacks.
title_cn: 无处可藏：受保护订单流上的三明治攻击分析
abstract_cn: 抢跑（front-running）长期困扰以太坊的公共内存池（mempool），使其得名「黑暗森林」——掠食者潜伏其中，伺机捕猎有利可图的交易。作为应对，以太坊及其他区块链生态日益依赖私有 RPC 与原生保护机制来使交易免受对手侵害，我们将其称为受保护订单流（protected order flow）。然而，这些机制防止抢跑的实际效果及其所隐含的信任假设仍鲜为人知。本文首次开展针对受保护订单流的三明治攻击的三年纵向测量研究，覆盖六条区块链：Ethereum、Solana、Tron、Base、Arbitrum 与 Monad。我们提出能够捕获区块内与跨区块「宽」攻击的检测启发式，并基于机器人行为进行过滤，以区分三明治攻击与正常交易活动。针对本应免受抢跑的交易，我们在 Solana 上识别出 2,800 万次三明治攻击，在 Tron 上 38,567 次，在 Ethereum 上 30,607 次，在 Base 上 1,889 次。重组（reorg）区块另外暴露了 2,875 名 Ethereum 受害者。与传统公共内存池中的三明治攻击不同，这些攻击很少紧贴受害交易发生，且在 Solana 之外由少数实体实施。我们的分析揭示了每一层的暴露面：Solana 上的验证者层与应用层暴露；Ethereum 上的订单流拍卖与重组区块；Tron 上无法阻止基于延迟的抢跑的先到先服务排序；以及 Base 上一个暴露待处理交易的 RPC 缺陷和可预测的受害者行为。这些发现表明，现有抢跑保护所提供的保障可能远弱于用户预期，凸显了对更强的端到端三明治攻击防御的需求。
summary_cn: 三年六链纵向测量受保护订单流的三明治攻击：Solana 2,800 万次、Tron 38,567、Ethereum 30,607、Base 1,889，并定位各链保护失效层级。
objective_summary: 设计覆盖区块内与跨区块的宽攻击检测启发式并按机器人行为过滤，对六条区块链三年链上数据做纵向测量，统计受保护交易遭三明治攻击的规模与成因。
evidence_note: 六条链三年链上数据，仅 Solana 即识别 2,800 万次攻击并逐链分析成因；摘要未报告检测启发式的准确率验证。
novelty_note: 首个针对私有 RPC 等受保护订单流的多链纵向测量，揭示此前未被量化的保护失效。
scope: 结论限于所测六条区块链、三年时间窗与作者定义的检测启发式口径。
limitations: 检测依赖启发式与机器人行为过滤，可能误判或漏检，摘要未报告其误报率与漏报率验证。

title: Your Model Is Leaking: Covert Information Transfer through LLM Residual Streams
abstract: Privacy-sensitive organizations may run large language models (LLMs) in restricted or air-gapped environments while exporting selected diagnostic artifacts. We show that a compromised runtime component can hide sensitive information in intermediate activations that are allowed to leave the restricted environment. An offline observer can recover this information with a simple linear decoder. The attack requires no model retraining or weight modification, no attacker-controlled egress, and no control over the recorder or transfer process. We introduce a residual-stream covert-channel attack that maps messages to codewords and injects them into an intermediate residual stream through a compromised runtime hook. To maintain recoverability, the injection strength is scaled with the local residual norm using the signal-to-residual-norm ratio. Across eleven models from seven architecture families, our evaluation shows 91--100% recovery on nine models with KL divergence 0.001--0.007, while evaluated activation-level detectors remain close to random guessing (AUC <= 0.56). Tested post-hoc defenses do not reliably eliminate the channel. Thus, an activation artifact can be schema-valid while carrying information that is not authorized to cross the boundary.
title_cn: 你的模型正在泄露：通过 LLM 残差流进行隐蔽信息传输
abstract_cn: 对隐私敏感的组织可能在受限或物理隔离的环境中运行大语言模型（LLM），同时导出选定的诊断工件。我们表明，一个被攻陷的运行时组件可以把敏感信息隐藏在被允许离开受限环境的中间激活中。离线观察者可以用一个简单的线性解码器恢复这些信息。该攻击无需重新训练模型或修改权重，无需攻击者控制的外发通道，也无需控制记录器或传输过程。我们提出一种残差流隐蔽信道攻击，它将消息映射为码字，并通过被攻陷的运行时钩子将其注入中间残差流。为保持可恢复性，注入强度依据信号与残差范数之比，随局部残差范数进行缩放。在来自七个架构族的十一个模型上，评估显示其中九个模型的恢复率为 91–100%，KL 散度为 0.001–0.007，而所评估的激活层检测器仍接近随机猜测（AUC ≤ 0.56）。所测试的事后防御无法可靠地消除该信道。因此，激活工件可以在符合模式规范的同时，携带未经授权跨越边界的信息。
summary_cn: 被攻陷的运行时钩子把消息编码注入 LLM 中间残差流，借允许导出的激活诊断工件外泄信息；11 个模型中 9 个恢复率 91–100%、KL 0.001–0.007，激活检测器 AUC ≤ 0.56。
objective_summary: 提出按残差范数比例将码字注入 LLM 中间激活的隐蔽信道攻击，在 11 个模型上评估恢复率、输出分布偏移、激活检测器与事后防御的效果。
evidence_note: 七个架构族共 11 个模型，量化恢复率与 KL 散度，并评估激活层检测器与事后防御；摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 把允许导出的中间激活诊断工件用作隔离环境的外泄载体，属此前少见的隐蔽信道。
scope: 适用于导出中间激活工件的受限或物理隔离 LLM 部署，且运行时组件已被攻陷。
limitations: 前提是运行时组件已被攻陷；11 个模型中 2 个未达所报恢复率；防御结论限于所测方法。

title: Enhancing Multiclass Malware Classification in Resource-Constrained Environments
abstract: The emergence of multi-class malware attacks such as ransomware, spyware, trojans, etc., presents an increasing and serious threat to cybersecurity, particularly in resourceconstrained environments like IoT devices. Existing machine learning models have achieved nearly perfect accuracy in binary malware classification but fall short in terms of classifying malware families and individual malware. Additionally, the complexity of these multi-class malware attacks presents a significant challenge of detection in resource-constrained environments, as multi-class detection usually requires high computational capability. This research bridges the gap by enhancing the detection accuracy of multi-class malware classification as well as developing a lightweight model that can run efficiently on resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we propose a robust, lightweight machine learning model featuring LightGBM classifier with SMOTE oversampling and SOM-US undersampling techniques for data balancing, as well as well-engineered feature selection through Genetic Algorithm. The model performed better than the current state-of-the-art models developed on the same dataset in both malware family classification (4 classes) and individual malware type classification (16 classes) with accuracy of 89.1% and 76% respectively. Thus, maintaining a balance between classification accuracy and computational efficiency in resource-constrained environments. Furthermore, we propose another model using Random Forest classifier with an accuracy of 91.2% in malware family classification and 78.7% in individual malware classification. Demonstrating a significant enhancement in terms of accuracy from the current state-of-the-art models.
title_cn: 在资源受限环境中提升多类恶意软件分类
abstract_cn: 勒索软件、间谍软件、木马等多类恶意软件攻击的出现，对网络安全构成日益严重的威胁，在 IoT 设备等资源受限环境中尤其如此。现有机器学习模型在二分类恶意软件分类上已达到近乎完美的准确率，但在恶意软件家族分类与具体恶意软件分类上仍有不足。此外，这些多类恶意软件攻击的复杂性给资源受限环境中的检测带来了重大挑战，因为多类检测通常需要较高的计算能力。本研究通过提升多类恶意软件分类的检测准确率，并开发能在资源受限设备上高效运行的轻量模型来弥合这一差距。本文提出一个鲁棒的轻量机器学习模型，采用 LightGBM 分类器，结合 SMOTE 过采样与 SOM-US 欠采样进行数据平衡，并通过遗传算法进行精心设计的特征选择。该模型在恶意软件家族分类（4 类）与具体恶意软件类型分类（16 类）上均优于在同一数据集上构建的现有最先进模型，准确率分别为 89.1% 与 76%。由此在资源受限环境中保持了分类准确率与计算效率之间的平衡。此外，我们还提出了另一个使用随机森林分类器的模型，其在恶意软件家族分类上的准确率为 91.2%，在具体恶意软件分类上为 78.7%。这表明相较现有最先进模型在准确率上有显著提升。
summary_cn: 以 LightGBM 加数据平衡与遗传算法特征选择构建轻量多类恶意软件分类器，4 类/16 类准确率 89.1%/76%；随机森林版本为 91.2%/78.7%。
objective_summary: 以 LightGBM 结合过采样、欠采样与遗传算法特征选择构建多类恶意软件分类模型，并在同一数据集上与已有最先进模型比较准确率。
evidence_note: 单一数据集上与同数据集已有模型比较准确率；摘要未点名数据集，未给出资源开销实测或统计检验。
novelty_note: LightGBM、SMOTE、遗传算法特征选择均为成熟组件，贡献主要在组合与调优。
scope: 适用于所用单一数据集上的 4 类家族分类与 16 类具体恶意软件分类任务。
limitations: 「轻量、适合资源受限设备」的主张在摘要中缺少设备端时延或内存等量化证据；仅单一数据集。

title: Shedding Light on Complex Bitcoin Mixer Transactions: 67-Fold Reduction in Unclassified Cases
abstract: Bitcoin's Unspent Transaction Output (UTXO) model enables public analysis of fund flows, but users often merge transactions into Shared Send Mixers (SSMs) to obscure these flows. Untangling SSMs to recover original subtransactions is an NP-complete problem. While a practical untangling algorithm exists, it fails to classify 1.4% of SSM transactions due to computational time limits. This paper introduces four novel heuristics that exploit structural weaknesses in real-world SSM transactions to resolve these timeout cases: preemptive grouping, connectable singleton, ambiguous pairing, and knapsack fallback. We provide theoretical proofs validating each heuristic and integrate them into an optimized pipeline. Applied to timeout transactions, our approach classifies 98.5% of previously unresolved cases, reducing the overall unclassified transaction rate from 1.4% to 0.021% of all SSM transactions. Our open-source implementation and comprehensive evaluation on the complete Bitcoin blockchain demonstrate that the heuristics effectively untangle previously intractable transactions, enabling more accurate flow analysis and deeper structural insights into cryptocurrency transaction patterns.
title_cn: 揭示复杂的比特币混币交易：未分类案例降至原来的 1/67
abstract_cn: 比特币的未花费交易输出（UTXO）模型使资金流可以被公开分析，但用户常把交易合并进共享发送混币器（SSM）以掩盖这些资金流。解缠 SSM 以恢复原始子交易是一个 NP 完全问题。尽管已有一种实用的解缠算法，但由于计算时间限制，它无法对 1.4% 的 SSM 交易进行分类。本文提出四种新的启发式方法，利用真实世界 SSM 交易中的结构弱点来解决这些超时案例：抢先分组、可连接单例、模糊配对与背包回退。我们为每种启发式给出了理论证明，并将它们集成到一个优化的流水线中。应用于超时交易时，我们的方法对此前未解决案例中的 98.5% 完成了分类，将整体未分类交易比例从全部 SSM 交易的 1.4% 降至 0.021%。我们的开源实现以及在完整比特币区块链上的全面评估表明，这些启发式能有效解缠此前难以处理的交易，从而支持更准确的资金流分析，并加深对加密货币交易模式的结构性理解。
summary_cn: 提出抢先分组、可连接单例、模糊配对、背包回退四种附证明的启发式，解缠此前超时的比特币共享发送混币交易，98.5% 得以分类，未分类率由 1.4% 降至 0.021%。
objective_summary: 针对现有 SSM 解缠算法因超时无法分类的交易提出四种启发式并给出理论证明，在完整比特币区块链上评估未分类率的下降。
evidence_note: 在完整比特币区块链上评估并与现有解缠算法对比，启发式附理论证明；摘要未提与真实标注对照的正确率。
novelty_note: 在已有解缠算法上补充针对超时案例的结构性启发式，属已有方向上的实质改进。
scope: 适用于比特币 UTXO 模型下的共享发送混币交易，尤其是原算法超时的子集。
limitations: 启发式依赖现有 SSM 交易的结构弱点，混币构造方式变化后可能失效；仍有 1.5% 超时案例未解决。
institution: Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology

title: ChronosAttack: Adversarial Tool Scheduling Attacks on LLM Agents
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents often process external tool responses as they arrive, making response timing part of the decision process. We introduce ChronosAttack, a delay-only scheduling attack that changes when authentic tool responses arrive without modifying, adding, removing, or accelerating them. Bounded delays can change the order of the same evidence and alter the final decision. We evaluate ChronosAttack on GPT-5.6 Sol, Gemini 3.6 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, and Claude Sonnet 4.6. GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude show strong targeted shifts in vulnerable settings, Gemini shows large shifts in the opposite direction, and DeepSeek is more stable under the tested schedules. We also find that sequential agent state is not always required and that a single scheduling inversion can cause a large decision change. Synchronization and order-consistency defenses reduce attacker control over observation order. These results show that tool-response timing can itself form an attack surface in asynchronous LLM agents.
title_cn: ChronosAttack：针对 LLM 智能体的对抗性工具调度攻击
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常在外部工具响应到达时即对其进行处理，这使响应时序成为决策过程的一部分。我们提出 ChronosAttack，一种仅靠延迟的调度攻击：它只改变真实工具响应的到达时间，而不修改、添加、删除或加速这些响应。有界的延迟即可改变同一批证据的顺序，进而改变最终决策。我们在 GPT-5.6 Sol、Gemini 3.6 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 上评估 ChronosAttack。GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude 在易受影响的设置中表现出强烈的定向偏移，Gemini 表现出相反方向的大幅偏移，而 DeepSeek 在所测试的调度下更为稳定。我们还发现，顺序式的智能体状态并非总是必需的，单次调度倒置即可导致决策的大幅变化。同步与顺序一致性防御降低了攻击者对观测顺序的控制。这些结果表明，在异步 LLM 智能体中，工具响应的时序本身即可构成攻击面。
summary_cn: 提出只延迟、不篡改真实工具响应的调度攻击 ChronosAttack：在四个 LLM 上仅改变证据到达顺序即可改变最终决策，效应方向与强度因模型而异，单次调度倒置即可引发大幅变化。
objective_summary: 提出仅延迟工具响应到达时间的调度攻击，在四个 LLM 上评估其引起的决策偏移，并测试同步与顺序一致性防御的效果。
evidence_note: 覆盖四个模型并含防御评估；摘要未给出任务数、样本量、偏移幅度数值或统计检验。
novelty_note: 把不改内容、只改到达时序的工具响应调度确立为新的攻击面，区别于内容注入类攻击。
scope: 适用于异步处理工具响应的 LLM 智能体，以及所测四个模型与所测调度设置。
limitations: 攻击者需能控制工具响应延迟；各模型效果方向不一，DeepSeek 在所测调度下较稳定。

title: Agentic AI Cybersecurity Framework
abstract: The increasing scale, complexity, and dynamism of modern cyber threats have rendered traditional reactive cybersecurity mechanisms insufficient. This paper introduces an Agentic AI Cybersecurity Framework (AACF) designed to enable autonomous, goal-driven, and adaptive cyber defense operations. Unlike conventional systems that rely on predefined rules and human intervention, the proposed framework leverages agentic artificial intelligence to perceive environmental states, reason about potential threats, and execute context-aware responses with minimal supervision. The framework is structured into key functional layers, including perception, reasoning, decisionmaking, action execution, and feedback-driven learning, enabling continuous adaptation to evolving attack patterns. By integrating intelligent agents with real-time data analysis and automated response mechanisms, AACF supports proactive threat detection, dynamic risk assessment, and coordinated mitigation strategies across distributed environments. A conceptual architecture is presented, along with illustrative use cases demonstrating its applicability to intrusion detection, incident response, and autonomous security orchestration. The proposed framework contributes to the emerging paradigm of self-directed cybersecurity systems and provides a foundation for developing resilient, scalable, and intelligent defense infrastructures.
title_cn: 智能体式 AI 网络安全框架
abstract_cn: 现代网络威胁在规模、复杂性与动态性上的不断增长，使传统的被动式网络安全机制显得不足。本文提出一个智能体式 AI 网络安全框架（AACF），旨在实现自主、目标驱动且自适应的网络防御操作。与依赖预定义规则和人工干预的传统系统不同，所提框架利用智能体式人工智能感知环境状态、推理潜在威胁，并在最少监督下执行上下文感知的响应。该框架由若干关键功能层构成，包括感知、推理、决策、动作执行以及反馈驱动的学习，从而能够持续适应不断演化的攻击模式。通过将智能体与实时数据分析和自动化响应机制相结合，AACF 支持跨分布式环境的主动威胁检测、动态风险评估与协同缓解策略。文中给出了一个概念架构，并通过示例用例展示其在入侵检测、事件响应与自主安全编排中的适用性。所提框架为新兴的自主导向网络安全系统范式作出贡献，并为构建有韧性、可扩展且智能的防御基础设施奠定基础。
summary_cn: 提出由感知、推理、决策、执行与反馈学习各层构成的智能体式 AI 网络防御概念框架 AACF，以入侵检测、事件响应与安全编排的示例用例说明适用性，未报告实验评估。
objective_summary: 提出面向自主网络防御的分层智能体式 AI 概念架构 AACF，并以示例用例说明其应用场景，未进行实证评估。
evidence_note: 仅有概念架构与示例用例，摘要未报告任何实现、数据集、基线或量化实验。
novelty_note: 感知-推理-决策-执行-反馈的分层是智能体系统常见结构，此处套用于网络防御。
scope: 停留在概念层面，适用于入侵检测、事件响应与安全编排等自动化防御的设计讨论。
limitations: 无实现与实验验证；摘要未涉及智能体自身被攻击或误操作带来的风险。

title: Security and Privacy in Large-Model-Driven Embodied Agents: Attacks, Defenses, and Future Directions
abstract: Large-model-driven embodied agents integrate foundation models with perception, reasoning, planning, and physical action, extending conventional model-level risks into embodied closed loops. Existing studies on their security and privacy remain fragmented across different system components and operational stages, making it difficult to understand how risks arise, propagate, and ultimately affect physical behavior or sensitive information. This survey presents a lifecycle-based analysis of security and privacy in large-model-driven embodied agents. We organize existing research into five stages: model construction and supply chain, multimodal input and interaction, semantic reasoning and task planning, action execution and physical feedback, and long-term deployment. Within this lifecycle, we systematically review representative attacks, defenses, and evaluation methods. Our analysis shows that attack entry, consequence realization, and defense intervention often occur at different stages of the embodied closed loop. It further reveals substantial gaps in end-to-end protection, real-world evaluation, and long-term privacy governance. This survey provides a unified perspective for understanding current progress and identifying critical directions for securing large-model-driven embodied agents.
title_cn: 大模型驱动具身智能体的安全与隐私：攻击、防御与未来方向
abstract_cn: 大模型驱动的具身智能体将基础模型与感知、推理、规划和物理动作相结合，把传统的模型层风险延伸到具身闭环之中。现有关于其安全与隐私的研究分散在不同的系统组件与运行阶段中，使人难以理解风险如何产生、传播，并最终影响物理行为或敏感信息。本综述对大模型驱动具身智能体的安全与隐私开展了基于生命周期的分析。我们将现有研究组织为五个阶段：模型构建与供应链、多模态输入与交互、语义推理与任务规划、动作执行与物理反馈，以及长期部署。在这一生命周期框架内，我们系统回顾了代表性的攻击、防御与评估方法。我们的分析表明，攻击入口、后果实现与防御介入往往发生在具身闭环的不同阶段。分析还揭示了在端到端防护、真实世界评估与长期隐私治理方面的显著空白。本综述为理解当前进展、识别保障大模型驱动具身智能体安全的关键方向提供了统一视角。
summary_cn: 按模型构建与供应链、多模态输入、推理规划、动作执行、长期部署五个生命周期阶段综述具身智能体的攻击、防御与评估，指出攻击入口、后果与防御常分处不同阶段。
objective_summary: 以五阶段生命周期框架梳理大模型驱动具身智能体的安全与隐私研究，归纳代表性攻击、防御与评估方法并总结研究空白。
evidence_note: 系统性文献梳理，但摘要未说明检索方法、纳入标准与覆盖文献数量。
novelty_note: 以生命周期阶段组织具身智能体安全文献，并提出攻击入口与后果跨阶段分离的观察。
scope: 适用于以基础模型驱动感知、规划与物理执行的具身智能体相关研究。
limitations: 摘要未给出检索协议与文献规模，结论依赖所选的代表性工作。

title: A Non-Invasive Cloud-Based Migration Strategy for Post-Quantum Cybersecurity in Smart HVAC Systems: Architecture, Implementation, and Empirical Evaluation
abstract: Legacy smart HVAC controllers rely on vendor-cloud TLS secured by ECDH and RSA, both broken by Shor's algorithm, and typical 10-15 year lifespans mean today's devices remain in service through the quantum-threat era. Direct on-device post-quantum cryptography is infeasible: an ESP32-S3, representative of capable HVAC hardware, has only 339 KB free heap against the 900 KB ML-KEM-768 requires, and even classical ECDH-P256 keygen (111.93 ms) dwarfs hardware AES-128 (0.032 ms). We propose a non-invasive PQC proxy, requiring no device, firmware, or vendor-cloud changes, performing ML-KEM-768 encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 authentication (NIST FIPS 203/204) with AES-256-GCM session keys via HKDF, implemented with Open Quantum Safe liboqs on a Raspberry Pi 4B gateway. Over 500 runs, the post-quantum handshake (Steps 1-6) completes in 2.48 ms, 0.38 ms slower than classical baseline, with PQC computation around 8% of handshake time at 20 ms simulated round-trip network latency. The gateway sustains 443 sessions/second, 100% success under 32 concurrent connections, extrapolating to 3546 sessions/second on a 32-core cloud instance. Five side-channel tests, including verified in-place session-key zeroization and a fixed-vs-random TVLA timing analysis, found no exploitable timing leakage or susceptibility to man-in-the-middle attacks. The architecture is vendor-agnostic and becomes unnecessary once vendors adopt NIST PQC natively.
comment: 27 pages, 12 figures (3 architecture diagrams, 9 experimental plots), 6 tables. Preprint; work in progress. Presents a non-invasive post-quantum cryptography proxy for smart HVAC systems with empirical evaluation on Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3 hardware (ML-KEM-768, ML-DSA-65, liboqs)
title_cn: 面向智能 HVAC 系统后量子网络安全的非侵入式云端迁移策略：架构、实现与实证评估
abstract_cn: 传统智能 HVAC 控制器依赖由 ECDH 与 RSA 保护的厂商云 TLS，而二者均可被 Shor 算法攻破；典型的 10-15 年使用寿命意味着当今的设备在量子威胁时代仍将服役。直接在设备上运行后量子密码并不可行：代表较强 HVAC 硬件的 ESP32-S3 仅有 339 KB 空闲堆，而 ML-KEM-768 需要 900 KB；即使是经典 ECDH-P256 的密钥生成（111.93 ms）也远超硬件 AES-128（0.032 ms）。我们提出一种非侵入式 PQC 代理，无需改动设备、固件或厂商云，执行 ML-KEM-768 封装与 ML-DSA-65 认证（NIST FIPS 203/204），并通过 HKDF 派生 AES-256-GCM 会话密钥，在 Raspberry Pi 4B 网关上基于 Open Quantum Safe liboqs 实现。在 500 次运行中，后量子握手（步骤 1-6）在 2.48 ms 内完成，比经典基线慢 0.38 ms；在 20 ms 模拟往返网络时延下，PQC 计算约占握手时间的 8%。该网关可维持每秒 443 个会话，在 32 个并发连接下成功率为 100%，外推到 32 核云实例可达每秒 3546 个会话。五项侧信道测试（包括经验证的原地会话密钥清零，以及固定对随机的 TVLA 时序分析）未发现可利用的时序泄露，也未发现易受中间人攻击的问题。该架构与厂商无关，一旦厂商原生采用 NIST PQC 便不再需要。
summary_cn: 在 Raspberry Pi 4B 网关上实现 ML-KEM-768/ML-DSA-65 非侵入式 PQC 代理，无需改动 HVAC 设备与厂商云；握手 2.48 ms，比经典慢 0.38 ms。
objective_summary: 在 ESP32-S3 上测量设备端运行 PQC 的可行性，并在 Raspberry Pi 4B 网关上实现无需改动设备、固件与厂商云的后量子代理，测量握手时延、吞吐、并发成功率与侧信道表现。
evidence_note: 500 次运行并对比经典基线，含并发、吞吐与 TVLA 时序测试；仅单一网关硬件，网络时延为模拟，云端吞吐为外推。
novelty_note: 用 ML-KEM、ML-DSA 与 liboqs 等标准组件搭代理网关，贡献主要在 HVAC 场景的集成与实测。
scope: 适用于经厂商云 TLS 通信的智能 HVAC 控制器与 Raspberry Pi 4B 级网关部署。
limitations: 设备与厂商云均不改动，摘要未说明代理之外各段链路如何获得量子安全；云端吞吐为外推。

title: MixGuard: Towards Detecting and Understanding Mixer Laundering on Ethereum
abstract: Mixers protect privacy by concealing deposit--withdrawal links, but are also abused to launder illicit funds. Existing anti-money laundering studies do not specifically target mixer laundering, while mixer research focuses on deanonymization rather than identifying laundering-related transactions. Public reports remain fragmented, leaving no public case-level dataset for systematic measurement and detection. To fill this void, this paper presents the first comprehensive study of mixer laundering on Ethereum. We first construct \textsc{MixLaunder}, the first public case-level dataset of mixer laundering. It covers 27 cases involving Tornado Cash and Railgun from 2020 to 2025 and labels 9,300 laundering-related transactions with case identities and observable upstream and downstream fund flows, including deposits totaling approximately \$1.1 billion. By comparing these transactions with background mixer usage, we identify five common strategies, showing that laundering evidence spans complementary behavioral and fund-flow contexts, while same-case activity is locally tight but weakly connected across bursts. Our analysis further reveals coverage gaps in mixer-side risk screening and representative deanonymization heuristics. Guided by these findings, we develop \textsc{MixGuard}, which combines tri-view representation learning with two-stage grouping for transaction-level detection and case-aware grouping. Under strict case-level holdout evaluation, \textsc{MixGuard} outperforms representative baselines, achieving 97.89\% detection precision and 98.73\% group purity, while its top ten groups cover 95.09\% of each case's transactions on average.
comment: accepted by ACM SIGMETRICS 2027
title_cn: MixGuard：迈向以太坊混币器洗钱的检测与理解
abstract_cn: 混币器通过隐藏存款与取款之间的关联来保护隐私，但也被滥用于清洗非法资金。现有反洗钱研究并未专门针对混币器洗钱，而混币器研究关注的是去匿名化，而非识别与洗钱相关的交易。公开报告仍较零散，导致至今没有可用于系统测量与检测的公开案例级数据集。为填补这一空白，本文对以太坊上的混币器洗钱开展了首个全面研究。我们首先构建了 MixLaunder——首个公开的混币器洗钱案例级数据集。它涵盖 2020 至 2025 年间涉及 Tornado Cash 与 Railgun 的 27 个案例，为 9,300 笔洗钱相关交易标注了案例身份以及可观测的上下游资金流，其中存款总额约 11 亿美元。通过将这些交易与背景混币器使用情况进行比较，我们识别出五种常见策略，表明洗钱证据分布在互补的行为上下文与资金流上下文之中，而同一案例的活动在局部高度紧密、跨突发批次之间却联系较弱。我们的分析还揭示了混币器侧风险筛查与代表性去匿名化启发式方法的覆盖缺口。在这些发现的指导下，我们开发了 MixGuard，它将三视图表示学习与两阶段分组相结合，用于交易级检测与案例感知分组。在严格的案例级留出评估下，MixGuard 优于代表性基线，检测精确率达 97.89%，分组纯度达 98.73%，且其前十个分组平均覆盖每个案例 95.09% 的交易。
summary_cn: 构建首个公开混币器洗钱案例数据集 MixLaunder（27 案、9,300 笔交易），提出 MixGuard，案例级留出下精确率 97.89%、分组纯度 98.73%（SIGMETRICS'27）。
objective_summary: 构建以太坊混币器洗钱案例级数据集并对行为与资金流做测量分析，据此设计三视图表示学习加两阶段分组的检测方法，以案例级留出评估与基线对比。
evidence_note: 27 个案例、9,300 笔标注交易，严格案例级留出评估并与代表性基线对比；摘要未提统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 首个公开的混币器洗钱案例级数据集，并把目标从去匿名化转向洗钱交易识别与案例分组。
scope: 适用于以太坊 Tornado Cash 与 Railgun 在 2020–2025 年间的已知洗钱案例。
limitations: 仅 27 个已知案例、两种混币器，对未曝光案例或新型洗钱手法的泛化未验证。

title: The hidden life of signals: Time-domain inferences and other privacy attacks on everyday devices
abstract: In privacy research on radiofrequency-based protocols, the dominant focus has remained on Bluetooth, WiFi, and Zigbee, while a broader and arguably more consequential attack surface has gone largely unnoticed: the privacy risks created by the composition of everyday wireless protocols. Widely deployed systems such as KeeLoq remotes, vehicle TPMS sensors, and other sub-GHz devices continuously emit metadata and timing structure that, when analyzed jointly rather than in isolation, enable powerful behavioral inference. This work-in-progress paper argues that privacy leakage in these environments is not merely a property of individual protocols, but an emergent property of their interaction, correlation, and composition across devices, spaces, and routines. The resulting attack surface arises both from protocol metadata that directly degrades privacy and from the latent relationships between devices and the ways users move among and interact with them over time. We present preliminary evidence that these composed signals expose underappreciated opportunities for inference and tracking, and we outline a research agenda for characterizing and mitigating this broader class of privacy failures.
comment: Work in progress. Presented at the 2026 Symposium on the Science of Security (HotSoS 2026), Session 11, April 16, 2026. Session listing: this https URL 9 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Device identifiers are pseudonymized
title_cn: 信号的隐秘生活：针对日常设备的时域推断及其他隐私攻击
abstract_cn: 在基于射频协议的隐私研究中，主流关注点一直集中在蓝牙、WiFi 与 Zigbee 上，而一个更广泛、且可以说影响更大的攻击面却在很大程度上被忽视：日常无线协议的组合所带来的隐私风险。KeeLoq 遥控器、车辆 TPMS 传感器及其他 sub-GHz 设备等广泛部署的系统持续发出元数据与时序结构，当对它们进行联合而非孤立的分析时，便能实现强有力的行为推断。这篇进行中工作论文认为，此类环境中的隐私泄露不只是单个协议的属性，而是这些协议在设备、空间与日常作息之间相互作用、关联与组合所产生的涌现属性。由此产生的攻击面既来自直接削弱隐私的协议元数据，也来自设备之间的潜在关联，以及用户随时间在设备之间移动并与之交互的方式。我们给出初步证据，表明这些组合信号暴露了未被充分认识的推断与追踪机会，并勾勒了一个用于刻画与缓解这一更广泛类别隐私失效的研究议程。
summary_cn: 主张 KeeLoq 遥控、TPMS 等 sub-GHz 日常无线协议的元数据与时序在联合分析时会涌现行为推断与追踪风险，给出初步证据与研究议程（HotSoS 2026，进行中工作）。
objective_summary: 论证多种日常无线协议组合导致的隐私泄露是一种涌现属性，以初步证据支撑并提出刻画与缓解该类问题的研究议程。
evidence_note: 摘要只称给出初步证据，未说明采集规模、场景数量或对照；comment 称含 8 图 5 表，设备标识已假名化。
novelty_note: 把隐私泄露从单协议视角转向跨协议组合与时域关联，关注较少研究的 sub-GHz 攻击面。
scope: 适用于 KeeLoq 遥控器、TPMS 等持续发射的 sub-GHz 设备及其所处的日常环境。
limitations: 进行中工作，证据为初步性质，推断与追踪的准确率及缓解措施尚未系统评估。

title: Trouble at the top: can Python extend the chains of trust in infrastructure firmware?
abstract: Compiled Python bytecode (PYC) has become an essential part of network switches, routers, and other network infrastructure devices. Our analysis shows that its integrity is implicitly trusted in multiple designs that make use of Python code at the top of the operational software, such as the management and control pane of enterprise network switches. At the same time, the integrity of PYC files is not covered under the traditional chain-of-trust models, due to complex interactions with the CPython loader, byte compiler, and other Python runtime components. We explore the risks inherent in including PYC and Python runtimes in the de facto trusted code basis of commercial enterprise equipment and offer a comprehensive framework for understanding emergent behaviors in these designs.
comment: Work in progress. Presented at the 2026 Symposium on the Science of Security (HotSoS 2026), Session 2, April 14, 2026. Session listing: this https URL 9 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
title_cn: 顶层之患：Python 能否延伸基础设施固件的信任链？
abstract_cn: 编译后的 Python 字节码（PYC）已成为网络交换机、路由器及其他网络基础设施设备的重要组成部分。我们的分析表明，在多种将 Python 代码置于运行软件顶层的设计中（例如企业网络交换机的管理与控制平面），PYC 的完整性被隐式信任。与此同时，由于与 CPython 加载器、字节编译器及其他 Python 运行时组件之间存在复杂交互，PYC 文件的完整性并未被传统的信任链模型所覆盖。我们探讨了将 PYC 与 Python 运行时纳入商用企业设备事实上的可信代码基所固有的风险，并提供了一个用于理解这类设计中涌现行为的综合框架。
summary_cn: 指出企业交换机等网络设备管理/控制平面中的 PYC 字节码被隐式信任却不在传统信任链覆盖内，探讨其风险并提出理解涌现行为的框架（HotSoS 2026，进行中工作）。
objective_summary: 分析商用企业网络设备中 Python 字节码与运行时处于事实可信代码基、却不在信任链保护范围内的问题，并提出理解相关风险的框架。
evidence_note: 摘要仅称分析了多种设计，未给出分析的设备数量、攻击演示或量化结果；作者自陈为进行中工作。
novelty_note: 点出 PYC 完整性因 CPython 加载与编译机制落在传统信任链模型之外这一具体缺口。
scope: 适用于在管理与控制平面运行 CPython 与 PYC 的商用企业网络设备。
limitations: 进行中工作，摘要未给出受影响设备清单、可利用性验证或缓解方案评估。

title: Agent Name Collision Attacks in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: Multi-agent hosts turn remote Agent Cards into local agents, tools, workflow targets, and broker routes. A2A defines the card's name as human-readable metadata, not as a stable identity, and specifies no collision semantics. The security failure begins when a host nevertheless uses that remote name as a local routing identifier. We traced registration through dispatch and ran isolated regression tests at seven pinned open-source revisions. Six client-style integrations selected an attacker-controlled peer's client or loopback endpoint for a request addressed to a trusted peer's name. A seventh, brokered implementation collapsed both peers onto one name-derived route; queue and access-control state determine whether the result is interception or denial. The common result is wrong-peer dispatch, not universal privilege inheritance. Synthetic credential and tool tests found no A-specific credential transfer in the tested client bindings and no direct transfer of A-owned tools. The broker path forwards a caller-configuration object; delegated identity or tokens reach B only if present and B can consume the route. Two other paths expose a later, model-mediated decision rather than direct execution authority. The necessary conditions assign different responsibilities to the protocol, implementations, and deployments. Hosts should route by an origin-bound stable identity, keep names presentational, and reject ambiguous aliases. The evidence establishes a recurring implementation vulnerability class, not a universal A2A protocol exploit or a count of vulnerable deployments.
title_cn: 多智能体系统中的智能体名称碰撞攻击
abstract_cn: 多智能体宿主会把远程 Agent Card 转换为本地的智能体、工具、工作流目标与代理（broker）路由。A2A 将卡片的 name 定义为人类可读的元数据，而非稳定身份，也没有规定任何碰撞语义。当宿主仍把这个远程名称用作本地路由标识符时，安全失效便由此开始。我们从注册到派发全程追踪，并在七个固定版本的开源代码上运行了隔离的回归测试。六个客户端式集成在请求发往受信任对等方名称时，选中了攻击者控制的对等方的客户端或回环端点。第七个基于代理的实现把两个对等方合并到同一个由名称派生的路由上；结果是拦截还是拒绝，取决于队列与访问控制状态。共同的结果是派发给错误的对等方，而非普遍的权限继承。合成凭证与工具测试发现，在所测客户端绑定中不存在 A 特有凭证的转移，也不存在 A 所拥有工具的直接转移。代理路径会转发一个调用方配置对象；委托身份或 token 只有在其存在且 B 能消费该路由时才会到达 B。另外两条路径暴露的是之后由模型介导的决策，而非直接的执行权限。这些必要条件把不同的责任分配给协议、实现与部署。宿主应按与来源绑定的稳定身份进行路由，使名称仅用于展示，并拒绝有歧义的别名。这些证据确立的是一个反复出现的实现漏洞类别，而不是一个普遍的 A2A 协议漏洞利用，也不是对易受攻击部署数量的统计。
summary_cn: 揭示多智能体宿主把 A2A Agent Card 名称当作路由标识引发的名称碰撞：7 个开源实现中 6 个把发给可信对等方的请求派发到攻击者端点，1 个代理实现合并路由导致拦截或拒绝；未发现普遍的权限继承。
objective_summary: 追踪 A2A 宿主从注册到派发的名称处理路径，在七个固定版本开源实现上以隔离回归测试及合成凭证、工具测试检验错派与权限转移。
evidence_note: 七个固定版本实现的隔离回归测试与合成凭证、工具测试；作者明示不统计真实易受攻击部署数量。
novelty_note: 把 A2A 名称作路由标识引发的错派命名为一类实现漏洞，并区分协议、实现与部署的责任。
scope: 结论限于所测七个开源 A2A 宿主实现与版本，不代表协议普遍漏洞或部署流行度。
limitations: 样本仅七个实现且在隔离环境测试；真实部署中攻击者注册同名对等方的可行性未测量。

title: CCR: Towards a Common, Quality-Gated CACAO Integrations Registry for European Cybersecurity Automation
abstract: Standardised, machine-readable cybersecurity playbooks provide a basis for portable, shareable, and reusable incident-response logic. OASIS CACAO provides a vendor-neutral representation for such playbooks, but not the product-specific integration artefacts needed to invoke external products and services. We introduce the Common CACAO Registry (CCR), an open, provenance-aware registry of CACAO HTTP-API connector envelopes. Each envelope captures an API operation's command, inputs, target, authentication-related information, provenance, validation evidence, and maturity metadata. CCR is quality-gated, with acceptance requiring both CACAO v2 schema validity and a mean back-validation score of at least 0.8 against the source OpenAPI operation, while a six-level maturity model records progressively stronger evidence and distinguishes gate acceptance from operational readiness. To seed CCR, we develop a hybrid OpenAPI-to-CACAO pipeline. Deterministic code extracts source-derived interface facts, generates identifiers, wires cross-references, and validates structure, while a constrained LLM provides bounded semantic enrichment, including action naming, authentication interpretation, and CACAO activity annotation. Evaluation across eight security APIs yields 713 CACAO-schema-valid envelopes with a mean back-validation score of 91.5%, of which 675 produce well-formed, dispatchable HTTP requests in a local harness. Comparison with a deterministic rule-based baseline shows that mechanical API structure is preserved more reliably through rule-based translation, while the LLM contributes bounded semantic enrichment, most notably CACAO activity annotation. Together, these results support CCR as reusable integration infrastructure for CACAO action steps and as an initial foundation for a broader common European registry.
comment: 20 pages. Accepted at the 12th Workshop on the Security of Industrial Control Systems & of Cyber-Physical Systems (CyberICPS 2026), held in conjunction with ESORICS 2026. To appear in Springer LNCS
title_cn: CCR：迈向面向欧洲网络安全自动化的通用、质量门控 CACAO 集成注册库
abstract_cn: 标准化、机器可读的网络安全剧本为可移植、可共享、可复用的事件响应逻辑提供了基础。OASIS CACAO 为此类剧本提供了厂商中立的表示，但不提供调用外部产品与服务所需的产品特定集成工件。我们提出通用 CACAO 注册库（Common CACAO Registry，CCR），一个开放的、感知来源的 CACAO HTTP-API 连接器封装注册库。每个封装记录一个 API 操作的命令、输入、目标、认证相关信息、来源、验证证据与成熟度元数据。CCR 采用质量门控：收录要求同时满足 CACAO v2 模式有效性，以及相对源 OpenAPI 操作的平均反向验证得分不低于 0.8；另有一个六级成熟度模型记录逐级增强的证据，并区分通过门控与具备运行就绪性。为给 CCR 提供初始内容，我们开发了一个混合式 OpenAPI 到 CACAO 流水线。确定性代码提取源自接口定义的事实、生成标识符、连接交叉引用并验证结构，而一个受约束的 LLM 提供有界的语义增强，包括动作命名、认证解释与 CACAO 活动标注。在八个安全 API 上的评估产出了 713 个符合 CACAO 模式的封装，平均反向验证得分为 91.5%，其中 675 个能在本地测试环境中生成格式正确、可派发的 HTTP 请求。与确定性的基于规则基线比较表明，基于规则的翻译能更可靠地保留机械性的 API 结构，而 LLM 贡献了有界的语义增强，其中最显著的是 CACAO 活动标注。综合而言，这些结果支持 CCR 作为 CACAO 动作步骤的可复用集成基础设施，以及作为更广泛的欧洲通用注册库的初步基础。
summary_cn: 提出质量门控的 CACAO 连接器注册库 CCR 与规则加 LLM 的 OpenAPI 到 CACAO 混合流水线：8 个安全 API 产出 713 个模式有效封装、平均反向验证得分 91.5%，其中 675 个可生成可派发请求（CyberICPS'26）。
objective_summary: 设计带质量门控与六级成熟度模型的 CACAO 连接器注册库，用规则加 LLM 的混合流水线从八个安全 API 生成封装，并与纯规则基线对比。
evidence_note: 8 个安全 API、713 个封装、本地测试环境可派发性检验与纯规则基线对比；未在真实事件响应流程中验证。
novelty_note: 补齐 CACAO 缺失的产品集成层并引入质量门控与成熟度分级，属标准生态的工程性推进。
scope: 结论适用于有 OpenAPI 描述的 HTTP 安全 API 与 CACAO v2 剧本表示。
limitations: 仅八个 API，可派发性只在本地测试环境检验；门控通过不等于运行就绪（作者自陈区分）。

title: Control-Token Injection Suppresses Chain-of-Thought and Defeats Reasoning-Based Oversight in Tool-Using Agents
abstract: The safety of a tool-using language model agent is usually treated as a property of the model alone. We give controlled, full-precision evidence that it is instead a joint property of the model and the software that renders its chat template and parses its tool calls, the decoding harness, and that both halves are attackable from untrusted input. On the released gpt-oss-20b reasoning model under its published tool sandbox, appending a single string of the model's own channel-control tokens to a user message makes the tokenizer render a reasoning turn that is already complete, so the model writes no chain-of-thought and proceeds directly to the tool call. Across forty tasks the model already completes, the reasoning channel falls from a mean of 52.5 tokens to zero on every trial while the http.post still fires on every trial. A rule monitor and a cross-family language-model monitor detect the unsafe request on all plain trials and no forged trials, and on overtly malicious requests the attack converts 39.6% of the model's refusals into completed exfiltrations. Separately, whether an identical tool-call generation fires is decided by the harness parser, not the model: a truncation-tolerant regular expression fires a call whose closing token is missing while a strict one drops it, and two parsers shipped for the Gemma agent give opposite outcomes on identical greedy generations, firing on all twenty-four trials and on none. We show the suppression can be delivered indirectly and characterize its dependence on the chat template across two more reasoning models, and we evaluate input sanitization, parser hardening, and empty-reasoning detection as defenses; flagging an absent trace catches the basic attack but not an adaptive benign decoy. All measurements use greedy decoding on publicly released models. Code and per-trial logs: https://github.com/Usama1002/deleting-the-trace
title_cn: 控制 token 注入抑制思维链并击败工具型智能体中基于推理的监督
abstract_cn: 工具型语言模型智能体的安全性通常被视为仅属于模型本身的属性。我们给出受控的、全精度的证据，表明它实际上是模型与解码 harness（即渲染聊天模板并解析工具调用的软件）的共同属性，并且这两部分都可以被不可信输入攻击。在已发布的 gpt-oss-20b 推理模型及其公开的工具沙箱下，只要在用户消息后附加一串该模型自身的通道控制 token，分词器就会渲染出一个已经完成的推理轮次，于是模型不写任何思维链而直接进行工具调用。在模型本已能完成的四十个任务上，推理通道在每次试验中都从平均 52.5 个 token 降为零，而 http.post 仍在每次试验中被触发。一个规则监控器和一个跨模型家族的语言模型监控器在所有普通试验中都检测出了不安全请求，而在所有伪造试验中均未检测出；在明显恶意的请求上，该攻击把模型 39.6% 的拒绝转化为完成的数据外泄。另外，同一个工具调用生成是否会被触发取决于 harness 解析器而非模型：容忍截断的正则表达式会触发缺少结束 token 的调用，而严格的正则表达式会将其丢弃；为 Gemma 智能体发布的两个解析器在相同的贪心生成上给出相反结果，一个在全部二十四次试验中都触发，另一个一次都不触发。我们表明这种抑制可以被间接投递，并在另外两个推理模型上刻画了它对聊天模板的依赖；我们还评估了输入净化、解析器加固与空推理检测三种防御：标记缺失的推理轨迹能捕获基础攻击，但无法捕获自适应的良性诱饵。所有测量均在公开发布的模型上使用贪心解码。代码与逐次试验日志：https://github.com/Usama1002/deleting-the-trace
summary_cn: 在 gpt-oss-20b 用户消息中附加其自身通道控制 token，即可让思维链从平均 52.5 token 降为零且工具调用照常触发，规则与 LLM 监控器全部漏检，并将 39.6% 的拒绝转为数据外泄；另揭示 harness 解析器决定调用是否触发。
